Downs (1957) proposed the simplest model of representative democracy. This model considers two candidates solely focused on election outcomes. Candidates announce a single policy proposal and commit to implementing it if elected. As long as voters' preferences exhibit single-peakedness, Downs' model yields a unique equilibrium where both candidates announce policies closest to the median voter's preferences. The model's conclusions can be extended to scenarios where candidates possess personal policy preferences provided they at least covet the office they are contesting. Although candidates cannot ascertain the distribution of voters' policy preferences, elections involve numerous policy issues, campaign costs are high, and potential candidates must decide whether to announce their candidacy—these factors could lead to outcomes diverging from Downs' model—the framework still provides a solid foundation for interpreting the median voter's preferred policy as the equilibrium outcome of standard models.

Query_Text_cn: 为什么高速路边取款机的小键盘上有点字盲文呢？光顾这些机器的人大多都是司机，其中并无盲人。根据我的学生比尔·托亚的说法，取款机制造商必须给普通的街头取款机装配带点字盲文的小键盘，因此，所有机器都造成一个样子，成本更低廉。要不然的话，就要把两类机器分开，保证合适的机器安装到合适的地方。倘若点字盲文给看得见的用户造成了麻烦，那费这么大功夫也算物有所值，但它们并不碍事。
Translation: Why do the small keyboards on ATM machines at highways have Braille? The people who use these machines are mostly drivers, and there are no blind individuals among them. According to my student Bill Toya, manufacturers of ATM machines are required to equip ordinary street-side ATMs with Braille keyboards, so all machines are produced in one uniform design to make them cheaper. Otherwise, they would have to manufacture two separate types of machines and ensure the proper machines are installed in appropriate locations. Even if the Braille causes inconvenience to sighted users, the effort is presumably justified—but in reality, the Braille doesn't pose any problem.

Query_Text_cn: 话要从头说起。我在自己的经济学概论课上，布置了一篇书面作业：“利用经济学原理，探讨你亲身观寮到的事件或行为棋式中的有趣问题。”而托亚先生的问题，正是他交给我的作业一一他交上来两篇短文，其中一个的标题就是这个。我在课堂上说，“文章字数有限制，500字以内。很多出色的论文比这还要短得多。文章里面不要掺杂复杂的技术。要假设你是在给一个从没上过经济学课的亲戚讲故事。最好的论文，普通人一看就明白了，而且一般都不用什么公式和图表。
Translation: Let me start from the beginning. In my principles of economics course, I assigned a written assignment: "Using economic principles, explore an interesting question arising from an event or behavioral pattern you have personally observed." Mr. Toya's question was precisely what he submitted in his assignment—he turned in two short essays, one of which bore that very title. In class, I had said, "The essay has a word limit of 500 words. Many excellent papers are even shorter. Avoid overly technical jargon. Imagine you're telling a story to a relative who has never taken an economics course. The best papers are those anyone can understand without formulas or charts."

Query_Text_cn: 跟比尔·托亚有关取款机键盘的问题一样，最好的论文．急包含着一个似是而非的问题。
Translation: The best paper related to the ATM keyboard issue connected with Bill Toya. Urgent. It contains a seemingly valid but questionable problem.

Query_Text_cn: 杜尔斯墓认为，这是因为大多数新娘在婚礼那天都希望显得漂亮又时尚，所以租赁公司必须储备大录与众不同的婚纱每种尺码四五十种。每套婚纱租赁的次数很少，可能每隔四五年才租得出去一次。因此，为了弥补开支，公司收取的租赁费比直接买一套还要贵。既然买更便宜，也就没有人会租。反过来说，由于新郎安于规矩的样子，租赁公司只需要每款型号准备一两套礼服就行了。所以，每套礼服每年都能租出去好儿次，租比买要便宜得多。
Translation: Durslmeyer argues that this is because most brides wish to appear beautiful and fashionable on their wedding day, so rental companies must stock a wide variety of distinctive wedding dresses, with each size available in four to fifty different options. Each dress is rented out very infrequently, possibly only once every four or five years. To offset operational costs, rental fees are set higher than the price of purchasing a dress outright. Since buying is cheaper, no one would choose to rent. Conversely, as grooms are content with a conventional appearance, rental companies need only keep one or two suits per model. Consequently, each suit can be rented out several times annually, making renting significantly cheaper than purchasing.

Query_Text_cn: 本书收录了我多年来收集的最有趣的 “经济自然主义者” 案例，献给那些如比尔・托亚（Bill Tjoa）和詹妮弗・杜尔斯基（Jennifer Dulski）一样，乐于解开日常人类行为之谜的读者。“我想向你介绍马蒂・索恩德克（Marty Thorndecker）。他是一位经济学家，但人真的非常好。”尽管许多人认为经济学是一门晦涩难懂的学科，但其基本原理既简单又贴合常识。通过具体案例观察这些原理的实际应用，任何人都能毫不费力地掌握它们。
Translation: This book compiles the most intriguing "economic naturalist" cases I have collected over the years, dedicated to readers like Bill Tjoa and Jennifer Dulski who enjoy unraveling the mysteries of everyday human behavior. "I want to introduce you to Marty Thorndecker. He is an economist and a genuinely good person." While many perceive economics as an arcane discipline, its core principles are both simple and intuitively familiar. By examining concrete cases of their practical application, anyone can effortlessly master these principles.

Query_Text_cn: 不幸的是，大学里并不这么教经济学。我在康奈尔大学执教后不久，几个身在不同城市的朋友不约而同地给我发来了埃德·阿诺(EdArno）的这幅漫画：很南兴向你介绍刺儿头先生。他是个经济学家，可人真的很好。
Translation: Unfortunately, economics is not taught this way in universities. Shortly after I began teaching at Cornell University, several friends in different cities independently sent me Ed Arno's cartoon: "Let me introduce Mr. Prickly. He's an economist, but he's really a nice guy."

Query_Text_cn: 漫画就是事实。如果人们觉得它有意思，那准是因为它说出了一些真相。早在阿诺的漫画流传开来之前，我就注意到，每当在社交场合，人们问起我的职业，我回答自己是经济学家时，他们总会有点失望。我不禁追问为什么。不少人会提起多年前上过的经济学概论课，“全都是那些可怕的图表。
Translation: Cartoons are facts. If people find them amusing, it must be because they speak to some truth. Long before Arno's cartoons began circulating widely, I had noticed that in social gatherings, whenever people asked about my profession and I answered that I was an economist, they would always seem a bit disappointed. I couldn't help but ask why. Many would mention their long-forgotten Introduction to Economics course: "It was all about those daunting charts."

Query_Text_cn: 学习经济学的本科生相对较少，攻读经济学博士学位的比例更是微乎其微。然而，许多经济学概论课程却充斥着公式与图表，且其教学内容竟以这部分微乎其微的博士预备群体为目标受众。

Query_Text_cn: 结果，大多数上这些课的学生没学到什么知识。上课六个月之后，学生们参加基本经济学知识测试，他们的表现比从没上过概论课的学生好不了多少。
Translation: As a result, most students enrolled in these courses gained little knowledge. Six months later, when they participated in a basic economics knowledge test, their performance was only slightly better than that of students who had never taken an introductory course.

Query_Text_cn: 学生们似乎连最基本的经济学原理都没弄懂。如果你上过经挤学课程，至少听说过“机会成本”这个词吧。从事一项活动的机会成本，是指你为了从事这件事而放弃的其他享情的价值。
Translation: Students seem not to grasp even the most basic principles of economics. If you've taken an economics course, you should at least have heard of the term "opportunity cost". The opportunity cost of engaging in an activity refers to the value of the alternatives you give up in order to pursue that activity.

Query_Text_cn: 举个例子，假设你森了一张美国大歌星埃里克·克莱普顿(EricClapton）今晚演唱会的免费门票。注意，你不能转售。可另一美国大歌星鲍勃·迪伦（BohDylan）今晚也在开演唱会，你也很想去。迪伦的演唱会票价为40美元。当然，你别的时候去看他的演出也行，但你的心理承受价格是50美元。换言之，要是迪伦的票价高过50美元，你就情愿不看了，哪怕你没别的事要做。除此之外，看两人的演出并无其他成本。
Translation: For example, suppose you have secured a free ticket to tonight's concert by American superstar Eric Clapton. Note that it cannot be resold. However, another American legend, Bob Dylan, is also holding a concert tonight, and you would also like to attend. Dylan's concert ticket costs $40. Of course, you could attend his show another time, but your willingness-to-pay threshold is $50. Put differently, if Dylan’s ticket price were above $50, you would prefer not to go, even if you had no other plans. Additionally, there are no other costs associated with attending either performance.

Query_Text_cn: 去看克莱普顿的演唱会，惟一必须牺牲的事情就是去看迪伦的演唱会。不去看迪伦的演唱会，你会错失对你来说价值50美元的表演，但同时，你也省下了买迪伦演唱会票所需支付的叨美元。所以，不去看迪伦演唱会，你放弃的价值是50-40=10（美元）。如果你觉得看克莱普顿的演唱会至少值10美元，那你就应该去看；要不然，就去看迪伦的演唱会。
Translation: Attending Eric Clapton's concert requires sacrificing the opportunity to see Bob Dylan's concert. By not attending Dylan's concert, you miss out on a performance worth $50 to you, but you also save the $40 you would have spent on his ticket. Therefore, the value forgone by skipping Dylan's concert is $50 - $40 = $10. If you believe Clapton's concert is worth at least $10 to you, you should attend it; otherwise, go to Dylan's concert.

Query_Text_cn: 按一般的看法，机会成本是经济学概论课上要介绍的两大（或三大）重点概念之一。但根据我们现在手边的可靠证据，不管从哪一个角度来看，大多数学生都没有掌握这个概念。最近，经济学家保罗·费雷罗（PaulFerraro）和劳拉·泰勒（LauraTaylor）向几组学生提出了上述克莱普顿／迪伦问题，看看他们能否做出正确回答。
Translation: According to conventional views, opportunity cost is one of the two (or three) key concepts introduced in an introductory economics course. However, based on the reliable evidence we currently have, from any perspective, most students fail to grasp this concept. Recently, economists Paul Ferraro and Laura Taylor presented several groups of students with the aforementioned Clapton/Dylan problem to see if they could answer it correctly.

Query_Text_cn: 如前所述，正确的答案是10美元，也就是你不去看迪伦演唱会所牺牲的价值。可是，费雷罗和泰勒向270名最近上了经济学课程的大学生提出了这个问题，只有7.4％的人选择了正确答案。因为只有4个选项，哪怕学生们是随机选择，正确率也该有25％。看起来，同学们似乎觉得掌握这些知洲良丢脸。
Translation: As mentioned earlier, the correct answer is $10, which is the value of the Dylan concert you forgo. However, when Ferrero and Taylor posed this question to 270 undergraduate students who had recently taken economics courses, only 7.4% selected the correct answer. Given there were four options, random guessing should yield a 25% accuracy rate. It appears students seem to find this knowledge embarrassing.

Query_Text_cn: 之后，费雷罗和泰勒又向88名从没上过经济学课程的学生提出了同一个问题，这回的正确率是17·2%比上过经济学课程的学生高两倍，但仍比随机选择的正确率要低。
Translation: Ferraro and Taylor then posed the same question to 88 students who had never taken an economics course. This time, the correct response rate was 17.2%, which was twice as high as that of students who had taken economics courses, but still lower than that of random selection.

Query_Text_cn: 为什么上过经济学课程的学生没能表现更佳呢？窃以为，主要原因是，在典型的概论课上，教授会给学生灌输几百个概念，机会成本只是其中之一，而且模模糊糊，一笔带过。倘若学生没花足够的时间在上面，没在不同的例子里反复演练，也就无法真正理解它。
Translation: Why do students who have taken economics courses fail to perform better? In my humble opinion, the primary reason is that in typical introductory classes, professors often cram hundreds of concepts into the curriculum, with opportunity cost being merely one among them, and frequently only explained in a cursory and ambiguous manner. If students do not invest sufficient time studying this principle or practice applying it through diverse examples, they cannot truly grasp its essence.

Query_Text_cn: 但费雷罗和泰勒提出了另一种可能性：教经济学的讲师自己也没掌握机会成本的基本概念。2005年美国经济学协会开年会的时候，他俩向l99名专业经济学家提出了同一个问题，只有21.6％的人选择了正确答案，25.1％的人认为去看克莱普顿演唱会的机会成本是0，25,6％认为是40美元，还有27.6％认为是50美元。
Translation: But Ferraro and Taylor proposed another possibility: economics lecturers themselves may not have grasped the basic concept of opportunity cost. In 2005, during the American Economic Association's annual conference, they posed the same question to 199 professional economists. Only 21.6% chose the correct answer, 25.1% believed the opportunity cost of attending Clapton's concert was $0, 25.6% thought it was $40, and 27.6% considered it $50.

Query_Text_cn: 费雷罗和泰勒核查了经济学概论最主要的教科书，他们发现，大多数教科书对机会成本并未给予足够的重视，来帮助学生解答克莱普铆迪伦问题。他们还注意到，比概论程度更深的教科书也未曾耐心、深人地介绍这个概念。在大学微观经济学的首选课本当中，索引里都找不到。机会成本”这个词。
Translation: Ferrero and Tyler reviewed the foremost textbooks in introductory economics and found that most of them did not give sufficient emphasis to opportunity cost to help students address the Kleppner-Dylan problem. They further observed that even textbooks aimed at more advanced audiences failed to provide a patient and thorough explanation of the concept. Remarkably, the term "opportunity cost" is listed nowhere in the index entries of leading university-level microeconomics textbooks.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，机会成本有助于解释一大堆有趣的行为模式。举个例子：众所周知，美国沿海大城市和中西部小城市之间存在着巨大的文峰异。
Translation: However, opportunity cost helps to explain a host of interesting behavioral patterns. For example: It is well known that there are significant Wenfeng differences between coastal megacities in the United States and small cities in the Midwestern region.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，你或许不同意这一前提，但大多数人好像觉得它还算是个中性的描述句。如果你在托皮卡问路，人们会停下来帮你，可在曼哈顿，他们可能看都不看你一眼。因为在这个地球上，曼哈顿的工资水平最高，要做的事情最多，他人时间的机会成本很高。所以，纽约人急躁一点儿是理所当然的。
Translation: Of course, you might disagree with this premise, but most people seem to consider it a relatively neutral descriptive statement. If you ask for directions in Topeka, people will stop to help you, but in Manhattan, they might not even glance at you. This is because, on this planet, Manhattan has the highest wages, the most tasks to accomplish, and the opportunity cost of others' time is extremely high. Therefore, it is understandable that New Yorkers are somewhat impatient.

Query_Text_cn: 我要求学生们写“博物经济学”作业，灵感得自生物学概论课上老师要学生们回答的那些问题。如果你了解一丁点儿进化论，你会发现很多以前从没注意到的事情。利用这一理论，我们可以识别和思考构建这个世界的基本结构和模式。
Translation: The inspiration for my students' "Muse Economics" assignments comes from the questions that the professor asked students to answer in the Introduction to Biology course. If you understand even a little of evolutionary theory, you will discover many things you never noticed before. By applying this theory, we can identify and reflect upon the basic structures and patterns that constitute the world.

Query_Text_cn: 比方说，有个标准的达尔文式问题：为什么大多数脊椎动物的雄性都比雌性大？比如雄海象有20多英尺长，6000多磅重（相当于一辆林肯SUV了），而雌海象却只有800-1200磅重。
Translation: For instance, there is a standard Darwinian question: Why are male vertebrates typically larger than females? Take male walruses as an example—they can grow to over 20 feet long and weigh more than 6,000 pounds (equivalent to a Lincoln SUV), while female walruses weigh only 800 to 1,200 pounds.

Query_Text_cn: 在大多数脊推动物身上都可观察到类似的两性差异。按进化论来解释，大多数脊椎动物都采用的是一夫多妻制（也就是说，只要雄性能力足够强，就可以占有多个雌性伴侣），因此雄性必须以竟争的方式才能获得雌性。雄海象有时候会在海滩上互相击打数个小时，直到其中一方筋疲力尽，满身是血地退却。
Translation: In most vertebrate species, similar sexual dimorphism can be observed. From an evolutionary perspective, the widespread polygyny among vertebrates (i.e., as long as the male is strong enough to secure multiple female mates) necessitates that males compete to obtain females. Male walruses sometimes battle each other for hours on the beach until one retreats exhausted and bloodied.

Query_Text_cn: 惟有战斗的胜利者，才能享有临幸上百只雌性海象的权力。这砂化成头等品的一种奖赏，同时也解释了为什么雄海象会大得多．在限其他雄性海象的争斗中，具有大块头突变基因的海象更容易获胜，于是下一代海象出现这种基因的几率会更高。简而言之，堆性这么大的原因在于，个头小的雄性很少有机会接近雌性。
Translation: Only the victors of these battles are granted the privilege of mating with dozens of female walruses. This selective mechanism acts as a premium reward and explains why male walruses are significantly larger. During fights against other male walruses, individuals carrying genetic mutations for larger size are more likely to prevail, increasing the likelihood of this gene appearing in subsequent generations. In short, the reason for such pronounced size disparity is that smaller males rarely have the opportunity to approach females.

Query_Text_cn: 雄孔雀有能开屏的漂亮大尾巴，原因也差不多。实验证明，雌孔雀喜欢有着较长尾羽的雄孔雀，因为，尾羽长象征着身体健康，而受寄生虫折磨的雄孔雀长不出光鲜好看的长尾巴。
Translation: The reason male peacocks have large, beautiful tails capable of fanning out is similar. Experiments have shown that female peacocks prefer males with longer tail feathers because long feathers symbolize good health, and males afflicted by parasites cannot grow vibrant long tails.

Query_Text_cn: 可对大块头雄海象和有着漂亮尾巴的雄孔雀来说，个体优势却成了群体的劣势。比如，一头6000磅重的海象，碰到天敌大白鳌时很难逃得掉。要是所有雄海象体重都能减轻一半，境况会好很多。这样一来，雄海象彼此之间打斗的结果还跟以前一样，而碰到大白盆时又更容易脱身。同样的道理，如果所有雄孔雀的尾羽全都减短一半，一方面，雌孔雀的选择仍跟以前一样，另一方面，碰到天敌时又更容易逃脱。可惜雄海象坚持庞大体格，雄孔雀也不肯放弃自己长长的尾羽。
Translation: For large male walruses and peacocks with magnificent tails, individual advantages become disadvantages for the group. For instance, a male walrus weighing 6,000 pounds struggles to escape from killer whales when threatened. If all male walruses halved their body weight, their situation would improve significantly. In this scenario, the outcomes of their fights would remain unchanged, yet they would escape killer whale attacks more easily. Similarly, if all peacocks shortened their tail feathers by half, on one hand, female peahens would still have the same basis for selection, while on the other hand, they would escape predators more easily when threatened. Unfortunately, male walruses persist in maintaining their massive size, and male peacocks refuse to abandon their long tail feathers.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，进化竞争并不会无限制地发展下去。到了某个程度之后，体格较大或尾羽较长的内在弱点，会逐渐超过较易接触雌性的优点。这种成本与收益的平衡，会反映在幸存下来的雄性身上。
Translation: Of course, evolutionary competition does not develop without limits. Once a certain point is reached, the inherent disadvantages of larger body size or longer tail feathers gradually outweigh the advantage of being more easily noticed by females. This balance between costs and benefits will be reflected in the surviving males.

Query_Text_cn: 生物学家的叙述很有趣。它条理分明，看似正确。按这样的说法，假设你看到了单一配偶的物种，即雄性和雌性终身相伴，你就不会发现两性差异。这便是“证明”这个词的古老含义一有规饭就有例外，而“有例外，才能证明规律的存在。”例外验证了规徐。一夫多妻制令我们得出了雄性体格大的结论。而对于那些不果用一夫多妻制的动物，雄性并不比雌性大。例如，信天翁是单一配偶，根据理论，雄性和雌性个头应该差不多大．事实也的确如此。
Translation: Biologists' accounts are fascinating. Their narratives are logically structured and seemingly valid. According to this reasoning, if you observe a monogamous species where males and females remain lifelong companions, you would not find significant sexual dimorphism. This reflects the ancient meaning of "proof" — there are exceptions to every rule, and "exceptions validate the rule's existence." Exceptions affirm the norm. Polygynous systems lead us to conclude that males are larger in size. In species without polygyny, however, males are not significantly larger than females. Take the albatross, a monogamous species, as a case in point. The theory predicts that males and females should be similarly sized, and this aligns with empirical observation.

Query_Text_cn: 生物学家有关两性差异的描述是站得住脚的。它容易记住，方便对他人转述：如果你能讲述这一类的故事，理解它们的内在原因，你对生物学的认识，也就比死记硬背鸟儿属于鸟纲上了一大级台阶。根据经济学原理，做出叙述性解释，道理也是一样。
Translation: Biologists' descriptions of sexual dimorphism are well-founded. These accounts are memorable and easy to convey to others: if you can tell such stories and understand their underlying causes, your grasp of biology will advance far beyond mere rote memorization of facts like "birds belong to the Aves class." Similarly, in economics, providing narrative explanations operates under the same principle.

Query_Text_cn: 大多数经济学概论课都不重视叙述（我自己从前也一样）。相反，它们把学生淹没在公式和图表里。数学是经济学知识发展进步的一项重要源泉，但对这堂课的人门者来说，并不见得是有效载体。除了工程系的学生，以及少数在数学生，以及少数在数学上受过深人训练的学生，大多数试图通过公式和图表来学习经济学的学生，绝不可能真正掌握’‘像经济学家一样思考”的著名思维方式。他们把大量精力都花在理解数学细节上了，却忽视了藏在经济学概念背后的常识。
Translation: Most introductory economics courses neglect narrative (I was once the same). Instead, they drown students in formulas and diagrams. Mathematics is an important source of progress in economic knowledge, but it is not necessarily an effective vehicle for beginners. Except for engineering students and a few who have undergone rigorous mathematical training, most students attempting to learn economics through formulas and diagrams will never truly master the famed "economic way of thinking." Their efforts become consumed by deciphering mathematical details while overlooking the common sense underlying economic concepts.

Query_Text_cn: 人的大脑是极端灵活的，有能力吸收无数种不同形式的新信息。但大多数脑袋吸收信息，都会存在一种较为轻松的方式。一般而言，学生处理公式和图表都很吃力。但由于我们这个物种在进化过程中变得疽于讲故事，几乎每个人都能轻轻松松地吸收以叙述形式表达的相应信息。
Translation: The human brain is extremely flexible, capable of absorbing new information in countless forms. However, most brains tend to favor a more effortless manner when processing information. Generally speaking, students struggle with formulas and charts. Yet, as our species has evolved to be gifted at storytelling, almost everyone can effortlessly absorb corresponding information presented in narrative form.

Query_Text_cn: 这一点，是我在二十多年前参加康奈尔大学的跨学科写作项目时偶然意识到的。研究表明，学习的最好方式之一，就是把它写下来。叙述性学习理论的两位倡议者，沃尔特·多尔（walterDoyl")和凯西·卡特（KathyCarter）曾指出，“究其核心，叙述性学习观点认为，人类有一种‘故事化’个人经历的共同倾向，也就是说，以叙述的方式阐释信息和经历。”另一叙述性学习理论家，心理学家杰罗姆·布鲁诺（JeromeBruner）发现，儿童会”把事情编成故事，当他们尝试理解生活，会利用故事化的视角看待个人经历，以此作为进一步思考的基础……如果他们不能以一种叙述性结构理解事情，就记不牢靠，以后也不能随时拿出来细细琢麟。
Translation: This realization came to me over two decades ago while participating in Cornell University's interdisciplinary writing program. Research demonstrates that one of the most effective ways to learn is by documenting it. Walter Doyle and Kathy Carter, two champions of narrative learning theory, noted that: "At its core, the narrative learning perspective holds that humans share a common tendency to 'narrativize' personal experiences, meaning they interpret information and experiences through a narrative framework." Another narrative learning theorist, psychologist Jerome Bruner, found that children naturally "construct stories when attempting to understand life, applying a narrative lens to their personal experiences as a basis for further reflection... If they cannot organize events into a narrative structure, the memories remain poorly retained and cannot be easily recalled for deeper contemplation later on."

Query_Text_cn: 一句话，吸收叙述性信息，似乎是人类大脑的专长。我的博物经济学书面作业，正是直接针对这一优势心：它要求学生的论文标题提出一个问题。我发现，向学生强调，要尽量列举最有趣的问题，这是很管用的。原因有三。第一，要找到一个有趣的问题，他们一般必须先考虑若干备选问题，这本身就是一项有用的锻炼；第二，提出有趣问题的学生会对作业产生更浓厚的兴趣，并投人更多精力；第三．提出有趣问题的学生更乐意对他人讲述。如果你不能把概念拿出教室应用它，就不算真正理解了它。可一旦你能自己用它，它就永远属于你了。
Translation: Absorbing narrative information appears to be a unique strength of the human brain. My natural economics written assignment is specifically designed to leverage this advantage: it requires students' paper titles to pose a question. I have found that emphasizing the importance of identifying the most intriguing questions is highly effective. There are three reasons. First, to find an interesting question, students typically must first consider multiple alternative questions—a process itself constituting valuable training. Second, students who formulate engaging questions develop greater interest in the assignment and invest more effort. Third, those who pose interesting questions are more inclined to discuss their work with others. If you cannot take a concept beyond the classroom to apply it, you have not truly mastered it. Yet once you can apply it independently, it becomes permanently your own.

Query_Text_cn: 成本效益原则，是所有经济学概念的源头。它提出，惟有当行动所带来的倾外效益大于倾外成本时，你才应该这么做。多简单的概念啊，不是吗？可要活学活用起来，也不是那么容易的。
Translation: The cost-benefit principle is the source of all economic concepts. It proposesthat you should only act when the external benefits generated by the action exceed its external costs. What a simple concept, isn't it? Yet applying it flexibly isn't always easy.

Query_Text_cn: 你想在隔壁的校内杂货店买一个闹钟，价位20美元。有个朋友告诉你，同样的闹钟在城里的红马特超市只卖10美元。你会进城买这个10美元的闹钟吗？还足直接在隔壁的杂货店买？不管你到哪里买，如果闹钟出了故障，都由制造商保修。
Translation: Would you go into the city to buy the alarm clock for $10 at Red Mart supermarket, or simply buy the same one priced at $20 from the school campus store nearby? No matter where you purchase it, any malfunctions would be covered by the manufacturer’s warranty.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，这里并没有绝对正确或错误的答案。每个人都必须权衡相关成本和收益。可当我们问别人在这种情况下怎么做的时候，大多数人都选了去凯马特超市买闹钟。
Translation: Certainly, there are no absolutely correct or incorrect answers here. Everyone must weigh the relevant costs and benefits. When we ask others what they would do in such a situation, however, most chose to buy an alarm clock at Kmart.

Query_Text_cn: 你想在隔壁的校内杂货店买一台笔记本电脑，价值2510美元。同样的电脑，在城里的凯马特超市卖2500美元。不管你在哪儿买．出了问题都要退回原厂保修。
Translation: You want to buy a laptop computer at the on-campus grocery store next door for $2510. The same laptop is sold at the Kmart supermarket in town for $2500. Regardless of where you purchase it, any issues must be returned to the original manufacturer for warranty service.

Query_Text_cn: 这一回，大多数人说他们会在学校里买。就问题本身而言，这样回答并不算错。但如果我们问一个理性的人在这两种情况下应该怎么做，他会说，成本效益原则清楚地表明，两次的回答应当一样。毕竟，在两个例子当中，你进城去的效益都是10美元，也就是你省下来的钱。成本是你为了进城所付的代价。在两例当中，这也是一样的。既然成本一样，效益一样，那么答案自然也该一样才对。
Translation: This time, most people said they would buy it at school. Taken at face value, such an answer is not incorrect. However, if we ask a rational person what they should do in both scenarios, they would argue that the principle of cost-benefit analysis clearly dictates that the answers should be consistent. After all, in both examples, the benefit of going into town is the $10 you save. The cost is what you pay to go into town. In both cases, this cost remains identical. Since the costs are the same and the benefits are identical, the answers should logically be consistent as well.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，大多数人似乎认为，去城里买闹钟，能省50％的钱，而买台2510美元的电脑，只能省10美元，前者的效益似乎比后者要大得多。可惜这不是正确的思考方式。按百分比来想问题．放在其他地方或许合适，但在这儿不行。
Translation: However, most people seem to believe that buying an alarm clock in the city can save 50% of the cost, while purchasing a $2,510 computer only saves $10, making the former's benefit appear far greater. Unfortunately, this is not the correct way to think about it. While considering percentages might be appropriate elsewhere, it does not apply here.

Query_Text_cn: 所以，你显然应当权衡成本和收益。看看成本效益原则如何在不寻常的例子里发挥作用，能让你讲出有趣的故事来：、向朋友提出这些问题，看看他们会怎么做。这一类的对话，能加深你对成本效益原则的理解和认识。
Translation: Therefore, you should clearly weigh the costs and benefits. Seeing how the cost-benefit principle operates in unusual examples can help you craft engaging narratives: pose these questions to friends and observe their responses. Such discussions will deepen your understanding and grasp of the cost-benefit principle.

Query_Text_cn: 向学生们举出这些说明了一条普遍原理的例子之后，我会立刻给他们出一道习题．要求他们自己应用原理。讲罢闹钟和电脑的例子，我对他们提出了如下问题。
Translation: After presenting examples that illustrate a universal principle to the students, I immediately assign them an exercise, requiring them to apply the principle themselves. After discussing the examples of alarm clocks and computers, I posed the following question to them.

Query_Text_cn: 你马上要出两趟差，但只有一次用机票打折卡的机会。去芝加哥的机票是200美元，打折后能省90美元；去东京的机票2000美元，打折后省100美元。
Translation: You are about to go on two business trips, but you only have one opportunity to use your flight discount card. The flight to Chicago costs $200, and using the discount would save you $90; the flight to Tokyo costs $2000, and using the discount would save you $100.

Query_Text_cn: 这一回，几乎每个人都做出了正确回答，该在去东京时用，这样能省50美元，比去芝加哥省40美元划算。但每个人都回答正确，并不意味着这是个不值得问的问题。还是那句话，如果你的目标是让核心概念成为自身应用知识的一部分，惟一的办法就是反复实践。
Translation: This time, nearly everyone provided the correct answer: using it when traveling to Tokyo saves $50, which is more cost-effective than saving $40 when going to Chicago. However, the fact that everyone answered correctly does not mean it is an unworthy question to ask. As the saying goes, if your goal is to make core concepts an integral part of your applied knowledge, the only way is through repeated practice.

Query_Text_cn: 本书所选的问题，不光是因为有趣，还因为它们活学活用了基础经济学里的重要原理。我希望你会觉得，通过本书学习这些原理，有意思，又轻松。再加上这些问题有趣且答案简短，能为各位读者聊天时提供不少助兴的谈资。
Translation: The questions selected in this book are not only intriguing but also effectively demonstrate key principles of basic economics. I hope you will find that learning these principles through this book is both engaging and effortless. Additionally, these intriguing questions with concise answers can provide readers with plenty of lively conversation material for social gatherings.

Query_Text_cn: 我告诉学生说，他们对问题的回答，应当作为有待进一步推敲脸证的合理假设。它们并不意味着最终定论。我和本·伯南克(BenBeoanke）正打算把比尔·托亚关于高速公路取款机上为什么会有点字盲文的例子收人我们的经济学概论教科书，就有人气急致坏地给我发来一封电子邮件，说这事儿的真正原因是美国《残疾人法案》规定必须这么做。他发给我一个网页链接，证明自己的说法。果不其然．的确有法律规定，所有取款机的键盘上都要有点字盲文，高速公路旁的也不例外。在一些极少见的情况下（比方说，一位育人坐着出租车来到这种取款机旁，而且不想把卡号密码透露给司机），点字盲文就能派上用场。
Translation: I told my students that their answers to questions should be treated as reasonable hypotheses open to further scrutiny and validation. They do not represent final conclusions. Just as Ben Bernanke and I were preparing to include Bill Toya's example of Braille on highway ATMs in our principles of economics textbook, someone sent me an email in a fit of anger claiming the real reason was a requirement under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). They provided a webpage link proving their point. Indeed, federal law mandates that all ATM keyboards must include Braille, including those at highway locations. In extremely rare scenarios—for instance, when a visually impaired person takes a taxi to such an ATM and does not want to disclose their card number or PIN to the driver—the Braille proves useful.

Query_Text_cn: 我给这位来信者回信说，我早就告诉学生，他们的答案不一定正确。但我又劝他再想一想，在什么样的情况下，法令能被人们所采用呢？如果在高速公路取款机的键盘上设计点字盲文成本极高，这种法令能颁布吗？当然不会。事实上，在键盘上增加点字盲文几乎没什么成本。既然它没害处，说不定偶尔还有用处，立法者们才觉得，做出这样的规定有利无害，这样，等到了年底，他们才好说，今年做了些好事。在本例当中，托亚先生的解释似乎比那位愤怒的来信者更有道理一些。不过，在其他案例中，肯定有人能提出更好或者更完善的答案。
Translation: I wrote back to this correspondent saying I had long told my students that their answers were not necessarily correct. Yet I urged him to reconsider: In what circumstances would an ordinance be adopted? If designing Braille on the keypad of a highway ATM were extremely costly, would such a law ever pass? Of course not. In reality, adding Braille to keypads incurs almost no cost. Since it does no harm and might occasionally be useful, lawmakers reason that such a requirement is harmless and beneficial. This allows them to report at year's end that they've done "some good." In this particular case, Mr. Toya's explanation seems more reasonable than the angry correspondent's. However, in other cases, surely someone could propose better or more refined answers.

Query_Text_cn: 所以，读到答案部分，不妨带着挑刺儿的眼光。说不定你掌握着相关的知识，能对其加以补充改进。比方说，有位婚纱店的老板就告诉我，新娘宁愿买而不是租婚纱，还有另一个原因。婚纱大多是半成品，穿之前需要大量的调整．而用于出租的婚纱经不起这么反复折腾。这个看法有一定道理，但它跟詹妮弗·杜尔斯基解释中提出的核心经济学概念并无冲突。
Translation: Therefore, when reading the answer section, it might be worthwhile to adopt a critical eye. You might possess relevant knowledge that could supplement or improve upon it. For instance, a bridal shop owner once told me that brides prefer to buy rather than rent wedding dresses for another reason: most wedding dresses are semi-finished and require significant adjustments before wearing. However, dresses for rent cannot withstand such repeated alterations. This perspective has some validity, but it does not conflict with the core economic concept proposed in Jennifer Durskis' explanation.

Query_Text_cn: 为什么不同的产品有着不同的形状呢？对此问题，若不稍微考虑成本效益原则，再聪明的回答也算不得圆满。比方说，对高速公路旁取款机按键上的点字育文，比尔·托亚的解释即是建立在此原理之上的。厂商留下了高速路取款机上的点字盲文，是因为生产两种不同取款机的成本，远远大于合理的预期收益。
Translation: Why do different products come in different shapes? Without considering the cost-benefit principle, even the cleverest answer cannot be fully satisfactory. For instance, Bill Torrey's explanation regarding the Braille characters on highway-side ATM buttons is grounded in this principle. Manufacturers retain the Braille features on highway ATMs because the cost of producing two distinct models of ATMs (one with Braille and one without) far exceeds the reasonable anticipated benefits.

Query_Text_cn: 一般而言，生产商并没有什么动力给产品增加新功能，除非这种功能所带来的产品价值（也就是收益）大于其成本。几乎所有的实例都表明，产品设计既要包含最符合消费者心意的功能，又要满足卖方保持低价、便于竞争的需求。这也就是说，产品设计必须在两者之间实现平衡。
Translation: Generally speaking, producers have little incentive to add new features to a product unless the product value (i.e., revenue) generated by such a feature exceeds its cost. Nearly all examples demonstrate that product design must incorporate features that best align with consumer preferences while also meeting sellers' need to maintain low prices and enhance competitiveness. In other words, product design must achieve a balance between these two aspects.

Query_Text_cn: 汽车功能的演进，精妙地阐述了这一平衡关系。196l年春天，我买了自己的第一辆车，当时我还是个高中生。最吸引我眼球的．二手汽车广告大致如下："1955年产双门庞蒂克，V8发动机，带收音机、加热器，手动变速，售价375美元，可议价。”当然，如今所有的车都带加热器，可在1955年，它还只是个选配件。当年我住在南佛罗里达州，那儿卖的很多车都没有加热器。可是，在冬天最冷的那几天，有个加热器还是挺舒服的。那时人们的收人比现在低得多，不少买家宁愿放弃一时的享受，以换取更低的价格。要是制造商只卖带加热器的车型，恐泊有不少生意都会给卖不带加热器的便宜车型的对手抢走。
Translation: The evolution of car features artfully illustrates this equilibrium. In the spring of 1961, as a high school student, I purchased my first vehicle. The used car ads that most caught my attention read something like: "1955 two-door Pontiac, V8 engine, includes radio, heater, manual transmission, priced at $375, negotiable." Of course, all cars now come standard with heaters, but in 1955 it was still an optional feature. Back then, many cars sold in South Florida did without heaters. Yet during the coldest days of winter, having a heater proved rather comforting. Incomes were far lower back then, and many buyers opted to forgo such conveniences to secure a lower price. Had manufacturers only offered heater-equipped models, they likely would have lost sales to competitors selling cheaper models without heaters.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，随着收人的提高，愿念冬天忍受严寒来省几个钱的消费者逐渐减少。等不带加热器车型的需求量降到某个限度以下，经销商也就不愿再把它们留在展厅了。当然，要是有人愿意出高价定制，经销商也可以卖给他们不带加热器的乍型。可显而易见的是，没人会出高价故意不要加热器。最终，不带加热器的车型消失了。在1955年，庞蒂克的v8是买家通常的选择，因为如果不买V8，就只能选6缸引擎。V8的好处（也即收益）是它提速比6缸发动机快得多。它的成本，除去售价较高，就是耗油胶也较大，但那些日子油价还很便宜。
Translation: However, as incomes rose, fewer consumers were willing to endure the cold in winter to save a few dollars. Once demand for models without heaters fell below a certain threshold, dealers no longer wanted to keep them on the showroom floor. Of course, dealers could sell non-heated variants to customers willing to custom-order them at a premium. Yet it was obvious that no one would pay a premium to intentionally forgo the heater. Eventually, models without heaters disappeared from the market. In 1955, the Pontiac V8 was the typical buyer's choice because opting out of the V8 meant settling for a 6-cylinder engine. The V8's advantage (its benefit) was its significantly quicker acceleration compared to the 6-cylinder engine. Its cost, aside from the higher purchase price, was greater fuel consumption, though oil prices were still cheap in those days.

Query_Text_cn: 到了20世纪70年代，阿拉伯人搞起了石油禁运。l973年年中，1加仑。汽油才卖38美分，一年以后就涨到了52美分。1979年第二次油危机爆发，1980年油价涨到了1.19美元。由于油价暴涨，v8再也通不过成本效益测试了，于是不少消费者决定放弃它优越的提速性，所以，这种发动机差不多全都消失了。6缸发动机还算常见，可70年代以前关国很少见的4缸发动机，迅速走人市场。
Translation: By the 1970s, Arabs imposed an oil embargo. In mid-1973, a gallon of gasoline cost just 38 cents, rising to 52 cents within a year. The second oil crisis erupted in 1979, pushing prices to $1.19 by 1980. Due to soaring oil prices, the V8 failed cost-benefit analyses, leading consumers to abandon its superior acceleration performance. Consequently, such engines virtually disappeared. While 6-cylinder engines remained common, 4-cylinder engines - rare in the U.S. before the 1970s - quickly entered the market.

Query_Text_cn: 然而，到了20世纪80年代初，从绝对价格来看，油价保持平稳，与其他商品的价格相比，甚至还稍有下跌。到1999年，1加仑汽油的价格是1.4美元，从购买力来看，比1973年0.38美元的价格还要低（也就是说，1999年1.40美元能买到的商品和服务，比l973年的0.38美元能买到的要少）。这样一来，20世纪90年代发动机规格再度变动，也就不足为奇了。随着近年来油价攀升，20世纪70年代的趋势又重演了。比方说，早在2005年油价突破3美元之前，福特汽车公司就减产了旗下最大的SUV车型Excurosion，该车重达7500磅，10英里就耗油1加仑。而节能的混合动力车大受欢迎，经销商的售价甚至比标价还高。
Translation: However, by the early 1980s, oil prices remained stable in absolute terms and even slightly declined relative to other commodity prices. By 1999, the price of one gallon of gasoline stood at $1.40, which had less purchasing power than the $0.38 price in 1973 (meaning $1.40 in 1999 could buy fewer goods and services than $0.38 in 1973). Thus, the重新调整 of engine specifications in the 1990s came as no surprise. As oil prices rose in recent years, the 1970s trend resurfaced. For instance, even before oil prices surpassed $3 per gallon in 2005, Ford Motor Company reduced production of its largest SUV model, the Excursion, which weighed 7,500 pounds and consumed one gallon per 10 miles. Meanwhile, fuel-efficient hybrid vehicles gained popularity, with dealers selling them for prices higher than the listed ones.

Query_Text_cn: 简而言之，产品设计的功能要符合成本效益原则。该原则认为，当且仅当收益不低于成本，才应采取行动。因此，只有收益（以愿意支付额外费用的消费者数量来衡量）不低于成本（以增加某一功能所能吸引的额外消费者数量来平衡量）的时候，才应当增设某一产品功能。
Translation: In short, the functionality of product design should adhere to the cost-benefit principle. This principle holds that action should be taken if and only if the benefits are no less than the costs. Therefore, a product function should only be added when the benefits (measured by the number of consumers willing to pay extra fees) are no less than the costs (balanced by the number of additional consumers attracted through the addition of that function).

Query_Text_cn: 这一原则同样休现在汽车变速箱的演变当中。我那辆1955年产的庞蒂克，采用的是当时最标准的3档变速箱。现在我开的车，早就用上了6档变速箱。但在1955年，制造商制造6档变速箱并非难事。
Translation: This principle is also reflected in the evolution of automotive transmissions. My 1955 Pontiac features the standard 3-speed transmission of its era. The car I drive now has long since adopted a 6-speed transmission. However, manufacturing a 6-speed transmission was not technically difficult for automakers as early as 1955.

Query_Text_cn: 制造商同样必须权衡产品增益与消费者买账的意愿。从成本方面来看，变速箱每多一个前进档，制造成本亦相应增加，前进档越多，整车售价自然越高。消费者愿意出高价吗？从收益方面来看，前进档能带来更好的加速性，而且更省油。所以，答案取决于有多少消费者愿意为了这些优点买单。
Translation: Manufacturers must also balance product gains against consumers' willingness to pay. Cost-wise, each additional forward speed in a transmission increases manufacturing expenses, leading to higher vehicle prices as the number of forward gears grows. Will consumers pay this extra cost? In terms of benefits, more forward speeds deliver better acceleration performance and improved fuel efficiency. Thus, the answer hinges on how many buyers will actually pay for these advantages.

Query_Text_cn: 汽车变速箱至少应该有两个，甚至三个前进档，才称得上是实用：所以从产品设计的角度来看，我那辆1955年产庞蒂克的3档变速箱，显然只达到了最低限度。因为如今的经济比1955年更繁荣，所以，我们愿意为了提高加速性支付更多的钱。又因为更多前进档省下的油钱，比以前多了很多，所以它们的魅力也就更大了。这些变化合在一起，解释了3档变速箱的消失。
Translation: A car transmission should have at least two, or even three forward gears to be considered practical. Thus, from a product design perspective, the 3-speed transmission in my 1955 Pontiac model only meets the bare minimum requirement. Today's economy is far more prosperous than it was in 1955, so we are willing to pay more for enhanced acceleration performance. Additionally, transmissions with more forward gears now yield significantly greater fuel savings compared to earlier times, making them increasingly appealing. These combined factors account for the disappearance of the 3-speed transmission.

Query_Text_cn: 本章讨论的例子将说明，不仅汽车设计的演变受制于成本效益原则，其他各种产品和服务都可套用它来进行解释。头三个例子阐明了这样一个道理：如果某项功能的确有用，可用得着它的时候很少，那这项功能添加到产品身上的可能性就不大。
Translation: The examples discussed in this chapter will illustrate that the evolution of car design, like that of various other products and services, is constrained by the cost-benefit principle and can be explained through its application. The first three examples demonstrate the principle that if a function is indeed useful but is needed only rarely, the likelihood of incorporating it into a product is low.

Query_Text_cn: 要回答这个问题，经济学家必然会对比相关成本与效益。不管是在冷冻室还是在冷藏室，安一盏打开门就会自动亮的灯，成本差不多都是一样的。这也就是经济学家所谓的“固定成本”，在这里指的是，它不随你开关冰箱门次数的多寡而发生变化。从收益方面来看，柜子里有一盏灯，你找东西更方便。由于大多数人打开冷藏拒的次数，比打开冷冻柜的次数要多得多．显然，在冷藏拒安装一盏灯的好处更大。所以，既然加装一盏灯的成本相同，那么，根据成本效益原则，在冷藏柜安灯就比在冷冻柜安灯更划算。
Translation: To answer this question, economists would inevitably compare the relevant costs and benefits. Whether in a freezer compartment or a refrigerator compartment, installing a light that turns on when the door is opened incurs roughly the same cost. This is what economists refer to as a "fixed cost," meaning it does not vary with the frequency of opening the refrigerator door. In terms of benefits, having a light inside the compartment makes it easier to locate items. Since people typically open the refrigerator compartment far more often than the freezer compartment, the advantages of installing a light are clearly greater in the refrigerator. Therefore, given that the cost of adding a light is identical, according to the cost-benefit principle, installing it in the refrigerator compartment is more economically rational than in the freezer compartment.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，并不是所有消费者都认为在冷冻柜安装一盏灯不划算。大体上，若从什么人愿意为这类功能的好处买单来衡量，一个人收入越高，就越有可能愿意为附加的功能买单。所以，成本效益原则告诉我们，为了享受冷冻拒有灯所带来的便利性，收入超高的消费者可能越愿意多花钱。果然如此。高档冰箱生产商sub一Zero生产的Pro48冰箱，不仅在冷冻柜安了灯，甚至连每一层单独的冰格里都安了灯。这种冰箱的售价是多少？14450美元。所以说，Suh一Zero的枷48冰箱，乃是证明成末效益原则的又一例外。
Translation: Of course, not all consumers consider installing a light in a freezer compartment to be a poor cost-benefit trade-off. Broadly speaking, when measured by who is willing to pay for the advantages of such features, a person with higher income is more likely to be willing to spend extra on additional functionalities. Thus, the cost-benefit principle indicates that consumers with extremely high income might be the most willing to pay extra for the convenience of having lights in a freezer. Indeed this is the case. High-end refrigerator manufacturer Sub-Zero’s Pro48 model not only installs lights in the freezer compartment but even adds lights in each individual ice cube tray compartment. What is the price of this refrigerator? At $14,450. Therefore, the Sub-Zero Pro48 refrigerator stands as another exception that defies the cost-benefit principle.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，美国电力系统提供的家用电是110伏，还有不少国家为220伏。笔记本电脑的电源线内里变压器，使得电脑可以在两种标准下正常运行。反之，电视和电冰箱则只能在一种标准下运转。要想在法国用美国冰箱，你必须要单独买一个变压器，把法国220伏的电源转换成110伏。同样，在美国用韩国电视，也只能单独买一个变压器，把美国110伏的电源转换成220伏的。为什么这些家用电器不能像笔记本电脑一样到处通用呢？传送220伏的电比110伏要稍微便宜一些，同时也稍微危险一点。到底采用哪套输电系统，大多数国家都曾进行过相当广泛的论证，而一旦做出决策，国家就会向选中的系统投入大黄资金。因此，指望各国改用统一的供电标准，在近期内是不现实的：．所以，带着电器跨国旅行的人，需要找些办法来保证这些电器能在不同的供电标准下使用。
Translation: The majority of household appliances cannot function universally across different voltage standards like laptop power adapters because their internal circuits and components are specifically designed to operate at either 110V or 220V. Laptops include built-in transformers within their power cords to safely convert and regulate the input voltage (either 110V or 220V) to the lower, stable voltage required by the device. However, high-power appliances such as televisions and refrigerators lack this capability due to several reasons:1. **Design Limitations**: These appliances often require direct connection to a specific voltage for optimal efficiency and safety. Their motors, compressors, and internal components are engineered to function precisely within the voltage range of their intended country, making modifications or built-in voltage conversion impractical.2. **Cost and Complexity**: Integrating a voltage conversion system into large appliances would significantly increase their cost and size. Transformers required for high-power devices are bulky and expensive, unlike the compact adapters used for low-power electronics.3. **Safety Risks**: Operating an appliance outside its rated voltage can damage internal components, reduce lifespan, or even pose fire hazards. For example, refrigerators depend on precise motor speeds and heating elements that are calibrated for specific voltages.4. **Historical Standards**: Most nations invested heavily in constructing power grids aligned with either 110V or 220V standards during infrastructure development. Changing these systems nationwide is economically unfeasible and logistically challenging.5. **Global Incompatibility**: Manufacturers prioritize efficiency and cost-effectiveness by optimizing appliances for the voltage standard of their target market. Retrofitting existing appliances with voltage conversion would require redesigning entire systems, which is not commercially viable.As a result, travelers must use external transformers or voltage converters to safely adapt these appliances to foreign electrical standards. The differences in voltage requirements remain a major obstacle to universal appliance compatibility.

Query_Text_cn: 给所有电器内里变压器，无疑能满足这一需求，但这么做会增加电器的制造成本。绝大多数的冰箱、洗衣机、电视以及其他电器，恐怕不会有出国旅行的机会，所以，给它们加装内置变压器的顺外支出，也就没什么道理。
Translation: Fitting built-in transformers in all electrical appliances would undoubtedly meet this requirement, but doing so would increase manufacturing costs. Most refrigerators, washing machines, televisions, and other appliances are unlikely to be exported, so incurring additional expenses for installing built-in transformers would make little sense.

Query_Text_cn: 笔记本电脑却是个例外，尤其是在它刚诞生那段时间。当时购买笔记本电脑的人，大多是雷要带着它们国内外到处出差的商务人士。衬这些人来说，在国际航班上带着沉重的变压器，实在是一种无法接受的负担。所以，笔记本电脑生产商从一开始就在电脑里内置了变压器。
Translation: Laptops were an exception, especially during their early years. At that time, most laptop buyers were businesspeople who actually needed to travel domestically and internationally with them. For these individuals, carrying heavy transformers on international flights was simply an unbearable burden. Consequently, laptop manufacturers built transformers directly into the computers from the very beginning.

Query_Text_cn: 便利店全年无休，全天营业。
Translation: The convenience store is open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，总会出现这样那样的紧急情况，迫使这类商店至少暂时关门。例如，2007 年英国夏季洪水过后，许多城镇的居民被迫在毫无准备的情况下疏散。毋庸置疑，一家无人值守且未上锁的商店，会成为抢劫者的绝佳目标。
Translation: Of course, various emergencies will inevitably arise, forcing such stores to close at least temporarily. For instance, after the 2007 UK summer floods, many residents in towns were forced to evacuate without any preparation. Undoubtedly, an unattended and unlocked store would become an ideal target for looters.

Query_Text_cn: 这些地方，显然都有理由希望门上有锁。所以，既然大多数工业门卖的时候就带锁，那么，所有的门都按同一模式制造肯定更便宜。这个道理，跟所有取款机（哪怕是安装在高速路边的取款机）的健盘上都带．氛字盲文是一样的。
Translation: These places clearly have good reason to want locks on their doors. So, since most industrial doors are sold with locks already installed, it would certainly be cheaper to manufacture all doors to the same pattern. The logic here is the same as why all ATMs—even those installed along highways—have Braille markings on their keyboards.

Query_Text_cn: 而下面两个例子表明，有时候．产品设计的细节，似乎还与几何学原理有一定的关系。
Translation: The following two examples illustrate that, sometimes, the details of product design seem to be related to principles of geometry.

Query_Text_cn: 几乎所有软性饮料瓶子，不管是玻璃瓶还是铝罐子，都是目柱形的。可牛扔盒子却似乎都是方的。方形容器能比国柱形容器更经济地利用货架空间。那么，为什么软性饮料生产商坚持使用圈柱形容器呢？原因之一可能是，软性饮料大多是直接就着容器喝的，所以，由于圈柱形容器更称手，抵消了它所带来的额外存储成本。而牛扔却不是这样，人们大多不会直接就着盒子喝牛奶。
Translation: Almost all soft drink bottles, whether glass bottles or aluminum cans, are cylindrical. Milk cartons, however, tend to be square. Rectangular containers can utilize shelf space more efficiently than cylindrical ones. So why do soft drink producers persist in using cylindrical containers? One reason might be that soft drinks are often consumed directly from the container, and since cylindrical containers are more ergonomically designed, this convenience compensates for the additional storage costs. However, people typically do not drink milk directly from the carton.

Query_Text_cn: 可就算大多数人直接就着盒子喝牛奶，成本效益原则亦里示，它们不大可能装在圈柱形容器卖。不错，方形容器（不管容器里装什么东西）的确能节约货架空间，但牛扔一例中节约的空间，显然比软性饮料一例中来得更划算。超市里大多数软性饮料都是放在开放式货架上的，这种架子便宜，平常也不存在运营成本。但牛奶则需专门装在冰柜里，冰柜很贵，运营成本也高。所以，冰拒里的存储空间相当宝责，从而提高了用方形容器装牛奶的收益。
Translation: Even though most people drink milk directly from the carton, the cost-benefit principle suggests that it is unlikely to be sold in cylindrical containers. Square containers (regardless of their contents) indeed save shelf space, but the space saved in the case of milk is clearly more cost-effective than in the case of soft drinks. Most soft drinks in supermarkets are stored on open shelving, which is inexpensive and incurs minimal operational costs. However, milk must be kept in refrigerated cabinets, which are costly and have high operational expenses. Consequently, storage space in refrigerated units is particularly valuable, thereby increasing the benefit of using square containers for milk.

Query_Text_cn: 铝制易拉雄的任务是装饮料。在全借界大部分地区销售的12盎司①铭制易拉雌，都是阅柱形的，高度（高12厘米）约等于宽度（直径6.5厘米）的两倍。如果把这种易拉罐造得矮一点，胖一点，能少用许多铝材。打个比方吧，高7.8厘米、直径7.6厘米的圆柱铝罐，与现在的标准易拉罐容童相同，但能少用近30％的铝材。
Translation: The primary function of aluminum cans is to hold beverages. Most 12-ounce aluminum cans sold globally are cylindrical, with a height of 12 centimeters approximately twice the width (diameter of 6.5 centimeters). If these cans were made shorter and wider, significantly less aluminum material could be used. For example, a cylindrical aluminum can with a height of 7.8 centimeters and a diameter of 7.6 centimeters would hold the same volume as current standard cans but use nearly 30% less aluminum.

Query_Text_cn: 既然矮一点的雌于造价更低，为什么人们至今仍使用标准易拉罐呢？可能的解释之一是，消费者会受到横竖错觉的误导。所谓横竖错觉，是心理学上一种著名的视错觉。比方说，请看下图中的横条与竖条，哪个更长呢？大部分人都会自信满满地说是竖条长。但你只要量一下就知道，横竖条其实一样长。
Translation: Since shorter cans are cheaper to produce, why do people still use standard aluminum cans today? One possible explanation is that consumers might be misled by the horizontal-vertical illusion, a famous visual illusion in psychology. For example, look at the horizontal and vertical bars below – which one appears longer? Most people confidently claim the vertical bar is longer. But if you measure them, you’ll find both bars are actually the same length.

Query_Text_cn: 由于存在这种错觉，消费者可能不愿意买矮胖易拉雄装的软饮料，觉得它容童小。可这个解释似乎暗示竞争对手放弃了轻松的获利机会。也就是说，如果只有视错觉这一个原因使得消费者不愿意购买矮胖易拉罐，那么竞争时手完全可以提供这种易拉罐，并明确指出这种容器的容童和传统易拉罐完全一样。既然摇胖易拉罐的生产成本更便宜，卖这种易拉罐的饮料厂商就能比传统厂商提供稍低的价格，同时抵补其成本。所以，要是只有视错觉这一个问题，必然会出现可为竞争对手所利用的轻松获利的机会。横竖错觉：看起来似乎是竖条长，实际上却不是。
Translation: The existence of this illusion may lead consumers to avoid purchasing short and squat soda cans, perceiving them as having smaller capacities. However, this explanation implies that competitors have overlooked an easy profit opportunity. Specifically, if visual illusion were the sole reason deterring consumers from buying short cans, competitors could simply offer such cans while explicitly stating their capacity is identical to traditional cans. Since producing squat cans is cheaper, beverage companies using them could undercut traditional rivals' prices while covering costs. Thus, if visual illusion were the only issue, competitors would inevitably exploit this profitable opportunity. Vertical-horizontal illusion: an optical illusion where a vertical line appears longer than an equal-length horizontal one.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一种可能的解释是，购买软性饮料的顾客更中意细长易拉罐的样子。即便他们知道接胖易拉罐的容量与之相同，还足宁愿多出点钱买细长的，道理跟他们愿意多出钱住景色好点的酒店房间一样。
Translation: One possible explanation is that customers who purchase carbonated beverages prefer the appearance of slender cans. Even though they know that wider cans have the same capacity, they are still willing to pay more for the slender ones, similar to how they would pay extra for a hotel room with a better view.

Query_Text_cn: 产品设计功能有时还反映出厂商的深思熟虑：不同的功能对用户行为有着什么样的影响。举个例子，假设有人不想吃超速罚单，他兴许会愿意多花钱买一辆带超速瞥示功能的汽车。下面的两个例子说明，制造商对某一设计功能（此功能对产品的使用将产生什么样的影响）的战略决策，会反映在产品身上。
Translation: Product design features often reflect manufacturers' strategic considerations: different functions can influence user behavior in specific ways. For instance, someone wishing to avoid speeding tickets might be willing to pay extra for a car equipped with a speed alert feature. The following examples demonstrate that manufacturers' strategic decisions regarding a particular design feature—specifically, how that feature will impact product usage—are reflected in the product itself.

Query_Text_cn: 租车开最叫人灰心丧气的一个经验是，把车照往常开自家汽牟那样停在油泵前，却发现油箱位叉在车身另一侧，油枪够不着。其实，汽车制造商只需要把加油孔统一设在汽车某一侧，就能解决这个难题。
Translation: One of the most frustrating experiences when renting a car is parking it in front of a gas pump as you would with your own vehicle, only to realize that the fuel filler door is on the opposite side, making it impossible to access the gas nozzle. In fact, if car manufacturers were to standardize the placement of the fuel filler door on one side of the vehicle, this problem could easily be resolved.

Query_Text_cn: 在美国和其他车辆方右行驶的国家，过街时右转比左转容易。所以，大多数司机会到能右转进站的加油站加油。假设油箱总设在汽车的司机一侧，那么，为了加油，驾驶员必须将车停在油泵的右侧。这样一来，在交通高峰期，所有向右的油泵会挤满车，而大多数朝左的油泵却没人用。所以，不同车型的加油孔设在不同侧面，意味着有些车能从左边加油。于是司机们扰不用排队等着加油了。这种好处（收益），显然比给租来的车加油时偶然停错了方向所带来的成本大得多。在有些情况下，产品设计不仅要符合产品可能的使用方式，产品希望向用户表达什么样的信息，也会对它有形响。‘下面两个例子说明，采用某一种形式所传达的信息更容易为人们所吸收，或是其造价更为低廉。
Translation: In countries with right-hand traffic, such as the United States, right turns are easier than left turns when crossing streets. Consequently, most drivers prefer gas stations accessible via right turns. Assuming fuel tanks are always positioned on the driver's side, vehicles must park to the right of fuel pumps for refueling. During peak hours, this results in crowded right-side pumps while left-side pumps remain underutilized. Therefore, varying the placement of fuel filler necks across vehicle types—allowing some to refuel from the left—eliminates unnecessary queuing. The benefits of this design clearly outweigh the occasional inconvenience of misaligning rented cars with pumps. Additionally, product design must not only align with intended usage but also consider the information it conveys. The following examples demonstrate how certain forms are either more readily absorbed by users or cost-efficient to implement.

Query_Text_cn: 从曼哈顿帝国大厦楼顶俯视34一号大街，你或许会好奇，为什么街上70％的车都是明黄色的桥车。除去极少的几辆莲花牌或者兰博基尼跑车，这些黄色桥车基本上全是出租车，多为福特产的维多利亚皇冠牌。可在纽约北部不远的一座小型大学城伊萨卡，出租车没一辆是黄色的，而且几乎清一色都是迷你货车。
Translation: Looking down from the top of the Empire State Building in Manhattan at 34th Street, one might wonder why 70% of the vehicles below are bright yellow taxis. Aside from a few rare Lotus or Lamborghini sports cars, these yellow cabs are almost exclusively taxis, predominantly Ford Victoria Crown models. However, in the small university town of Ithaca just north of New York City, none of the taxis are yellow, and they are almost entirely minivans.

Query_Text_cn: 我们于上午10时左右到达马拉维的一个小村庄——Nthandire这个村庄距离马拉维首都利隆圭一个小时的车程。我们经过污浊的街道，穿过那些妇女和儿童组成的人群。这些妇女和儿童光着脚，拿着水罐、木柴以及其他杂物。上午10时左右的空气是闷热的。在这个南非内陆国家里，该地区以种植玉米为生，家家户户在这片无情的土地上竭力维持生计。今年比往年更加艰难，因为雨水稀少可能是由于厄尔尼诺洋流的影响。不管是什么原因造成的，在我们经过的土地里，庄稼都枯萎了。
Translation: We arrived at around 10 a.m. in Nthandire, a small village in Malawi. This village lies an hour's drive from Lilongwe, the capital of Malawi. We traversed gritty streets and passed through crowds of women and children. These women and children walked barefoot, carrying water pots, firewood, and other miscellaneous items. The air at around 10 a.m. was stifling. In this landlocked southern African nation, the region sustains itself through maize cultivation, with households struggling to sustain livelihoods on this unforgiving land. This year has been particularly arduous, as sparse rainfall likely due to the El Niño current has left crops withered across the fields we passed.

Query_Text_cn: 如果村子里有体力充沛的男子能够在房顶和农田建立一些小型蓄水设施，以收集前几个月降落的雨水，那么我们就不会看到那个上午如此凄惨的景象。但是当我们到达这个小镇的时候，我们没有发现任何年轻力壮的男人。事实上，是老年妇女和几十个孩子在欢迎我们，我们没有看到任何处于工作年龄的青年男女。于是我们便问，“工人去哪了？去地里干活了吗?”负责为我们引路的志愿者悲伤地摇着头说不，他们几乎全都死了。这个村庄完全被艾滋病摧毁了，几年来艾滋病一直在马拉维的各个地区肆虐。这个村子里只剩下5个20—40年龄段的男人，这个上午他们也不在村里，因为全部去参加前一天死于艾滋病的一个村民的葬礼。
Translation: If the villagers had had able-bodied young men who could build small water-harvesting facilities on rooftops and farmlands to collect the rainwater that had fallen months earlier, then we would not have witnessed such a grim scene that morning. However, upon arriving at the village, we found no young men of working age. In reality, elderly women and dozens of children were the ones greeting us, and there were no young people of marriageable or working age visible. So we asked, "Where have the workers gone? Are they out in the fields?" The volunteer guiding us shook their head sorrowfully: "No, almost all of them are dead." The village had been entirely devastated by AIDS—a disease rampant across Malawi over the years. Only five men remained in the 20-40 age bracket, and even they were absent that morning, as they had all gone to attend the funeral of a villager who died from AIDS the day before.

Query_Text_cn: 近几年死亡一直笼罩着。我们所遇到的祖母充当她们孙儿的监护人一这些孩子已经成为孤儿。每一个妇女都有一个悲惨的故事：自己的儿女如何死去，留给她们照顾5—10个——有时甚至是15个——孙儿的沉重负担。在大多数发达国家，这个年龄段的妇女已经卸下一生的操劳、颐养天年。现在她们不能停下来，甚至没有片刻的休息，因为这个村庄的祖母以及无数和她们境遇相似的人知道，如果放松一刻的话，这些孩了就将死去。
Translation: In recent years, death has loomed over. Grandmothers in our community now act as guardians for their grandchildren—children who have become orphans. Each woman has a tragic story: how their children died, leaving them with the heavy burden of caring for 5 to 10—and sometimes even 15—grandchildren. In most developed countries, women of this age would have retired from a lifetime of labor to enjoy their golden years. Now they cannot pause, not even for a moment's rest, because these grandmothers of the village—and countless others in similar circumstances—know that if they relax for a moment, these children will perish.

Query_Text_cn: 生存下去的机会很渺茫，不知什么时候生命就完全停止了。如照片一（见彩页）所示，我们遇到一个妇女，在她的土屋前面，有15个已经成为孤儿的孙儿。当她开始向我们诉说她的境况时，她首先指向土屋旁边的土地——地里的庄稼已经枯死了。她的这一小块地大约有半公顷左右，面积太小，即使是在雨水充沛的时候也不足以养活整个家庭。农地的小规模以及干旱的问题被另一个问题扩大了——在这个地区，土壤的养分已经被耗尽，以至于雨水充沛时玉米的产量仅为1吨，而同样情况下1公顷肥沃土壤的玉米产量为3吨。
Translation: The chances of survival are slim, and life might come to an end at any moment. As shown in Photo 1 (see color insert), we encountered a woman whose half-hectare plot of land, barely sufficient to sustain her family even in years of sufficient rainfall, now lay barren. Pointing to the withered crops in the field, she began recounting her plight. The small scale of farmland and drought issues were exacerbated by another critical problem: in this region, soil nutrients have been depleted to such an extent that corn yields reach only 1 ton per hectare during rainy seasons—compared to 3 tons under the same conditions on fertile soil.

Query_Text_cn: 半公顷土地出产的半吨玉米既不能提供充足的养分，也不能提供（如果有的话）少量收入。由于今年的干旱，几乎颗粒无收。她把手伸进围裙里，取出一把半腐烂的、被虫蛀过的黍粒一一这就是作为晚餐的稀粥的原料。这也就是孩子们一天中惟一的一顿饭。
Translation: The half-hectare plot yields half a ton of corn, which provides neither sufficient nutrients nor, if any, meager income. Due to this year's drought, the harvest is near-total failure. She reached into her apron and pulled out a handful of half-rotten, bug-eaten millet grains—this is the raw material for the thin porridge that serves as dinner. It is the only meal the children have all day.

Query_Text_cn: 我向她问起孩子的健康问题。她指着一个大约4岁的孩子说，这个女孩一周之前患上了疟疾。老太太背着她的孙女去大约10公里之外的当地医院看病。当她们到达那里时，当天提供的抗疟疾药品——奎宁——已经用完了。尽管孩子发着高烧，这位祖母和孙女还是被送回家里，被告知要第二天再来。
Translation: I asked her about her children's health condition. She pointed to a girl about four years old and said that the child had contracted malaria a week ago. The elderly woman had carried her granddaughter on her back to the local hospital, which was about 10 kilometers away, for treatment. When they arrived, the antimalarial medication—quinine—supplied for that day had already been exhausted. Despite the child’s high fever, the grandmother and granddaughter were sent back home and told to return the following day.

Query_Text_cn: 这也算是一个小小的奇迹，当她们第二天经过10英里的艰苦跋涉回到医院时，奎宁到货了，孩子得到治疗并活了下来，尽管形势曾经千钧一发。如果疟疾在一两天内不能得到治疗，那么孩子可能转为脑疟疾，接下来就是昏迷和死亡。每年有超过100万（也许有300万之多）的非洲儿童死于疟疾。可怕的灾难发生了，但事实上这个疾病是部分可预防的（通过在马拉维的贫困地区以及非洲大陆的多数地方使用蚊帐和其他环境控制措施），且是完全可以治疗的。对于这样一种疾病每年夺走数百万人的生命，简直没有任何借口可言。
Translation: This is indeed a small miracle. When they returned to the hospital after an arduous ten-mile trek the following day, the quinine had arrived, and the child received treatment and survived—though the situation had been critically precarious. If malaria had not been treated within one or two days, the child could have developed cerebral malaria, followed by coma and death. Over one million (perhaps as many as three million) African children die from malaria each year. While such a tragic disaster unfolds, the disease is in fact partially preventable (through the use of bed nets and environmental control measures in impoverished areas of Malawi and much of the African continent) and fully treatable. There is simply no excuse for a disease that claims millions of lives annually.

Query_Text_cn: 我们访问Nthandire的向导是一个信奉基督教的义工，一位为当地一家非政府组织工作的热情而富有同情心的人。他和同事尽一切可能帮助诸如此类的村庄。这个非政府组织没有任何资金来源，仅靠一些微薄的捐助维持。这个组织在这个村庄(包括这个具体的家庭）最大的成就是提供了一块塑料防雨油布，将其放置在土屋的茅草屋顶之下。这块防雨油布可以使孩子们避免完全暴露于自然环境之下，下雨的时候，雨水不会通过屋顶渗透到孩子身上。每个家庭贡献的几分钱就是这个组织能够集的全部。
Translation: The guide who showed us around Nthandire is a Christian volunteer, a passionate and compassionate individual working for a local non-governmental organization. He and his colleagues go to great lengths to assist villages like this one. This NGO has no funding sources and survives solely on meager donations. Its greatest achievement in this village—including this specific household—has been providing a plastic waterproof tarp, placed beneath the thatched roofs of mud huts. The tarp shields children from full exposure to the elements, preventing rainwater from seeping through the roof onto them during downpours. The few cents contributed by each family constitute the entirety of what the organization can collect.

Query_Text_cn: 随着我们继续向这个村庄行进，其他祖母们也讲述了类似的故事。每个人都失去了儿女，那些活着的仍然为生存而挣扎。这个村里所有的人都是穷人。附近没有诊所，没有安全的水源，地里没有庄稼，以及很显然的一没有援助。我停下来问—个女孩的名字和年龄，她看起来像七八岁的样子，但实际上已经12岁了——营养不良阻碍了她的发育。我问她自己生活中的梦想是什么，她说自己想成为一名老师，并准备努力学习和工作以实现这个理想。我知道如果她在这样一种环境下生活，那么能够活到上中学以及师范学校的可能性是微乎其微的。对这些孩子来说，上学是一件可遇而不可求的事情。无论上学与否，孩子们都染上了疾病。他们的人学率取决于家庭在多大程度上需要他们取水、砍木柴，或者照顾弟妹及堂兄弟姊妹，也取决于他们是否付得起上学所用的物品、校服以及支付交通费用；还取决于步行数公里路程去学校的安全性。
Translation: As we continued our journey into the village, other grandmothers recounted similar stories. Each had lost their children, and those still alive struggled to survive. Everyone in this village is poor. There are no clinics nearby, no safe water sources, no crops in the fields—and, most tellingly, no aid. I paused to ask a girl her name and age; she looked around seven or eight but was actually twelve—malnutrition had stunted her growth. When I asked about her aspirations in life, she replied that she wanted to become a teacher and would study hard to realize this dream. I knew that under such circumstances, her chances of surviving until middle school or teacher training college were negligible. For these children, schooling is a matter of luck. Regardless of whether they attend school or not, the children are plagued by illnesses. Their enrollment rates depend on how much their families need them to fetch water, collect firewood, or care for siblings and cousins, as well as whether they can afford school supplies, uniforms, or transportation costs; safety during the long walks to school also plays a role.

Query_Text_cn: 当天晚些时候，我们离开这个村庄飞往第二个城市Blantyre，我们要访问位于那里的马拉维主医院——伊丽莎白女王中心医院。在那里，我们经受了当天受到的第二次冲击。马拉维政府渴望以这个医院为基地，开始为大约90万感染HIV病毒的国民进行治疗的计划，这些人因为缺乏治疗，濒于死亡边缘。这个医院为那些能够负担抗逆转录酶病毒疗法所需的每天1美元费用的人们建立了一个宽敞的诊所，这种疗法基于马拉维政府与印度基因药物生产商——Cipla达成的协议，这家企业是向贫困国家提供低成本抗逆转录酶病毒药物的先驱。马拉维政府太穷了，不能为所有需要治疗的人负担每天1美元的费用，所以这项医疗计划最初只适用于那些能自己负担治疗费用的少数马拉维人。当我们访问这家医院时，这个治疗点每天只向能够自己负担费用的大约400人提供抗艾滋病药品——一个有90万人患艾滋病的国家中的400人！其他病人实际上不能得到任何抗艾滋病药品。
Translation: Later that day, we departed the village and flew to Blantyre, the second city we visited, to tour Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital, Malawi’s main hospital. There, we experienced the second shock of the day. The Malawi government, eager to launch a treatment plan for approximately 900,000 HIV-positive citizens on the brink of death due to lack of care, had established a spacious clinic at this hospital for those able to afford the $1 daily cost of antiretroviral therapy (ART). This treatment was based on an agreement between the Malawi government and Indian pharmaceutical manufacturer Cipla, a pioneer in supplying low-cost antiretroviral drugs to impoverished nations. Too cash-strapped to cover the $1 daily fee for all those in need, the Malawian government’s healthcare initiative initially only served the minority of Malawians capable of self-funding their treatment. During our visit, this treatment site provided antiretroviral medications to roughly 400 people daily—out of nearly 900,000 HIV-positive individuals in the country! The remaining patients received virtually no antiretroviral treatment.

Query_Text_cn: 我们随一位视察病房与门诊服务的医生弯腰走进一间会议室。他向我们描述了接受抗艾滋病治疗的病人所取得的小小奇迹。药物治疗的成功率几乎为100%。因为马拉维人以前从来没有接受过药物治疗，所以HIV同族没有显示出抗药性。这位医生也谈到他的病人对每天两次的治疗有很强的依赖性，这些病人当然有很高的求生欲望。总之，这位医生对结果是很满意的。
Translation: We followed a doctor inspecting wards and outpatient services as we ducked into a meeting room, its low doorway requiring a bend. He described the small miracles achieved by patients undergoing antiretroviral treatment. The success rate of drug therapy approaches 100%. Since Malawians had never previously received medication, HIV strains showed no drug resistance. The doctor also mentioned his patients' strong adherence to twice-daily treatment regimens, as these individuals naturally possess a high survival instinct. Overall, the doctor expressed satisfaction with the outcomes.

Query_Text_cn: 正当他的总结使我们感到鼓舞的时候，这位医生站了起来，建议我们看一下就在会议室隔壁的病房。事实上，这个所谓“病房”只是一种令人震惊的委婉说法，因为就其实质而言根本不是病房。“病房”里是即将死于艾滋病的马拉维人，病房中没有任何药品。这个房间大约摆放了150张床，容纳了450名艾滋病人，大约三个人挤在一张床上。大多数情况下，两个人头脚相对躺下——分享这张“死亡之床”，另一个人躺在他们身边或者躺在床下面的地上——有时候直接躺在地上，有时候躺在一张木板上，在床下等待着死亡的来临。
Translation: As his encouraging summary was concluding, the doctor stood up and suggested we take a look at the ward adjacent to the meeting room. In truth, this so-called "ward" was merely a shocking euphemism, as it bore no resemblance to an actual medical facility. The room contained approximately 150 beds accommodating 450 AIDS patients from Malawi, with roughly three individuals crammed onto each bed. In most cases, two people lay head-to-foot to share this "bed of death," while the third lay beside them or beneath the bed on the floor—sometimes directly on the ground, other times on a wooden plank, awaiting death beneath the bed.

Query_Text_cn: 房间中呻吟声此起彼伏。这是一个死亡之屋——其中3/4以上的人处于不使用药物治疗的艾滋病晚期阶段。家庭成员坐在床边，抿着干涸的嘴唇，看着他们心爱的人死去。在这个大厅里负责治疗的医生同时也正是掌管这项医疗服务的人。他知道能够做什么。他知道要不是缺乏每天1美元的医疗费用，这些病人能够从死亡之床上站起来。他知道问题不是基础设施、后勤或者药物依赖。他知道问题是这个世界看着每天数百名马拉维人死于贫困而不闻不问，无动于衷。
Translation: The moans rise and fall continuously in the room. This is a house of death, where more than three-quarters of its inhabitants are in the final stages of untreated AIDS. Family members sit by the bedsides, lips parched, watching their loved ones pass away. The doctor responsible for treating patients in this hall is also the one overseeing the healthcare service. He knows what could be done. He knows that for $1 daily in medical costs, these patients could rise from their deathbeds. He knows the issue is not infrastructure, logistics, or drug dependency. He knows the problem is that the world turns a blind eye to hundreds of Malawians dying daily from poverty, indifferent and unmoved.

Query_Text_cn: 在数次访问之后，我逐渐了解了马拉维这个国家。几年之前，马拉维共和国的副总统贾斯廷·马拉维兹找到了我。马拉维兹是一个相当好的人，他形象威严、口才极佳，按照多党制民主的各种标准判断都是一个受欢迎的人物。走向成功的道路是漫长的，因为在这样一个贫困的国家——每人每天收入约为50美分或一年人均180美元，大的疾病、饥荒以及气候灾难持续存在，民主注定是脆弱的。令人吃惊的是，马拉维人做到了（民主），在其承受各种灾难的时候国际社会一直给予了支持。
Translation: After several visits, I gradually gained an understanding of the Republic of Malawi. Several years ago, Vice President Justin Malawizi of the Republic of Malawi approached me. Malawizi is a highly commendable individual with a commanding presence and excellent oratorical skills, embodying the qualities of a popular figure under multiparty democratic standards. The path to success has been arduous, as in such a impoverished nation—where per capita income stands at approximately 50 cents per day or $180 annually, with persistent epidemics, famines, and climate disasters—democracy remains inherently fragile. Remarkably, the Malawians achieved this (democracy), sustained by consistent support from the international community amid their enduring hardships.

Query_Text_cn: 副总统马拉维兹的几位家庭成员死于艾滋病。当我们第一次谈论艾滋病的时候，透过其悲伤的眼神，他向我讲述了其作为国家艾滋病委员会首脑的新责任。他领导一个专家小组设计全国性的防控艾滋病的策略，以应对巨大的挑战。这个小组访问了世界上许多机构——包括哈佛大学、约翰·霍普金斯大学、利物浦大学、伦敦卫生及热带疾病学院，以及世界卫生组织——以讨论如何对付艾滋病。
Translation: Several family members of Vice President Maravitz died of AIDS. When we first discussed the issue, through his grief-stricken eyes, he shared with me his new responsibility as head of the National AIDS Commission. Leading an expert panel, he designed a nationwide strategy to combat AIDS, addressing immense challenges. This panel visited numerous institutions worldwide—including Harvard University, Johns Hopkins University, Liverpool University, the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, and the World Health Organization—to discuss approaches to tackle the disease.

Query_Text_cn: 马拉维政府事实上为治疗其濒于死亡的患病人口曾制定出一项构思严谨的战略，这项战略充分考虑了如下各种挑战——管理一个新的药物配送系统，对病人的咨询和教育，社区扩大服务项目，以及培训医生所需的财务安排。在这个战略的基础上，马拉维向国际社会提出了一系列建议，以在5年内帮助1/3的患艾滋病人口(大约30万人）接受抗艾滋病药物治疗。
Translation: The Malawian government devised a well-conceived strategy to treat its critically ill population nearing death, taking into account various challenges including managing a new drug distribution system, patient counseling and education, expanding community-based services, and financial arrangements for training medical staff. Based on this strategy, Malawi proposed a series of initiatives to the international community aiming to provide antiretroviral treatment to one-third of its HIV-positive population (approximately 300,000 people) within five years.

Query_Text_cn: 但是国际上处理这件事情的过程是残酷的。提供捐助的那些政府（包括美国和欧洲国家）告诉马拉维人要大幅削减其建议的规模，因为第一次提出的建议“太雄心勃勃、太昂贵”。接下来的建议草案把治疗人口削减为5年10万人。捐助国甚至认为这个数目也太高了。经过5天的讨价还价，捐助国迫使马拉维又把预算削减了60%——治疗费用减少为4万人。这项被缩减的计划被提交给防治艾滋病、肺结核以及疟疾的全球基金。令人难以置信的是，负责运营这项基金的捐助者认为有必要再次削减计划。经过长期的努力，马拉维收到的资金只能在5年内拯救2.5万患病人口——这就是国际组织为这个国家的人民所作的死亡担保。
Translation: However, the international process for addressing this matter has been ruthless. Governments providing donations (including the U.S. and European countries) instructed Malawians to drastically reduce the scale of their proposed plan, claiming the initial proposal was "too ambitious and expensive." The subsequent draft proposal cut treatment targets to 100,000 people over five years. Donor nations still deemed this number excessive. After five days of negotiations, donors forced Malawi to further slash its budget by 60%—reducing treatment capacity to 40,000 people. This scaled-back plan was submitted to the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria. Astonishingly, the donor-operated fund deemed another reduction necessary. After prolonged effort, Malawi received funding sufficient to save only 25,000 afflicted people over five years—that is the death sentence international institutions handed down for this nation’s population.

Query_Text_cn: 联合国儿童基金会的卡罗尔·贝拉米正确地把马拉维所面临的困境描述为“完美风暴”——场由气候性疾病、贫困、肆虐流行的艾滋病以及长期受疟疾、血吸虫病和其他疾病所困而混合形成的风暴。面对这个可怕的大旋涡，整个世界迄今为止发出了一些看上去高尚的花言巧语，但是很少采取实际的行动。
Translation: Carol Bellamy of UNICEF accurately described the crisis facing Malawi as a "perfect storm"—a confluence of climate-related diseases, poverty, the AIDS epidemic, and long-standing struggles with malaria, schistosomiasis, and other illnesses. Faced with this terrifying vortex, the world has, to date, offered little more than noble-sounding empty rhetoric but极少采取实际行动。

Query_Text_cn: “完美风暴”数千英里之外是另一块贫困之地。这里的贫困程度要轻一些。尽管仍有巨大的风险和诸多未被满足的需要，这里的人们为生存所作的斗争逐渐获得了成功。斗争发生在孟加拉国一一世界上最为贫困的国家之一。孟加拉国的1.4亿人口生活在两条大河所形成的三角洲冲积平原上，这两条大河是雅鲁藏布江及恒河，它们穿过孟加拉国流向印度洋。
Translation: "The 'perfect storm' thousands of miles away lies another impoverished region. The poverty here is less severe. Despite significant risks and unmet needs, the struggle for survival here has gradually achieved success. This struggle unfolds in Bangladesh—one of the world's poorest countries. Bangladesh's 140 million people reside on the deltaic plains formed by two major rivers, the Brahmaputra and the Ganges, which flow through the country into the Bay of Bengal."

Query_Text_cn: 孟加拉国诞生于1971年反对巴基斯坦的独立战争。在那一年，孟加拉国发生了大饥荒和动乱一一这使得亨利·基辛格时期国务院的一位官员把其称为“国际残障者”。今天的孟加拉国远不是没有希望的。独立以来的人均收入已经翻了近一番，人均寿命由44岁提高到62岁。新生婴儿死亡率（每 1000 名活产婴儿中 1 岁前死亡的数量）从1972年的145降低到2002年的48。盂加拉国的经验告诉我们：甚至是在看起来毫无希望的环境中，如果能够实行正确的战略、选择正确的投资组合，仍然能够取得进步。
Translation: Bangladesh emerged from its independence war against Pakistan in 1971. That year saw severe famine and turmoil in the country—a situation that led a U.S. State Department official during Henry Kissinger's tenure to label it "an international basket case." Today's Bangladesh is far from hopeless. Since independence, per capita income has nearly doubled, and life expectancy has risen from 44 to 62 years. The infant mortality rate (number of deaths per 1,000 live births before age one) dropped from 145 in 1972 to 48 in 2002. Bangladesh's experience demonstrates that even in environments that appear utterly hopeless, progress remains achievable through the right strategic choices and targeted investments.

Query_Text_cn: 孟加拉国仍然没有摆脱极端贫困。尽管已经逃脱了上一代所经受的严重饥荒及疾病的困扰，今天的孟加拉国仍然面临着一些深层次的挑战。在访问马拉维数月之后，我在一个黎明时刻到达了孟加拉国的首都达卡,然后发现了令人惊奇的一幕——数千人从达卡的郊区及最贫困的邻近地区涌出来，步行去上班。经过更仔细的观察，我发现这些工人几乎全部是青年归女，可能在18—25岁之间。这是达卡迅速发展的制衣业的工人，她们每月负责裁剪、缝制并把数百万件成衣发送到美国和欧洲。
Translation: Bangladesh has yet to escape extreme poverty. Although it has escaped the severe famines and diseases that plagued the previous generation, today's Bangladesh still faces deep-seated challenges. Several months after visiting Malawi, I arrived at Dhaka, the capital of Bangladesh, at dawn and witnessed a striking scene - thousands of people emerging from Dhaka's suburbs and the poorest neighboring areas to walk to work. Upon closer observation, I noticed these workers were almost entirely young women, likely between 18 and 25 years old. They are workers in Dhaka's rapidly developing garment industry, responsible for cutting, sewing, and dispatching millions of ready-made garments to the United States and Europe each month.

Query_Text_cn: 在过去这些年，我访问过许多发展中国家的制衣厂。我已经熟悉了那些巨大的车间——在那里数百名青年妇女坐在缝纫机前，男性工人则负责裁剪。在那里织物依次经过生产线的各个环节，当它们到达生产的最后阶段时，则被贴上GAP、Polo、YvesSaintLaurent、Wal-Mart、J.C.Penney等商标。这不是一份迷人的工作，那些制衣厂的女工每天早上要行走2个小时的路程去工作。她们于7点或7点半到达工厂，接下来要在工作岗位上度过12小时。这些工人一刻不停地工作，也许只有非常短暂的午餐时间，甚至去厕所的机会都很少。色迷迷的老板弯下身子看着她们，使其面临性骚扰的威胁。在经过漫长、艰难、乏味的一天劳作之后，这些青年女工要长途跋涉回家，在回家的路上有时会受到暴力袭击。
Translation: Over the past years, I have visited numerous garment factories in developing countries. I have become familiar with those vast workshops where hundreds of young women sit at sewing machines while male workers handle cutting. The fabric progresses through each stage of the production line, and by the final stages, it is labeled with trademarks such as GAP, Polo, Yves Saint Laurent, Wal-Mart, and J.C. Penney. This is not an appealing job. The garment factory workers walk two hours each morning to get to work, arriving at 7 or 7:30 a.m., and then spend 12 hours on the job. These workers labor nonstop, with only a very brief lunch break, and even minimal opportunities to use the restroom. Lecherous bosses lean over them, subjecting them to the threat of sexual harassment. After enduring long, arduous, monotonous days of work, these young female workers must trek home, sometimes facing violent attacks along the way.

Query_Text_cn: 这些血汗工厂的工作是发达国家公众抗议的目标；这些抗议有助于改善工作环境的安全性和质量。然而，富国的抗议者应当抗议本国旨在将诸如孟加拉国的成衣出口排除在外的贸易保护主义，这样他们才能支持在更安全的工作环境下有更多的工作岗位。这些青年女工已经在现代经济中有了一个立足点——与马拉维的村庄相比，这是关键的、重大的一步（对这些妇女而言，也是从她们出生的孟加拉国的乡村迈出的重大一步）。血汗工厂位于走出极端贫困之阶梯的第一阶，它们使基辛格领导的国务院作出的“孟加拉国注定要极端贫困”的预测失灵了。
Translation: These sweatshop jobs have been targets of public protests in developed countries; such protests have contributed to improving workplace safety and conditions. However, protesters in wealthy nations should instead oppose their own country's trade protectionism aimed at excluding exports like Bangladesh's garment industry, thereby supporting more job opportunities in safer working environments. These young female workers have already secured a foothold in the modern economy—a critical and significant step compared to villages in Malawi (and for these women, also a major step out of rural Bangladesh, where they were born). Sweatshops represent the first rung on the ladder out of extreme poverty, rendering obsolete the prediction by the State Department led by Henry Kissinger that Bangladesh was destined for extreme poverty.

Query_Text_cn: 在一次对盂加拉国的访问中，我捡起当地一份英文报纸阅读，发现其中的增刊是对制衣女工的访谈。这些故事是强烈而痛苦、迷人的，令人眼界大开。她们逐个讲述了工作的劳累、劳动权利缺乏保障以及所受到的性侵犯。使人印象深刻且没有料到的是——这些故事的主人公一再强调这些工作是她们梦寐以求的最大机会，获得在制衣厂的工作使她们的生活变得更好了。
Translation: During a visit to Bangladesh, I picked up a local English newspaper and discovered a supplement featuring interviews with garment workers. Their stories were intense, painful, captivating, and eye-opening. They individually recounted the physical toll of their work, the lack of labor rights protection, and the sexual harassment they endured. What was striking and unexpected was that the subjects of these stories repeatedly emphasized that these jobs were their most coveted opportunities - securing work in garment factories had improved their lives.

Query_Text_cn: 几乎所有受访的妇女都生长在农村——那里极端贫困、文盲众多、没有学校，并且在一个集权和家族制的社会中易遭受长期的饥饿和困苦。如果她们（以及1970及1980年代最早出来做工的那些人）呆在农村，那么就必须接受父母安排的包办婚姻，到17岁或18岁的时候就被迫承担起抚养孩子的重担。到城市做工使得这些年轻妇女获得了前所未有的自由和机会。
Translation: Almost all the interviewed women originated from rural areas—where extreme poverty, high rates of illiteracy, lack of schools, and an authoritarian and clan-based social system left them vulnerable to prolonged hunger and hardship. Had they remained in rural regions (alongside those who first went out to work in the 1970s and 1980s), they would have been forced to accept arranged marriages by their parents and take on the burden of raising children by age 17 or 18. Moving to cities for work allowed these young women to attain unprecedented freedom and opportunities.

Query_Text_cn: 这些孟加拉国的妇女讲述了如下故事，即她们如何从微薄的工资中积累一小部分、管理自己的收入、拥有自己的住房，选择何时、与何人约会及结婚，选择在合适的时候要孩子，并用储蓄改善生活条件——尤其是回到学校提高识字率和工作技能。尽管生活是艰辛的，但这使她们获得了更大的经济机会——这在过去一代的农村居民中是无法想像的。
Translation: These Bangladeshi women narrated the following stories: how they set aside a small portion of their meager wages, managed their earnings, owned their own housing, chose when and whom to date and marry, decided when to have children, and used their savings to improve living conditions—particularly by returning to school to enhance literacy and vocational skills. Despite the hardships of life, this granted them greater economic opportunities—an achievement unthinkable for rural residents of the previous generation.

Query_Text_cn: 一些富国的抗议者认为达卡的这些制衣工厂应当或者支付更高的工资，或者被关闭。但是把工资提高到高于工人生产率的水平从而使工厂关闭，只能使这些女工回到悲惨的农村。对这些青年妇女而言，这些工厂提供的不仅是个人自由的机会，还为她们提供了发展阶梯的第一阶——在这个发展阶梯上，她们的劳动技能获得提高，并且自身（以及未来几年内其子女）的收人也在提高。实际上每一个成功发展的贫穷国家都要经历工业化的初级阶段。这些孟加拉妇女与很多年前到纽约制衣区及许多其他地方工作的移民有着相似的经历——这些移民早期在制衣工厂的劳作是通向未来几代城市繁荣道路的第一步。
Translation: Some protesters in wealthy nations argue that these garment factories in Dhaka should either pay higher wages or be shut down. However, raising wages to levels above worker productivity and shutting down factories would only force these female workers back into miserable rural conditions. For these young women, the factories offer not only opportunities for personal freedom but also the first rung of a development ladder—on this ladder, their labor skills are enhanced and their own incomes (and those of their children in coming years) rise. In reality, every successfully developing poor country must go through an initial stage of industrialization. These Bangladeshi women share experiences similar to those of immigrants who worked in New York's garment district and many other places decades ago—their early labor in garment factories marked the first step toward urban prosperity for future generations.

Query_Text_cn: 最近这些年，制衣业不但帮助孟加拉国经济增长每年超过5%，而且它也提高了妇女的自我意识和权利意识——孟加拉国是一个长久以来在生活中歧视妇女的社会。作为整个孟加拉更为一般和剧烈的社会变化过程的一部分，这种变化和其他变化使孟加拉国有机会在未来几年走上长期经济增长的道路。这些妇女所离开的农村也在发生迅速的变化，这部分是由于这些年轻妇女的工作收入汇款以及她们带回的思想和创意，部分是由于她们在农村和城市之间日易增加的旅行和暂时迁徙使得家庭将其经济基础分散在农业和城市制造业及服务业上。
Translation: Over the past decades, the garment industry has not only propelled Bangladesh's annual economic growth to exceed 5% but also enhanced women's self-awareness and awareness of their rights—in a society where women have long faced systemic discrimination in daily life. As part of the broader and profound social transformations occurring across Bangladesh, these changes have positioned the country to embark on a path of long-term economic growth in the coming years. Meanwhile, the rural areas from which these women have departed are undergoing rapid transformation, partly driven by remittances from their urban earnings, the ideas, and innovations they bring back, and partly due to their increasingly frequent travel and temporary migrations between rural and urban areas, which have prompted families to diversify their economic foundations across agriculture and urban manufacturing and service sectors.
