Query_Text_cn: 各国都迫切希望从规模更大的贸易组织中获得好处，但都担心其他国家（特别是中国）的产品会大量涌入。
Translation: All countries urgently seek to benefit from larger trade organizations but are concerned that products from other countries (especially China) will flood the market.

Query_Text_cn: 南非总统祖玛(JacobZuma)与中国国家主席习近平会晤后在南非首都比勒陀利亚对记者说，我们目前力争携手应对的问题是找到实现更加平等的贸易差额的途径。
Translation: South African President Jacob Zuma told reporters in Pretoria, the capital of South Africa, following his meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping that the issue they are currently striving to address through cooperation is finding ways to achieve a more equitable trade balance.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，非洲大陆的发展依靠中国的支持。
Translation: He said that the development of the African continent relies on China's support.

Query_Text_cn: 近平承认中国在非洲寻求自身的商业利益。
Translation: Xi Jinping acknowledged that China seeks its own commercial interests in Africa.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，我们都将对方视为自身发展的一个机遇。
Translation: He stated that both sides regard each other as an opportunity for their respective development.

Query_Text_cn: 一位官员说，根据周二讨论的提案，每个国家可能向金砖开发银行最高出资100亿美元。方案将在周三举行的领导人会议上进行审批。
Translation: According to the proposal discussed on Tuesday, each country may contribute up to $100 billion to the New Development Bank. The plan will be reviewed and approved at the leaders' meeting to be held on Wednesday.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，金砖开发银行将专注于基础设施发展，既包括金砖五国也包括它们希望开展业务的新兴市场。
Translation: He said that the New Development Bank will focus on infrastructure development, including both the BRICS countries and emerging markets where they seek to conduct business.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，经济学家和商业领袖说，500亿美元的启动资金不够该行在非洲或其他地区产生一定的影响。
Translation: However, economists and business leaders say that the initial funding of $50 billion is insufficient for the bank to make a significant impact in Africa or other regions.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，更加具体的决定至少将被推迟到金砖国家2014年巴西峰会的时候才会做出，包括银行的总部将设在哪个国家以及将向哪里投资。
Translation: He stated that more specific decisions would be postponed until at least the 2014 Brazilian Summit of the BRICS nations, including which country will host the bank's headquarters and where investments will be directed.

Query_Text_cn: 一位参与谈判的官员说，各国普遍同意有必要组建这样一个银行，创建一个多边机构从想法到变为现实需要很长时间。
Translation: An official involved in the negotiations said that countries have broadly agreed on the necessity to establish such a bank, and that creating a multilateral institution takes a long time from concept to reality.

Query_Text_cn: 17岁的达洛西奥(NickD'Aloisio)与父母在伦敦一起生活，这段时间他请了假，没去上学。
Translation: Nick D'Aloisio, a 17-year-old living with his parents in London, is currently on a break and not attending school.

Query_Text_cn: 他会让父母管理自己的钱。
Translation: He will have his parents manage his money.

Query_Text_cn: 这些都是一位刚刚晋身千万富豪的少年所做的决定。
Translation: These are the decisions made by a young man who has recently ascended to the status of a millionaire.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥把自己15岁时开始开发的免费新闻阅读软件卖给了雅虎公司(YahooInc.)。雅虎周一公布了买下Summly的消息，不过没有披露交易价格。
Translation: Nikolas Darozios sold the free news-reading app he began developing at age 15 to Yahoo Inc. The company announced on Monday that it had acquired Summly, but did not disclose the transaction price.

Query_Text_cn: 知情人士说，雅虎为收购这个公司支付了数千万美元。
Translation: Sources said Yahoo paid tens of millions of dollars to acquire the company.

Query_Text_cn: 对于一个仅会给雅虎增添两名员工而且还没有收入的团队来说，这是个不错的价码。
Translation: For a team that would only add two employees to Yahoo and has no revenue, this is a good deal.

Query_Text_cn: 青少年时期创立公司、后来公司获得成功的人有很多，但很少有人会如此迅速地致富。
Translation: Many people founded companies during their teenage years and later saw those companies succeed, but few have managed to accumulate wealth so rapidly.

Query_Text_cn: 吸引雅虎的是Summly可自动将新闻稿件浓缩成概要的核心技术。
Translation: The core technology that attracted Yahoo was Summly's ability to automatically condense news articles into summaries.

Query_Text_cn: 该技术是在硅谷研发机构SRIInternational的帮助下开发出来的，其中包括一种生成摘要的算法。该研发机构有人工智能实验室，并持有这个初创企业的股权。
Translation: The technology was developed with the assistance of the Silicon Valley research institution SRI International, including an algorithm for generating summaries. The institution houses an AI laboratory and holds equity in the startup.

Query_Text_cn: 软件的幕后英雄是达洛西奥，一位从12岁开始自学计算机编程的少年。他以前也开发了几款应用程序，如分析一个人Facebook账户以判断其心情的Facemood，还有一种帮助人们发现新音乐的应用。
Translation: The unsung hero behind the software is Delauro, a teenager who taught himself computer programming from the age of 12. He has previously developed several applications, such as Facemood, an application that analyzes a person's Facebook account to determine their mood, and another app that helps people discover new music.

Query_Text_cn: 2011年，达洛西奥创建了自己的公司，当时叫作Trimit。
Translation: In 2011, Dalossio founded his own company, then known as Trimit.

Query_Text_cn: 在SRI的帮助下，他重新设计了那款软件，使之能自动将新闻浓缩为400字的摘要，并在2012年底将其命名为Summly再次推出。
Translation: With the help of SRI, he redesigned the software to automatically condense news articles into 400-word summaries and re-launched it under the name Summly by late 2012.

Query_Text_cn: 为协助这次软件发布，达洛西奥从在线游戏开发商ZyngaInc.首席执行长平克斯(MarkPincus)以及香港商业巨头李嘉诚(LiKa-shing)持有的某投资公司那里募集到了资金。达洛西奥说，Trimit受到好评后，李嘉诚突然联系了我。
Translation: To assist with this software launch, D'Angelo secured funding from Mark Pincus, Chief Executive Officer of online game developer Zynga Inc., and an investment firm held by Hong Kong business magnate Li Ka-shing. D'Angelo said that after Trimit received positive feedback, Li Ka-shing unexpectedly contacted him.

Query_Text_cn: 此举引来了其它知名投资者，其中包括演员艾什顿?库彻(AshtonKutcher)和斯蒂芬?弗雷(StephenFry)。他们投给达洛西奥提供的资金总额为150万美元。
Translation: This move attracted other prominent investors, including actor Ashton Kutcher and Stephen Fry. The total funds they invested in Dallascio amounted to $1.5 million.

Query_Text_cn: 除在总结内容方面具有很高的效率外，Summly的巧妙设计也吸引了人们的注意。
Translation: Beyond its high efficiency in summarizing content, Summly's clever design has also drawn attention.

Query_Text_cn: 这款色彩鲜艳的软件菜单上有各种不同类型的新闻内容，向侧面划动即可刷新。
Translation: The vividly colored software menu features various types of news content. Simply swipe sideways to refresh.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥成了年少有为的科技界明星，他也成为了众多纸媒文章报道的对象并在电视上露面。
Translation: Dalozio has emerged as a young prodigy in the tech world, becoming the subject of numerous print media articles and making appearances on television.

Query_Text_cn: 他说：过去几个月是一段美妙的旅程，去年11月推出Summly后，我没想到会有这样的事。
Translation: He said, "The past few months have been a wonderful journey. After launching Summly in November last year, I never anticipated such developments."

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥现在与父母和弟弟生活在伦敦西南郊区温布尔登(Wimbledon)附近。他说，自己还会在家住一段时间，会继续从学校King'sCollegeSchool告假，同时为准备最后的大学入学参加一些校外考试。
Translation: D'Allessio currently lives with his parents and younger brother in the vicinity of Wimbledon, a suburb southwest of London. He said he will continue to reside at home for some time, taking a leave of absence from King's College School while preparing for university admissions by participating in external examinations.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，自己打算读人文专业，而不是计算机科学。
Translation: He said that he intended to major in humanities rather than computer science.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥说，他的父母是澳大利亚人，他七岁以前一直生活在澳大利亚，后来才回到英国。他的父亲在英国是摩根士丹利(MorganStanley)大宗商品部门的一名分析师。
Translation: Dallosio said that his parents are Australian, and he lived in Australia until he was seven years old before moving back to the UK. His father works in the commodities division of Morgan Stanley in the UK as an analyst.

Query_Text_cn: 母亲是律师。
Translation: The mother is a lawyer.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，对于从这笔收购中获得的收入，他将和父母共同管理，没有什么特别的计划。
Translation: He stated that regarding the proceeds from the acquisition, he will co-manage them with his parents and there are no specific plans for them.

Query_Text_cn: 他还说，在雅虎待上几年是理所当然的，但是他补充说，我对自己没有时间限制。
Translation: He also said that it was only natural to stay at Yahoo for a few years, but he added that he had no time frame for himself.

Query_Text_cn: 我想要在那里观察学习和努力创新。
Translation: I wish to observe, learn, and strive for innovation there.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥说，去年秋天寻找融资时，多家公司主动与我们接触，洽谈收购交易的可能性。
Translation: Delauro said that last autumn, while seeking financing, several companies reached out to the company proactively to discuss the possibility of acquisition deals.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥之所以被雅虎所吸引，是因为雅虎的规模，而且首席执行长梅耶尔(MarissaMayer)真正地专注于美化移动设备上的内容。
Translation: Dalarxico was attracted to Yahoo because of its scale and the fact that Chief Executive Officer Marissa Mayer was truly focused on enhancing content on mobile devices.

Query_Text_cn: 这笔交易是梅耶尔去年担任雅虎CEO以来的第六宗收购初创公司的交易。
Translation: This transaction marks Mayer's sixth acquisition of a startup since she became Yahoo's CEO last year.

Query_Text_cn: 雅虎说，该公司将关闭Summly应用程序，并把该技术整合于雅虎的其他服务。这款应用程序的下载次数不到100万次。
Translation: Yahoo said it will shut down the Summly app and integrate the technology into its other services. The app had fewer than 1 million downloads.

Query_Text_cn: 雅虎的高级副总裁卡恩(AdamCahan)周一在接受采访时说，达洛西奥是一个杰出的人才，雅虎对Summly压缩新闻报道的算法进行了大量测试。
Translation: Adam Cahan, Executive Vice President of Yahoo, said in an interview on Monday that Dalaoxiao is an outstanding talent and that Yahoo has conducted extensive testing on Summly's algorithm for compressing news articles.

Query_Text_cn: 熟悉这些谈话的人士说，达洛西奥已经与不少硅谷名人见了面，包括苹果负责工业设计的高级副总裁伊夫(JonathanIve)。
Translation: People familiar with the discussions said that D'Arsoio has already met with several prominent figures in Silicon Valley, including Jonathan Ive, Apple's senior vice president of industrial design.

Query_Text_cn: 达洛西奥说，Summly的投资者还包括默多克(RupertMurdoch)的妻子邓文迪(WendiMurdoch)。默多克是《华尔街日报》的母公司新闻集团(NewsCorp.)的首席执行长和董事长。新闻集团已经与这家初创公司签订了协议，以使该公司的内容能够轻易地整合进这款应用程序。
Translation: D’Arcy said that investors in Summly also include Wendi Murdoch, wife of Rupert Murdoch, who is the chief executive officer and chairman of News Corp., the parent company of *The Wall Street Journal*. News Corp. has signed an agreement with the startup to enable easy integration of the company's content into the app.

Query_Text_cn: 梅耶尔说，公司正打算推出能够融入人们日常生活的移动设备的服务。
Translation: Mayer said the company is planning to launch services for mobile devices that can seamlessly integrate into people's daily lives.

Query_Text_cn: 外国公司逐渐意识到，不能再寄希望于通过中国市场来实现收益的增长。
Translation: Foreign companies are gradually realizing that they can no longer pin their hopes on the Chinese market to achieve revenue growth.

Query_Text_cn: 就在企业纷纷发布今年第一季度财报之际，卡特彼勒公司(CaterpillarInc.)和ABBLtd.等大型设备生产商发现，中国对其产品需求的增速开始放缓，而苹果公司(AppleInc.)和星巴克(StarbucksCorp.)等消费类企业则看到其产品需求出现飙升之势。
Translation: When companies were releasing their first-quarter earnings reports, heavy equipment manufacturers like Caterpillar Inc. and ABBLtd. discovered that the growth in demand for their products in China began to slow, while consumer-focused firms such as Apple Inc. and Starbucks Corp. saw their product demand surge dramatically.

Query_Text_cn: 经济学家说，这些不尽相同的信号也许是中国经济增长出现重大变化的初期迹象，中国现在强调以消费支出带动经济增长。
Translation: Economists say that these diverse signals may be early signs of a significant shift in China's economic growth, as the country now emphasizes growth driven by consumption expenditure.

Query_Text_cn: 如果这种势头持续下去，中国经济可能会在未来数年保持稳定增长，尽管增速不会像过去30年那样达到平均每年两位数的水平。
Translation: If this momentum continues, China's economy may maintain stable growth over the coming years, although its growth rate will not reach the average annual double-digit levels seen in the past three decades.

Query_Text_cn: 总部位于美国伊利诺伊州皮奥里亚(Peoria)的建筑和矿业设备制造商卡特彼勒上周发布第一季度财报，其中美国业绩增长喜人。该公司首席执行长奥伯赫尔曼(DougOberhelman)说，美国的增长足以弥补中国和巴西业务的放缓。
Translation: Caterpillar, a construction and mining equipment manufacturer headquartered in Peoria, Illinois, U.S., released its first-quarter financial report last week, which showed robust growth in U.S. performance. Chief Executive Officer Doug Oberhelman said that the growth in the U.S. was sufficient to offset the slowdown in China and Brazil.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士工程公司ABB也是如此。
Translation: Swiss engineering company ABB is no exception.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司首席执行长霍根(JoelHogan)说，中国市场的产品销售出现了一些困难，不过北美市场对其电力设备的需求正不断增长。
Translation: The company's CEO Joel Hogan said that the sales of its products in the Chinese market have encountered some difficulties, however, the demand for its electric power equipment in the North American market is continuously growing.

Query_Text_cn: 淡水河谷公司(ValeSA)和联合技术公司(UnitedTechnologiesCorp.)等企业的财报也显示，今年第一季度中国需求放缓。其中联合技术公司表示，旗下成员奥的斯电梯(OtisElevator)的中国新订单减少了21%。
Translation: The Q1 reports of companies such as Vale SA and United Technologies Corp. also indicated a slowdown in Chinese demand this year. United Technologies said that new orders for its Otis Elevator division in China had declined by 21%.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，苹果财报却显示，包括香港和台湾在内的大中华区销售收入在截至3月31日的第一季度增加了两倍多，达到79亿美元，而这主要归功于像王鸿（音）这样的中国内地消费者。
Translation: Meanwhile, Apple's financial report showed that revenue in the Greater China region, including Hong Kong and Taiwan, more than tripled to $7.9 billion in the first quarter ended March 31, largely thanks to mainland Chinese consumers like Wang Hong (transliterated name).

Query_Text_cn: 今年24岁的推销员王鸿上周五在北京苹果专卖店花了大概人民币5,000元(约合800美元)买了一部最新款智能手机iPhone4S。
Translation: A 24-year-old salesperson named Wang Hong spent approximately 5,000 yuan (around $800) purchasing the latest model smartphone, the iPhone 4S, at the Apple Store in Beijing last Friday.

Query_Text_cn: 这不仅要搭上她一个月工资，还要再添上差不多1,000元。
Translation: This would not only cost her a month's salary but also require adding another approximately 1,000 yuan.

Query_Text_cn: 但王鸿说，为了不让自己落伍，还是要买。这是社会越来越以消费为导向的一个标志。
Translation: But Wang Hong said, "To avoid being left behind, I must still buy." This is a sign that society is becoming increasingly consumer-driven.

Query_Text_cn: 王鸿说：朋友都有iPhone，所以我觉得我也应该有。
Translation: Wang Hong said, "All my friends have iPhones, so I feel I should also have one."

Query_Text_cn: 与过去30年令人咋舌的高增长相比，中国经济目前正在减速。
Translation: Compared to the stunning high growth of the past three decades, China's economy is currently slowing down.

Query_Text_cn: 今年第一季度中国经济增长率为8.1%，这是2009年第一季度以来的最慢增速。
Translation: The economic growth rate in the first quarter of this year was 8.1%, which is the slowest growth rate since the first quarter of 2009.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然中国国内生产总值(GDP)的增长步伐预计将在今年余下时间有所加快，但中国政府高级官员提醒说，并不会力争实现过去那样的增长率。
Translation: Although China's GDP growth momentum is projected to pick up for the remainder of this year, senior Chinese government officials have cautioned that the country will not strive to achieve the high growth rates of the past.

Query_Text_cn: 中国现在似乎是处于经济转型的初期阶段，而转型的目的是增加消费支出，减少对投资、房地产和出口的依赖。
Translation: China now appears to be in the early stages of an economic transition, with the aim of increasing consumer spending and reducing reliance on investment, real estate, and exports.

Query_Text_cn: 依赖中国房地产和基础设施项目的外国公司销售疲弱，而面向中国消费者的企业销售强劲，这表明中国经济正在经历所谓的再平衡。
Translation: Foreign companies reliant on Chinese real estate and infrastructure projects have seen weakened sales, while those targeting Chinese consumers have strong sales, indicating that China's economy is undergoing the so-called rebalancing.

Query_Text_cn: 彼得森国际经济研究所(PetersonInstituteforInternationalEconomics)驻华盛顿特区中国问题专家拉迪(NicholasLardy)说，长期以来西方和中国经济学家都在呼吁实现再平衡，再平衡将使中国更能维持合理的长期增长速度。
Translation: Nicholas Lardy, a China expert at the Peterson Institute for International Economics in Washington, D.C., said that for years, Western and Chinese economists have been calling for rebalancing, which would enable China to sustain a more reasonable long-term growth rate.

Query_Text_cn: 这是因为，相比变幻不定的出口市场或过热的房地产市场，消费支出被认为是一种坚实得多的经济增长基础。
Translation: This is because, compared to the volatile export markets or the overheated real estate market, consumer spending is considered a much sturdier foundation for economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一个迹象是，一季度中国城镇居民可支配收入的增长速度自国际金融危机爆发以来首次超过了GDP的增速，从而提振了消费支出。
Translation: Another indication is that in the first quarter, the growth rate of disposable income for China's urban residents outpaced GDP growth for the first time since the outbreak of the global financial crisis, thereby boosting consumption expenditure.

Query_Text_cn: 但有关再平衡的可靠数据不多，而且消费增长要在维持很长一段时间之后才会成为中国经济的主要推动力。
Translation: However, reliable data on economic rebalancing is scarce, and consumption growth will need to sustain for an extended period before it can become the main driver of China's economy.

Query_Text_cn: 可支配收入很难说一定会稳定增长。
Translation: It is difficult to say whether disposable income will definitely maintain steady growth.

Query_Text_cn: 如果北京旨在放缓房地产和建筑行业的政策实施不当，那么经济可能就会出现硬着陆。
Translation: If Beijing's policies aimed at slowing the real estate and construction sectors are implemented improperly, the economy may experience a hard landing.

Query_Text_cn: 今年3月份，中国城市的新房价格出现两年前北京开始调控以来的首次同比下降。
Translation: In March this year, new home prices in Chinese cities recorded their first year-on-year decline since Beijing implemented regulatory measures two years ago.

Query_Text_cn: 这压制了建筑用大宗商品生产商的销售业绩，比如巴西的铁矿石生产商淡水河谷(Vale)。
Translation: This has suppressed the sales performance of producers of bulk commodities for construction, such as Brazilian iron ore producer Vale (Vale).

Query_Text_cn: 铁矿石是生产钢铁的主要原料。
Translation: Iron ore is the primary raw material for producing steel.

Query_Text_cn: 淡水河谷首席执行长费雷拉(MuriloFerreira)表示该公司在华业绩放缓的趋势将很快结束。
Translation: Vale’s CEO Murilo Ferreira stated that the slowdown in the company’s performance in China will soon come to an end.

Query_Text_cn: 惠誉评级(FitchRatingsService)亚洲信贷分析师皮莱(KalaiPillay)说，中国建筑市场总体上是在放缓。
Translation: KalaiPillay, an Asia credit analyst at FitchRatingsService, said that China's construction market was slowing overall.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，很多从西方进口产品的中国公司在获取信贷方面遇到很大困难，让这种放缓雪上加霜。
Translation: He said that many Chinese companies importing products from the West have encountered significant difficulties in accessing credit, exacerbating this slowdown.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然部分消费型企业报告非必需支出回落，星巴克(Starbucks)的情况却并非如此。
Translation: Although some consumer-facing companies reported a decline in non-essential expenditures, Starbucks is an exception.

Query_Text_cn: 星巴克首席财务长阿尔斯特德(TroyAlstead)说，我们在中国的客流量仍在强劲增长，别人所谈的放缓在我们这里并没有出现。
Translation: Starbucks Chief Financial Officer Troy Alstead said, "Our customer traffic in China remains strong, and the slowdown others have mentioned has not materialized for us."

Query_Text_cn: 总部位于伊利诺伊州格伦维尤(Glenview)的婴幼儿配方奶粉生产商美赞臣(MeadJohnsonNutritionCo.)称在华销量激增，这帮助弥补了美国市场销量放缓的打击。去年年底美国一名食用配方奶粉的儿童死亡，给美赞臣带来不利影响，虽然该公司被认定没有责任，但不良影响仍在。
Translation: Glenview, Illinois-based infant formula producer MeadJohnsonNutritionCo. reported a surge in sales in China, which helped offset the blow from the slowdown in its U.S. sales. The death of a child who consumed the formula in late 2023 in the U.S. had negatively impacted the company, though it was found not liable, the lingering negative impacts persisted.

Query_Text_cn: 客户群年龄大得多的法国巴黎保乐力加集团(PernodRicardSA)则表示，受马爹利(Martell)干邑和苏格兰威士忌销量的推动，它在中国市场增长强劲。
Translation: With a much older customer base, Pernod Ricard SA, the Paris-based French group, said that its strong growth in the Chinese market was driven by sales of Martell cognac and Scotch whisky.

Query_Text_cn: 麦当劳(McDonald'sCorp.)表示它在中国的快餐和甜点的销量在下降。
Translation: McDonald's Corp. said its sales of fast food and desserts in China are declining.

Query_Text_cn: 但这除了与中国人舍不得花钱有关以外，或许也跟西式快餐的市场竞争状况有关。
Translation: However, this might be related not only to the frugality of Chinese consumers but also to the competitive landscape of the Western fast food market.

Query_Text_cn: 在北京，40岁的朱江（音）月薪2万元，在国内算是非常不错的收入。他说知道中国经济在失去动力，但认为自己不会受太大影响。
Translation: In Beijing, Zhu Jiang (a 40-year-old with a monthly salary of 20,000 yuan) earns what is considered a very good income domestically. He acknowledges that China's economy is losing momentum but believes he won't be significantly affected.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，他在一家IT公司上班，产品需求很火。
Translation: He said that he works at an IT company and the product demand is booming.

Query_Text_cn: 他刚给自己买了一台苹果笔记本电脑MacBookAir。
Translation: He has just purchased for himself an Apple MacBook Air.

Query_Text_cn: 如果你是在帮别人理财，而不是在用自己的钱投资，那么你可能更容易持看多市场的态度。
Translation: If you are managing investments for others rather than using your own funds, you may be more inclined to hold a bullish outlook on the market.

Query_Text_cn: 相关报道约70%的富人说，他们的主要投资策略是保本，他们的主要投资目标是获得足够的退休收入安享晚年。
Translation: According to related reports, approximately 70% of the wealthy say their primary investment strategy is capital preservation, and their main investment objective is to secure sufficient retirement income to enjoy a comfortable retirement.

Query_Text_cn: 理财顾问对其客户的投资目标有不同看法。他们说，50%的客户寻求保本，另一半客户希望资产增值。
Translation: Financial advisors have differing views on their clients' investment objectives. They say that 50% of clients aim for capital preservation, while the other half seek asset appreciation.

Query_Text_cn: 理财顾问说，64%的客户希望获得退休收入。
Translation: A financial advisor said that 64% of clients hope to secure retirement income.

Query_Text_cn: 上述信息意味着，理财顾问不像他们的客户那样担忧经济或政治环境。
Translation: The information suggests that financial advisors are not as concerned as their clients about economic conditions or political environments.

Query_Text_cn: 他们也没有意识到他们的客户有多么保守。
Translation: They had also not realized how conservative their clients were.

Query_Text_cn: 在选购较高端的数码相机时，摄影爱好者通常不是选择佳能（Canon）就是选择尼康（Nikon）。
Translation: When selecting a high-end digital camera, photography enthusiasts typically choose either Canon or Nikon.

Query_Text_cn: 但有一批电子产品企业对笨重的专业相机进行了重新打造，生产出造型更优美、价格也更实惠的相机，正在对佳能和尼康的垄断构成威胁。
Translation: There is a group of electronics companies that have reimagined the clunky professional cameras, producing cameras that are more aesthetically designed and affordable, and are now posing a threat to Canon and Nikon's dominance.

Query_Text_cn: BloombergNews尼康1J1无反光镜相机由于傻瓜相机相对比较容易生产、准入门槛低，因此该领域市场竞争非常激烈，松下（PanasonicCorp.）、索尼（SonyCorp.）和奥林巴斯（OlympusCorp.）等相机制造商从这个市场分得一杯羹可谓步履维艰。
Translation: Due to the relatively easy production and low barriers to entry of point-and-shoot cameras, the competition in this market is extremely fierce, and camera manufacturers such as Panasonic Corp., Sony Corp., and Olympus Corp. have struggled to secure a share in this market.

Query_Text_cn: 为了扭转颓势，这些企业正在高端相机市场向尼康和佳能发起市场争夺战。尼康和佳能共占据全球单反相机市场75%左右的份额，专业摄影师和极其热衷摄影的业余发烧友通常选购的都是单反相机。
Translation: To reverse their declining fortunes, these companies are launching a market battle against Nikon and Canon in the high-end camera market. Nikon and Canon together hold approximately 75% of the global DSLR camera market, which is typically chosen by professional photographers and enthusiastic amateur photographers.

Query_Text_cn: 这些发起挑战的企业希望赢得将高端相机功能与紧凑设计集于一身的一款新兴相机的市场份额。
Translation: These challenger enterprises aim to capture the market share of a new type of camera that combines advanced camera features with a compact design.

Query_Text_cn: 但不配备将图像反射到拍摄者眼前的以反光镜为基础的传统取景器，而是对图像进行数字化处理，从而使相机机身更为紧凑。
Translation: But it does not feature a traditional reflex viewfinder that reflects the image to the photographer's eye, instead employing digital processing of the image to enable the camera body to be more compact.

Query_Text_cn: 此类无反光镜的数码相机的售价在300美元至1,700美元之间，而单反相机的售价低则500美元左右、高则数千美元（专业单反）不等，而且这还没有算上镜头的价格。
Translation: The prices of mirrorless digital cameras range from $300 to $1,700, while DSLR cameras start at around $500 and can reach several thousand dollars for professional models. This does not include the cost of lenses.

Query_Text_cn: 在本来就不甚景气、又被来自智能手机的越来越激烈的竞争所损害的数码相机市场，无反光镜相机正在逐渐兴起。
Translation: In the digital camera market, which has been stagnant and further hurt by increasingly intense competition from smartphones, mirrorless cameras are gradually gaining traction.

Query_Text_cn: 据市场研究机构国际数据公司(InternationalDataCorp，简称“IDC”)的数据显示，紧凑相机的出货量在去年有所下降，但无反光镜相机的出货量年比却几乎翻了一番，预计这种新型相机的出货量到2015年还将增加四倍。
Translation: According to data from market research firm International Data Corporation (IDC), the shipment volume of compact cameras declined last year, while that of mirrorless cameras nearly doubled on a year-on-year basis. Shipments of this new type of camera are expected to quadruple by 2015.

Query_Text_cn: 紧凑相机的出货量预计接近1亿3069万部左右。
Translation: The shipment volume of compact cameras is expected to approach approximately 130.69 million units.

Query_Text_cn: IDC数字成像业务研究经理克里斯?舒特(ChrisChute)说，“它给（相机）行业带来了提振，它重新设定了未来高端（摄影）体验的标准。
Translation: Chris Chute, research manager of IDC's Digital Imaging business, said, "It has given the (camera) industry a boost, resetting the standard for future high-end (photography) experiences."

Query_Text_cn: 据行业组织相机与影像产品协会（Camera&ImagingProductsAssociation）的数据显示，新型的无反光镜相机在日本的市场占有率最高，在去年下半年占可更换镜头相机近一半的总出货量。
Translation: According to data from the industry organization Camera & Imaging Products Association (CIPA), mirrorless cameras hold the highest market share in Japan, accounting for nearly half of the total shipments of interchangeable-lens cameras in the second half of last year.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，无反光镜相机在北美和欧洲的市场占有率分别为16.4%和18.7%。
Translation: In addition, the market share of mirrorless cameras in North America and Europe is 16.4% and 18.7%, respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 相机产品的转型在松下公司显而易见。总部位于日本大阪的松下公司已经有94年的历史，于2001年进军数码相机市场。
Translation: The transition in camera products is evident at Panasonic Corporation. Headquartered in Osaka, Japan, the company, with a 94-year history, entered the digital camera market in 2001.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司称，在截至去年12月31日的那一季度，其数码相机的销售额年比下降了28%，部分是因为对傻瓜数码相机的市场需求疲软，但是同属数码相机的无反光镜相机的销售额却上升了67%。
Translation: The company reported that its digital camera sales declined by 28% year-on-year in the quarter ended December 31 last year, partly due to weak demand for point-and-shoot digital cameras. However, sales of mirrorless cameras, also part of the digital camera category, increased by 67%.

Query_Text_cn: 新型的无反光镜相机在日本女性中尤其受欢迎。
Translation: New mirrorless cameras are especially popular among Japanese women.

Query_Text_cn: 日本逐渐增长的女摄影爱好者被人称为“相机女孩”，相机制造商针对她们推出了像“热情粉”和“魅惑棕”这样的不常见的相机颜色。
Translation: Japan's growing number of female photography enthusiasts, referred to as "camera girls," have seen camera manufacturers introduce unconventional colors like "Passion Pink" and "Seductive Brown" targeting this demographic.

Query_Text_cn: 这些厂商还提供各式各样意在吸引女性顾客的相机带和相机包等配件。
Translation: These manufacturers also offer a wide variety of camera straps, bags, and other accessories designed to attract female customers.

Query_Text_cn: 松下在四年前推出了当时市场上第一款无反光镜紧凑相机，该公司称，其吸取了从在美国市场销售Lumix这款相机中学到的教训。
Translation: Four years ago, Panasonic launched the first mirrorless compact camera on the market at the time. The company said it had learned lessons from selling the Lumix camera in the U.S. market.

Query_Text_cn: 松下北美区消费者营销总裁北岛嗣郎(ShiroKitajima)称，一开始公司的处境非常艰难，因为它把“所有人”都作为自己的目标客户。
Translation: Shiro Kitajima, president of Panasonic North America's consumer marketing, said that the company initially faced significant difficulties because it targeted "everyone" as its customer base.

Query_Text_cn: 后来，松下在市场调研中发现女性希望能不用拿着笨重的相机拍出质量较好的照片。
Translation: Later, Panasonic discovered through market research that women hoped to take high-quality photos without having to carry bulky cameras.

Query_Text_cn: 松下通过纸媒广告和在母婴及美容网站上刊登网络广告将目标瞄准女性客户。
Translation: Panasonic targets female customers through print media advertisements and online advertisements on maternal and infant care and beauty websites.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，该公司还专注于在女性经常光顾的商场销售无反光镜相机，而不是在主要顾客为男性的相机或电子产品卖场争夺市场。
Translation: Additionally, the company focuses on selling mirrorless cameras in department stores popular with women rather than competing in camera or electronics stores whose primary customers are men.

Query_Text_cn: 这项策略获得了成功。
Translation: This strategy has achieved success.

Query_Text_cn: 松下称，通常说来75%左右的单反相机购买者为男性，而无反光镜相机近70%的买家为女性。
Translation: Panasonic stated that typically around 75% of DSLR camera buyers are male, while nearly 70% of mirrorless camera buyers are female.

Query_Text_cn: 北岛嗣郎说，“尼康和佳能拥有较长的单反相机生产历史，我们不想和它们同部竞争。
Translation: Nakajima Toshiro said, "Nikon and Canon have a long history of producing DSLR cameras; we do not wish to compete in the same category with them."

Query_Text_cn: 我们力求在自己的地盘上竞争。
Translation: We strive to compete on our home turf.

Query_Text_cn: 去年10月，尼康推出了“尼康1”系列相机，加入了无反光镜相机的市场争夺战。
Translation: Last October, Nikon launched the "Nikon 1" series of cameras, joining the fray in the market for mirrorless cameras.

Query_Text_cn: 迄今为止，佳能是唯一一家未涉足无反光镜相机领域的大型相机制造商。
Translation: To date, Canon is the only major camera manufacturer that has not entered the mirrorless camera sector.

Query_Text_cn: 许多行业观察人士预计该公司将在今年推出此类相机。
Translation: Many industry observers expect the company to launch such cameras this year.

Query_Text_cn: 佳能公司发言人HirotomoFujimori拒绝就相机生产计划置评，但其表示佳能现在就具备发布无反光镜相机的技术能力。
Translation: Canon spokesperson Hirotomo Fujimori declined to comment on camera production plans but noted the company now possesses the technical capability to release a mirrorless camera.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，佳能一直在测试各种制造体型更小巧的相机的方法，无反光镜相机技术也是一个选择。
Translation: He said that Canon has been testing various methods for manufacturing smaller-bodied cameras, and mirrorless camera technology is also an option.

Query_Text_cn: 与厂商扎堆的紧凑相机市场相比，单反相机市场的价格竞争一直没那么激烈，因此此类相机的利润历来比较丰厚。
Translation: Compared to the crowded compact camera market, the price competition in the DSLR camera market has never been as intense, resulting in historically substantial profits for these cameras.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，单反相机还能带动镜头和其他配件的销售。
Translation: Additionally, DSLR cameras can also drive sales of lenses and other accessories.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管无反光镜相机的照片质量可能接近于低端单反相机，但依然无法与高端单反相机相媲美，因为高端单反配有尺寸更大的影像传感器并具备专业摄影师所看重的一些功能。
Translation: Although the photo quality of mirrorless cameras may approach that of entry-level DSLRs, they still cannot compete with high-end DSLRs because the latter are equipped with larger-sized image sensors and have features valued by professional photographers.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，对于大多数业余摄影爱好者而言，无反光镜相机已经足够精密。
Translation: However, for most amateur photographers, mirrorless cameras are already sufficiently precise.

Query_Text_cn: 今年32岁的韦恩?里扎尔（WayneRizal）是芝加哥地区的一名咨询师。两年前，当他的第一个孩子快要出生时，他决定换掉自己的傻瓜相机。
Translation: This year, 32-year-old Wayne Rizal, a consultant in the Chicago area, decided to replace his point-and-shoot camera two years ago when his first child was about to be born.

Query_Text_cn: 他曾考虑入手一部尼康的高端单反相机，但最终还是选择了一款索尼的无反光镜相机。
Translation: He had considered purchasing a high-end DSLR camera from Nikon, but eventually opted for a Sony mirrorless model.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，索尼这款相机的质量与大块头相机的质量相差不多，也能更换镜头，而且它体型更小巧、使用起来也更简便。
Translation: He said that Sony's camera is comparable in quality to bulkier models, supports interchangeable lenses, and is smaller in size and more convenient to use.

Query_Text_cn: 里扎尔说，“有了无反光镜相机，我可以用它实现许多我想要的功能，使用单反相机的话，在使用一些基本功能之前我还得先费不少功夫折腾一番。
Translation: Rizal said, "With a mirrorless camera, I can achieve many of the functions I want, whereas with a DSLR, I have to go through a lot of trouble before I can even use some basic functions."

Query_Text_cn: 欧洲银行大规模的去杠杆化过程仍在继续，但鼓舞人心的信号是，亚洲受到的打击可能没那么严重。
Translation: The massive deleveraging process of European banks continues, but an encouraging signal is that the impact on Asia may be less severe.

Query_Text_cn: 根据国际清算银行(BankofInternationalSettlements)最新公布的数据，欧洲银行对亚洲的敞口在去年第四季度继续缩小。
Translation: According to the latest data from the Bank of International Settlements, European banks' exposure to Asia continued to shrink in the fourth quarter of last year.

Query_Text_cn: 除印度尼西亚之外，亚洲的所有市场都经历了资金外流。欧洲银行对印度尼西亚的敞口季度环比增幅为3%。
Translation: Excluding Indonesia, all Asian markets experienced capital outflows. The quarterly sequential increase in European banks' exposure to Indonesia reached 3%.

Query_Text_cn: 台湾受到的打击最为严重，根据巴克莱集团(BarclaysPLC)的数据，欧洲银行对台湾的敞口第四季度环比降低了27%，同比降低了38%。
Translation: Taiwan was the hardest hit, according to data from Barclays PLC, with European banks' exposure to Taiwan falling by 27% quarter-on-quarter and 38% year-on-year in the fourth quarter.

Query_Text_cn: 巴克莱说，在这次从亚洲撤资的大潮中，法国的银行起了主导作用，其对亚洲的全部敞口在第四季度减少了20%，延续了上个季度的下降趋势。
Translation: Barclays said that in the current wave of divestment from Asia, French banks played a leading role, with their total exposure to Asia decreasing by 20% in the fourth quarter, continuing the downward trend from the previous quarter.

Query_Text_cn: 汇丰银行(HSBC)说，目前欧洲的银行在亚洲实施的去杠杆化操作对该地区构成了挑战。
Translation: HSBC said that the deleveraging operations implemented by European banks in Asia are posing challenges to the region.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，汇丰银行认为亚洲能够通过挖掘美国、日本和当地银行的潜力抵消欧洲银行缩减贷款规模带来的影响，这些银行最近几个月加大了放贷力度。
Translation: HSBC believes that Asia can offset the impact of European banks scaling back lending by tapping into the potential of US, Japanese, and local Asian banks, which have stepped up lending activities in recent months.

Query_Text_cn: 汇丰银行说，这些银行加大放贷力度的做法应该会为亚洲在面对欧洲银行去杠杆化操作的挑战时提供一些灵活性；这一去杠杆化过程可能再持续几年甚至更长时间。
Translation: HSBC said that the efforts by these banks to step up lending should provide some flexibility for Asia in the face of the challenge posed by Europe’s deleveraging operations; this deleveraging process could last another few years or even longer.

Query_Text_cn: 实际上，已有迹象显示从去年第四季度以来亚洲的情况已经有所改善。
Translation: In fact, signs indicate that the situation in Asia has improved since the fourth quarter of last year.

Query_Text_cn: 新加坡星展集团(DBSGroupHoldingsLtd.)香港子公司首席执行长庞华毅(SebastianParedes)在接受《华尔街日报》“并购看台”(DealJournal)栏目采访时说，尽管去年年底香港银行的资金非常紧张，但目前的流动性很充足。
Translation: Sebastian Paredes, Chief Executive Officer of DBS Group Holdings Ltd.'s Hong Kong subsidiary, said in an interview with The Wall Street Journal's "Deal Journal" column that while liquidity in Hong Kong banks was very tight toward the end of last year, the current liquidity is more than sufficient.

Query_Text_cn: 他还指出，尽管欧洲央行注入了大量流动性，欧洲的银行仍在远离银团贷款业务，不过他们正在以定期大额存单和双边贷款的方式回到市场。
Translation: He pointed out that despite the massive liquidity pumped in by the European Central Bank, European banks have been pulling back from syndicated loan businesses. However, they are returning to the market through term CDs and bilateral loans.

Query_Text_cn: 巴克莱还指出，尽管欧洲的银行削减了包括银团融资和项目融资在内的长期贷款，但有证据显示，这些银行正在对贸易融资等更短期融资表现出兴趣。
Translation: Barclays also noted that while European banks have cut long-term loans including syndicated financing and project financing, there is evidence that these banks are showing interest in shorter-term financing such as trade financing.

Query_Text_cn: 油价上涨让阿拉伯国家赚得盆满钵满。如果是以前，这些财富多将投向世界金融市场，然而现在，很大一部分都被花在国内。
Translation: The rise in oil prices has enabled Arab nations to reap substantial windfall profits. Previously, much of this wealth would have been directed toward global financial markets, but now a significant portion is being spent domestically.

Query_Text_cn: 海湾国家正在启动有史以来最大规模的花钱行动。主要为防止去年推翻其他中东国家政府的“阿拉伯之春”在本国上演，它们大手笔投资于各种国内项目，如新建房屋和医院、修缮清真寺、创造就业等等。
Translation: Gulf states are launching the largest-ever spending spree in history, primarily to prevent the Arab Spring—a movement that overthrew governments in other Middle Eastern countries last year—from taking place within their own borders. They are making lavish investments in various domestic projects, such as building new housing and hospitals, renovating mosques, creating jobs, and so on.

Query_Text_cn: 据国际金融研究所(InstituteofInternationalFinance)最近估计，今年海湾地区政府支出预计将达4,886亿美元，较2009年高出35%。
Translation: According to a recent estimate by the Institute of International Finance, Gulf region government spending is projected to reach $488.6 billion this year, 35% higher than in 2009.

Query_Text_cn: 这种对国内项目的重视尚未挤占海湾地区的对外投资，预计该地区国家在境外的净资产仅今年一年就将增加3,000亿美元左右。但对国内的重视，还是造成投资于国际资本市场的石油财富少于不重视国内的情况下可能有的水平。
Translation: This emphasis on domestic projects has not displaced overseas investments, with the net foreign assets of the region’s countries expected to increase by approximately $300 billion this year alone. However, prioritizing domestic initiatives has resulted in less petrodollar wealth being invested in international capital markets compared to what would have been possible under scenarios where domestic priorities were not emphasized.

Query_Text_cn: 新的支出形态也在造成政府预算猛增，并让过去用于扩大石油产能、升级军事装备等目的的资金转而投向社会项目。
Translation: New expenditure patterns are also driving soaring government budgets and diverting funds previously allocated for expanding oil production capacity and upgrading military equipment toward social programs.

Query_Text_cn: 日内瓦组织海湾研究中心(GulfResearchCenter)高级顾问、地区安全问题专家阿拉尼(MustafaAlani)说，阿拉伯之春爆发时，很多国家的政府都发现敌人在内部而不是在外部。
Translation: Mustafa Alani, a senior advisor at the Geneva-based Gulf Research Center and expert on regional security issues, said that when the Arab Spring erupted, many governments discovered their enemies were within rather than outside their borders.

Query_Text_cn: 据美银美林(BankofAmericaMerrillLynch)去年一份报告，阿拉伯之春爆发后，包括沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和科威特在内的海湾国家政府旋即承诺增加开支共计1,570亿美元。
Translation: According to a report by Bank of America Merrill Lynch last year, governments in Gulf states including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Kuwait promptly committed to increasing expenditures by a total of $157 billion following the Arab Spring.

Query_Text_cn: 这大约相当于该地区2011年GDP的13.4%。
Translation: This is approximately equivalent to 13.4% of the region's GDP in 2011.

Query_Text_cn: 为避免出现骚乱，海湾君主国家大规模投资于取悦民众的项目，比如提高政府雇员的工资和奖金，新建住房等。
Translation: To avoid unrest, Gulf monarchies have massively invested in public-pleasing projects, such as raising salaries and bonuses for government employees, constructing new housing, etc.

Query_Text_cn: 使这一切成为可能的是，石油输出国组织(OrganizationofPetroleumExportingCountries，亦称欧佩克)的平均原油价格在过去三年上涨了93%。
Translation: What made this possible was the 93% rise in the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries' (OPEC) average crude oil price over the past three years.

Query_Text_cn: 欧佩克成员国的净石油出口收入去年达到1.03万亿美元，按名义价格计算接近2009年的两倍。美国能源情报署(EnergyInformationAdministration)预计这个数字会继续增加，2012年达到1.17万亿美元，到2013年才会小幅回落。
Translation: The net oil export revenues of OPEC member countries reached $1.03 trillion last year, nearly double the level in 2009 at nominal prices. The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) projects this figure will continue to rise, reaching $1.17 trillion in 2012 before experiencing a slight decline in 2013.

Query_Text_cn: 由于国内支出猛增，海湾地区投资重点向重建区内基础设施转变这一出现了10年的趋势得以加快发展。
Translation: Due to a sharp increase in domestic spending, the decade-long trend of the shift of investment focus in the Gulf region toward rebuilding infrastructure within the zone has accelerated.

Query_Text_cn: 据估计，海湾国家未来15年已规划或已开始的资本投资一共为1.8万亿美元。
Translation: It is estimated that over the next 15 years, the capital investments by Gulf countries that are either planned or already underway will amount to $1.8 trillion.

Query_Text_cn: 研究机构RoubiniGlobalEconomics的经济学家津巴(RachelZiemba)说，阿拉伯之春使之提速，所有国家都加大了支出。
Translation: Rachel Ziemba, an economist at Roubini Global Economics, said the Arab Spring accelerated it, with all countries increasing their spending.

Query_Text_cn: 这种转变在沙特阿拉伯尤其引人注目。沙特是世界最大石油出产国，也是海湾地区人口最多的国家。
Translation: This transformation is particularly striking in Saudi Arabia, which is the world's largest oil producer and the most populous country in the Gulf region.

Query_Text_cn: 在刚刚过去的3月份，沙特国王阿卜杜拉(Abdullah)为遏制他眼中政治和社会秩序所面临的威胁，宣布将投入709亿美元用于住房和医疗，并设定了最低工资标准，还承诺向政府雇员发放奖金。
Translation: In March, King Abdullah of Saudi Arabia announced a $70.9 billion investment in housing and healthcare, set a minimum wage standard, and pledged bonuses for government employees to curb the threats he perceived to political and social order.

Query_Text_cn: 毫无疑问，海湾地区的石油出产国仍在向国际市场投资，同时也在投资一些具有炫耀性的项目，比如，卡塔尔最近通过一项交易购买了蒂芙尼(Tiffany&Co.)5%的股份，但是这些国家投资的资产类型已经发生了转变。
Translation: Gulf oil-producing nations continue to invest in international markets while also funding ostentatious projects, such as Qatar's recent acquisition of a 5% stake in Tiffany & Co. through a deal, but the types of assets these nations are investing in have shifted.

Query_Text_cn: 根据数据追踪机构Dealogic提供的数据，美国在2006到2009年间是沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋和科威特的主权财富基金最大的三个外国投资目标之一，但到了2010年和2011年，由于澳大利亚和西班牙成为海湾国家对外投资的主要兴趣所在，美国滑落到第七位。澳大利亚是中国重要的原材料供应国。
Translation: According to data from the tracking firm Dealogic, the United States was one of the top three foreign investment destinations for the sovereign wealth funds of Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Kuwait between 2006 and 2009. However, by 2010 and 2011, Australia and Spain became the primary focuses of investment for Gulf nations, causing the U.S. to drop to seventh place. Australia is a key supplier of raw materials to China.

Query_Text_cn: 今年到目前为止，迅速增长的巴西市场成为上述三国主权投资基金最大的投资目的地。
Translation: So far this year, the rapidly growing Brazilian market has become the top investment destination for the sovereign wealth funds of the three countries mentioned above.

Query_Text_cn: 津巴说，更多的投资正在涌入新兴市场，尤其是亚洲，不过拉丁美洲是个新的投资热点。
Translation: Jinba said that more investments are flowing into emerging markets, particularly in Asia, but Latin America has become a new hotspot for investment.

Query_Text_cn: 阿布扎比政府拥有的一家开发公司在今年早些时候向巴西的EBX集团投资20亿美元。
Translation: The development company owned by the government of Abu Dhabi invested $2 billion in Brazil's EBX Group earlier this year.

Query_Text_cn: 但是与这个富有的酋长国打交道的银行家说，最近达成交易花费的时间比以往要长。
Translation: However, bankers dealing with this wealthy emirate say that recent deals have taken longer to finalize than before.

Query_Text_cn: 海湾阿拉伯国家其实早就在通过实施一些国内项目朝经济多元化方向转变，上述那些与阿拉伯之春有关的支出则在加速这一转变。这些国内项目包括位于沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋的铝冶炼厂，以及位于阿布扎比的航空复合材料工厂。
Translation: Gulf Arab states have long been pursuing economic diversification through domestic projects, and the spending associated with the Arab Spring has accelerated this shift. These domestic projects include aluminum smelters in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates, as well as an aerospace composites plant in Abu Dhabi.

Query_Text_cn: 阿布扎比政府旗下的穆巴达拉开发公司(MubadalaDevelopmentCo.ofAbuDhabi)拥有通用电气(GeneralElectricCo.)和高级微设备公司(AdvancedMicroDevicesInc.,AMD,又名：超威半导体)等外国公司的大量股权。
Translation: Mubadala Development Company of Abu Dhabi owns significant equity in foreign companies such as General Electric Company and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. (AMD).

Query_Text_cn: 但是该公司还在努力通过这些投资促进国内的就业。
Translation: However, the company is still striving to promote domestic employment through these investments.

Query_Text_cn: 穆巴达拉开发公司的一家子公司三年前曾投资于AMD的半导体制造业务，该公司目前正计划在阿布扎比建一座微芯片工厂，它还启动了针对阿联酋公民的培训和教育项目。
Translation: A subsidiary of Mubadala Development Company invested in AMD's semiconductor manufacturing operations three years ago. The company is currently planning to build a microchip factory in Abu Dhabi and has launched training and education programs for UAE citizens.

Query_Text_cn: 26岁的马迪(AhmedMadi)说，这是让我们这些年轻工程师早点为这种工程做准备的好机会。马迪是来自阿布扎比的工程师，正在德累斯顿的一家半导体制造厂参加一个培训项目。
Translation: AhmedMadi,26,saidthisisagoodopportunityforusyoungengineerstoprepareearlyforsuchprojects.MadiisanengineerfromAbuDhabi,participatinginatrainingprogramatsemiconductormanufacturingplantinDresden.

Query_Text_cn: 沙特政府组建的矿产公司Ma'aden集团2009年与美国铝业巨头美国铝业(AlcoaInc.)建立了伙伴关系，共同在沙特阿拉伯负责一个价值110亿美元的冶炼厂工程。
Translation: Ma'aden Group, the mining company established by the Saudi government, formed a partnership with U.S. aluminum giant Alcoa Inc. in 2009 to jointly oversee a $11 billion aluminum refinery project in Saudi Arabia.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，国内支出的增加已经让政府的预算出现紧张。
Translation: At the same time, the increase in domestic spending has led to budgetary strain for the government.

Query_Text_cn: 沙特阿拉伯去年的支出超过了预算目标，沙特的净出口去年增长了40%。政府支出约为2,200亿美元，相当于该国净石油出口收入的三分之二还多。
Translation: Saudi Arabia's expenditures last year exceeded its budget targets, with net exports increasing by 40%. Government spending reached approximately $220 billion, accounting for more than two-thirds of the country’s net oil export revenues.

Query_Text_cn: 而2008年时，沙特阿拉伯的政府支出还不到该国净石油出口收入的一半。
Translation: In 2008, Saudi Arabia's government spending was less than half of the country's net oil export revenues.

Query_Text_cn: 像沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋这样的海湾国家需要更高的石油价格，以帮助实现预算的平衡。
Translation: Gulf nations such as Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates require higher oil prices to balance their budgets.

Query_Text_cn: 国际金融研究所（InstituteofInternationalFinance)非洲和中东问题专家阿比德(GeorgeAbed)说，沙特阿拉伯需要以约每桶80美元或更高的价格出售原油，而阿联酋需要原油价格在每桶90美元左右，这样才能使其在目前的支出水平上做到预算平衡。
Translation: George Abed, Institute of International Finance (IIF) expert on Africa and the Middle East, said that Saudi Arabia needs to sell crude oil at around $80 per barrel or higher, while the United Arab Emirates requires crude oil prices around $90 per barrel to achieve budget balance at their current spending levels.

Query_Text_cn: 2003年，油价只需达到每桶30美元左右这两个国家就能实现预算平衡。
Translation: In 2003, these two countries could achieve a budget balance when oil prices reached around $30 per barrel.

Query_Text_cn: 由于支出的攀升，国际货币基金组织的分析师去年预测，到2016年时，油价只有达到每桶98美元，沙特阿拉伯才能做到收支平衡。
Translation: Due to the rise in spending, analysts at the International Monetary Fund predicted last year that oil prices would need to reach $98 per barrel by 2016 for Saudi Arabia to break even.

Query_Text_cn: JasonAlden/Bloomberg正如《华尔街日报》周三报道的，位于伦敦的私募股权公司LionCapital正研究将旗下Weetabix业务出售给中国国有公司光明食品（集团）有限公司。
Translation: As reported by The Wall Street Journal on Wednesday, London-based private equity firm Lion Capital is exploring the sale of its Weetabix business to Shanghai Bright Food Group Co., Ltd., a state-owned Chinese company.

Query_Text_cn: 除标志性的椭圆形麦片之外，Weetabix还生产Alpen牛奶什锦早餐和ReadyBrek燕麦片。
Translation: In addition to its iconic oval-shaped cereal, Weetabix also produces Alpen milk-based muesli and ReadyBrek oatmeal.

Query_Text_cn: 去年，光明食品集团从澳大利亚私募股权公司ChampPrivateEquity手中收购了ManassenFoodsAustraliaPtyLtd.75%的股权。
Translation: Last year, Bright Food Group acquired a 75% stake in Manassen Foods Australia Pty Ltd. from Australian private equity firm Champ Private Equity.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司说，希望为这家澳大利亚公司提供一个进入中国市场的直接渠道，同时利用Manassen的网络在澳大利亚销售光明食品集团的产品。
Translation: The company said it aims to provide this Australian firm with direct access to the Chinese market while leveraging Manassen's network to sell Bright Food Group's products in Australia.

Query_Text_cn: 光明食品集团说，希望扩大海外业务，到2015年前使收入从2010年的70亿美元增长一倍，手段之一就是通过收购。
Translation: Bright Food Group said it aims to expand its overseas business and double its revenue from the $7 billion recorded in 2010 by 2015, with one of the strategies being acquisitions.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，该公司在扩大海外业务的过程中屡屡受挫。
Translation: However, the company has repeatedly encountered setbacks in the process of expanding its overseas business.

Query_Text_cn: 2011年3月在竞购法国酸奶生产商Yoplait50%股权的较量中，该公司败给了GeneralMillsInc.。去年还未能成功收购美国维他命零售商GNCHoldingsInc.和英国UnitedBiscuits(Holdings)Ltd.。
Translation: In March 2011, the company lost the bidding competition for a 50% equity stake in French yogurt producer Yoplait to General Mills, Inc. Last year, it also failed to successfully acquire U.S. vitamin retailer GNC Holdings, Inc. and British United Biscuits (Holdings) Ltd.

Query_Text_cn: 光明食品集团董事长王宗南去年在接受道琼斯通讯社采访时说，该公司计划创建一个旗下拥有多个国际品牌的食品集团，在中国市场推销部分品牌，同时将光明食品集团的产品出口到有需求的海外市场。
Translation: Wang Zhongnan, chairman of Bright Food Group, said in an interview with Dow Jones Newswires last year that the company plans to establish a food group with multiple international brands under its umbrella, promoting some of these brands in the Chinese market while exporting Bright Food Group products to overseas markets with demand.

Query_Text_cn: 王宗南还说，该公司的收购战略将专注于澳大利亚，因为该集团希望将业务进一步扩大至葡萄酒、乳制品和糖类。
Translation: Wang Zongnan also said that the company's acquisition strategy will focus on Australia, as the group aims to further expand its business into wine, dairy products, and sugar.

Query_Text_cn: 2003年11月，美国私募股权公司HicksMuseTate&FurstInc.斥资6.42亿英镑（合10.4亿美元）收购了Weetabix。
Translation: In November 2003, U.S. private equity firm Hicks Muse Tate & Furst Inc. acquired Weetabix for £642 million (equivalent to $1.04 billion).

Query_Text_cn: 这家私募股权公司是LionCapital的母公司，2005年1月LionCapital分拆出来。
Translation: The private equity firm is the parent company of LionCapital, which was spun off in January 2005.

Query_Text_cn: 黄金闪闪发光。
Translation: Gold shines.

Query_Text_cn: 当然，黄金已经闪耀了几个世纪；全球经济的兴衰取决于原油价格的涨跌；不断上涨的食品价格甚至威胁到最残暴的独裁统治：大宗商品价格的变动不仅关系到交易员和投资者的收益，也关系到经济中的其它部门。
Translation: Of course, gold has shone for centuries; the rise and fall of the global economy hinges on fluctuations in oil prices; and surging food prices even threaten the most brutal dictatorships: changes in commodity prices concern not only the profits of traders and investors but also other sectors of the economy.

Query_Text_cn: 有几十年的时间，大宗商品价格几乎在以不可阻挡的趋势下跌。
Translation: Over several decades, commodity prices have been declining in an almost unstoppable downward trend.

Query_Text_cn: 但在2000年左右，大宗商品价格开始上涨，这引发了有关“大宗商品价格上涨的超级周期”即将开始的合理预测。所谓“超级周期”是指在相当长的一段时间内，大宗商品价格一反常态，出现长期且大范围的上涨。
Translation: However, around the year 2000, commodity prices began to rise, sparking plausible forecasts of an impending "super-cycle" in commodity price increases. By "super-cycle" is meant a prolonged period during which commodity prices defy historical norms, experiencing sustained and broad-based upward movements over an extended timeframe.

Query_Text_cn: 曾任哥伦比亚财政部长、最近成为世界银行(WorldBank)行长候选人的经济学家奥坎波(JoseAntonioOcampo)和联合国经济学家厄顿(BilgeErten)经过统计分析发现，自1865年以来，史上曾出现过三次“超级周期”，2000年以来大宗商品价格上涨的这轮周期则是第四次。
Translation: Economist Jose Antonio Ocampo, former Colombian Finance Minister and recent candidate for World Bank president, and UN economist Bilge Erten found through statistical analysis that since 1865, there have been three "super cycles" in history. The current cycle of commodity price increases since 2000 is the fourth.

Query_Text_cn: 最近这场全球金融危机打乱了每一个市场，但此后大宗商品价格恢复了之前的涨势。
Translation: The recent global financial crisis disrupted every market, but since then, commodity prices have resumed their previous upward trajectory.

Query_Text_cn: 这进一步支撑了“超级周期论”者的观点和下面这种看法，即大宗商品价格上涨反映了市场担心各国央行大量印钞令通胀在所难免的顾虑。
Translation: This further bolsters the arguments of supercycle theorists and the notion that the rise in commodity prices reflects market concerns over central banks' massive money printing and the resulting unavoidable inflation.

Query_Text_cn: 但近期部分大宗商品价格出现下跌则削弱了“超级周期论”者的观点。
Translation: But the recent decline in prices of some major commodities has weakened the arguments of "super-cycle theorists".

Query_Text_cn: 交易员和投资者关心这一问题的理由显而易见，但对那些严重依赖大宗商品出口或进口的经济体而言，大宗商品价格涨跌也很重要。此外，这还事关全球都出现的通胀压力。
Translation: The reasons why traders and investors care about this issue are obvious, but fluctuations in commodity prices are also significant for economies heavily reliant on exports or imports of commodities. Additionally, this relates to the inflationary pressures emerging globally.

Query_Text_cn: 为了区分短期趋势和长期趋势，国际货币基金组织(InternationalMonetaryFund,简称：IMF)的经济学家最近绘制了自上世纪70年代以来四类大宗商品经通胀因素调整的价格走势图。这四类商品是能源、金属、食品和农业原材料（如木材、棉花、橡胶、羊毛等）。
Translation: To distinguish between short-term and long-term trends, economists at the International Monetary Fund (IMF) have recently mapped the inflation-adjusted price trends of four categories of commodities since the 1970s. These categories include energy, metals, food, and agricultural raw materials such as timber, cotton, rubber, and wool.

Query_Text_cn: 不管你是否相信，IMF的基本结论是：全球经济的脆弱前景意味着大宗商品价格不可能以过去10年那样的速度上涨。
Translation: Whether you believe it or not, the IMF's core conclusion is that the fragile outlook for the global economy implies commodity prices cannot rise at the same pace as in the past decade.

Query_Text_cn: 21世纪头十年确实发生了一些显著变化：此前数十年一直在下跌的大宗商品(能源除外)价格发生了彻底逆转。
Translation: The first decade of the 21st century did witness some significant changes: the prices of commodities (excluding energy), which had been declining for decades prior, underwent a complete reversal.

Query_Text_cn: 对此现象的一致解释是：随着中国、印度等大型经济体突然崛起，这些新兴市场对大宗商品的需求也开始迅速增加。
Translation: The widely accepted explanation for this phenomenon is that with the sudden rise of large economies such as China and India, the demand for commodities in these emerging markets has also begun to grow rapidly.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，世界各地的投资者也认为值得在大宗商品上押下重注。
Translation: At the same time, investors around the globe also deem it worthwhile to place big bets on commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 由于在需求增加之前大宗商品经历了价格下跌的长期过程，这挫伤了市场增加大宗商品生产的投资热情。
Translation: The prolonged decline in commodity prices before the increase in demand has dampened market enthusiasm for investment in expanding commodity production.

Query_Text_cn: 因此市场无法立即增加供给以满足新增的需求，价格因此上升。
Translation: Thus the market cannot immediately increase supply to meet the new demand, causing prices to rise.

Query_Text_cn: 能源价格确实需要另当别论。
Translation: Energy prices indeed deserve separate consideration.

Query_Text_cn: 一方面，与其他大宗商品的价格相比，能源价格由于各种原因更容易波动，比如反复出现的导致石油供应受到干扰的地缘政治风险。
Translation: On the one hand, energy prices tend to be more volatile than those of other commodities due to various factors, such as recurring geopolitical risks that disrupt oil supply.

Query_Text_cn: 另一方面，能源的价格明显在上涨，在过去40年里，增幅达到163%。
Translation: On the other hand, energy prices have been rising noticeably, with an increase of 163% over the past 40 years.

Query_Text_cn: 对于能源价格的特殊性的解释已有共识：石油价格的攀升抑制了经济增长，进而打压了其他大宗商品的价格。
Translation: There is a consensus on the explanation of the specificity of energy prices: the surge in oil prices suppresses economic growth, thereby driving down the prices of other commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 正如IMF的图表所示，金属价格在过去几年经历了大幅上升。
Translation: As shown in the IMF's charts, metal prices have seen significant increases over the past few years.

Query_Text_cn: 这反映了来自工业和投资者的强劲需求，这种需求也许是因为人们对货币和政府失去信心而被放大。
Translation: This reflects strong demand from industry and investors, which may be amplified by a loss of confidence in currency and government.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管如此，金属价格仍然基本保持在1973年的水平，这与能源价格形成了鲜明的对比，能源不太可能像当时那样便宜。
Translation: Despite this, metal prices have largely remained at 1973 levels, contrasting sharply with energy prices, which are unlikely to be as cheap as they were then.

Query_Text_cn: 在过去的几十年里，虽然世界人口不断增长，并且越来越富裕的中国人饮食习惯发生了变化（这一点经常被拿来讨论），食品价格仍然大大降低，甚至在21世纪初经历了上涨之后，食品价格仍然处在较低的水平。目前的食品价格大约是1973年食品价格的一半。
Translation: Over the past few decades, despite the continuous growth of the world population and the changing dietary habits of increasingly affluent Chinese - a factor often discussed - food prices have continued to decline significantly. Even after experiencing a rise in the early 21st century, food prices remain at relatively low levels. Currently, food prices are approximately half of what they were in 1973.

Query_Text_cn: 这种持久的趋势很可能继续保持下去。
Translation: This persistent trend is likely to continue.

Query_Text_cn: 的确，奥坎波和厄顿两人的研究发现，除石油之外，每个超级周期的上升阶段过后，价格都会出现下降，低于上一个10年期结束时的水平。
Translation: Indeed, the research by Ocampo and Erton found that, excluding oil, prices would fall below the levels recorded at the end of the preceding decade following the ascending phase of each super cycle.

Query_Text_cn: 在需求方面，再没有第二个中国或印度会进入全球市场，所以不太可能再次出现需求增长的巨大来源。
Translation: In terms of demand, there will be no second China or India to enter the global market, so it is unlikely that another major source of demand growth will emerge.

Query_Text_cn: 大宗商品资讯机构CPMGroup大宗商品研究大师克里斯蒂安(JeffreyChristian)说，在利率如此之低的背景下，可能会有另一波投资资金涌入大宗商品市场。
Translation: Jeffrey Christian, senior commodity analyst at the research firm CPM Group, said that against the backdrop of such low interest rates, another wave of investment capital may flood into the commodities market.

Query_Text_cn: 在供应方面，预料之中的反应正在上演：对包括铜和天然气在内的大宗商品生产能力的投资将导致供应量上升，同时，人们又有了开发更高效利用这些大宗商品的技术的新动力。
Translation: In terms of supply, the anticipated reaction is unfolding: investment in production capacity for commodities including copper and natural gas will lead to an increase in supply, while there is new impetus to develop technologies for more efficient utilization of these commodities.

Query_Text_cn: 克里斯蒂安说，当前的制约实际上存在于政治和社会层面，他指的是进行更多的矿产开采、能源开发和农业种植所遇到的政治、法律和环境方面的阻碍。
Translation: Christian said that the current constraints actually lie in the political and social dimensions, referring to the political, legal, and environmental hurdles encountered in expanding mining, energy development, and agricultural cultivation.

Query_Text_cn: 结果证明，超级周期可能只是为人们熟悉的供需决定价格理论取了个光鲜的名字而已，也就是说，需求带动的价格上涨引发供应增加，而供应增加又导致价格下降。
Translation: It turns out that the super cycle may simply be a glamorous name for the familiar theory of supply and demand determining prices, which means that demand-driven price increases trigger an increase in supply, which in turn leads to a price decline.

Query_Text_cn: 一家得到知名人士资助的初创企业周二宣布了发射自动化飞船到小行星远距离采矿的计划。这一雄心勃勃的计划旨在开启太空探索的一个全新领域。
Translation: A startup backed by prominent figures announced on Tuesday plans to launch automated spacecraft for distant asteroid mining. This ambitious initiative aims to open a new frontier in space exploration.

Query_Text_cn: 在西雅图航空博物馆(SeattleMuseumofFlight)举行的一个活动上，包括几名美国国家航空航天局(NASA)前任官员在内的一行人为一个名为行星资源公司(PlanetaryResourcesInc.)的小行星采矿企业揭开神秘面纱。
Translation: At an event held at the Seattle Museum of Flight, a group including several former NASA officials unveiled Planetary Resources Inc., an asteroid-mining company, lifting the veil on its operations.

Query_Text_cn: 行星资源公司联合创始人迪曼蒂斯(PeterDiamandis)说，太阳系“充满了资源，我们能将这些资源带给人类”。迪曼蒂斯曾帮助发起了旨在鼓励民间太空飞行的X-Prize大赛。
Translation: Peter Diamandis, co-founder of Planetary Resources, said, "The solar system is filled with resources, and we can bring these resources to humanity." Diamandis helped launch the X Prize competition aimed at encouraging private spaceflight.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司表示，它预计在两年内能将首架飞船送入近地轨道（距地球表面约160到1,600公里的高度），此举将成为发射飞船去勘探和开采小行星矿藏的前奏。
Translation: The company stated that it expects to launch its first spacecraft into near-Earth orbit (at an altitude of approximately 160 to 1,600 kilometers above Earth's surface), a move that will serve as a precursor to missions to explore and mine asteroids.

Query_Text_cn: 行星资源公司说，可能需要10年的时间完成勘探工作（即识别出适合采矿的最佳行星）。该公司成立于三年前，但直到上周才打破神秘。
Translation: Planetary Resources says it may take up to 10 years to complete the exploration work (i.e., identifying the best planets suitable for mining). The company was founded three years ago but only lifted the veil of secrecy last week.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司联合创始人安德森(EricAnderson)拒绝透露这家初创企业已经募集了多少资金。
Translation: The company's co-founder Eric Anderson declined to disclose how much funding the startup had raised.

Query_Text_cn: 但他说那些计划发射的火箭可以顺道将该公司研制的飞船送入太空，从而降低成本。
Translation: But he said that the rockets scheduled for launch could also carry the spacecraft developed by the company into space, thereby reducing costs.

Query_Text_cn: 他又说他相信将一组大约六艘飞船送入太空以研究一颗小行星大约需要2,500万至3,000万美元。
Translation: He also stated that he believed sending a fleet of approximately six spacecraft into space to study an asteroid would cost approximately $25 million to $30 million.

Query_Text_cn: 迪曼蒂斯说，行星资源公司将受益于新一代富裕的、“能够容忍风险的投资者”，其中部分投资者已经在商业太空旅行上投入巨资。
Translation: Diamandis said that Planetary Resources would benefit from a new generation of affluent, "risk-tolerant investors," some of whom have already invested heavily in commercial space travel.

Query_Text_cn: 总部设在西雅图地区的行星资源公司得到了谷歌公司(GoogleInc.)首席执行长(CEO)佩奇(LarryPage)等亿万富豪以及包括电影导演卡梅隆(JamesCameron)在内的行星勘探支持者的资助。
Translation: Planetary Resources, based in the Seattle area, has received funding from billionaires including Google Inc. CEO Larry Page and supporters of planetary exploration such as filmmaker James Cameron.

Query_Text_cn: 这家公司目前拥有20多名员工，但它的最终目标是将员工数量扩充至50到100人之间，这些员工必须“献身”这项事业。
Translation: The company currently employs over 20 staff members, but its ultimate goal is to expand its workforce to between 50 and 100 employees, all of whom must "dedicate themselves to the cause."

Query_Text_cn: 麻省理工学院(MassachusettsInstituteofTechnology)行星科学教授、多部小行星教科书的作者斌泽尔(RichardBinzel)说，他同意这种说法，即小行星的资源最终会被开采，它们还能成为人类前往火星等行星时的中间站。但他说行星资源公司的努力可能超前了几十年。
Translation: Richard Binzel, professor of planetary science at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and author of multiple asteroid textbooks, said he agrees with the notion that asteroid resources will eventually be mined and could serve as waystations for human missions to Mars and other planets. However, he noted that Planetary Resources' efforts may be decades ahead of their time.

Query_Text_cn: 安德森说，我们正在尝试一件非常大胆的事，我们可能会失败；但我认为，进行这样的尝试、推动空间探索向前迈进是值得去做的。
Translation: Anderson said, "We are attempting something very bold; we might fail; but I believe it is worth pursuing such attempts and advancing space exploration."

Query_Text_cn: 迪曼蒂斯说，一颗直径265英尺（约合80米）的普通小行星可能含有价值1,000亿美元的金属，其所含的能源足以驱动任何一架曾在太空中飞行的航天飞机。
Translation: Diamandis said that an ordinary asteroid with a diameter of 265 feet (approximately 80 meters) could contain $100 billion worth of metals and enough energy to power any spacecraft that has ever flown in space.

Query_Text_cn: 包括NASA很多研究员在内的科学家认为，开发小行星的资源对未来的太空探索非常重要，因为小行星可能提供丰富的矿产资源，这些资源可以用来建造太空探索者居住设施的组件。
Translation: Scientists, including many NASA researchers, believe that developing the resources of asteroids is crucial for future space exploration because these celestial bodies may offer abundant mineral resources that can be used to construct components for habitats of space explorers.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一个重要的资源是水：水可以被分解为氧气和氢气，前者可供宇航员呼吸，后者可被用来生产火箭推进剂。
Translation: Another important resource is water: water can be electrolyzed into oxygen and hydrogen, the former supplying astronauts with breathing oxygen while the latter can be used to produce rocket propellant.

Query_Text_cn: 行星资源公司的高管说，在抵达第一颗小行星后，该公司将开发上面的水资源、建立一个燃料补给站，然后开采小行星上的铁和其他金属。
Translation: The executives of Planetary Resources stated that after arriving at the first asteroid, the company will develop the water resources there, establish a fuel depot, and then proceed to mine iron and other metals from the asteroid.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司希望通过建立燃料补给站来降低成本。
Translation: The company seeks to reduce costs by establishing fuel supply stations.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司还希望将铂等一些有价值的材料带回地球，并可能尝试“捕捉”一颗体积较小的小行星，将其带到绕月轨道上，这样就可以在距离地球更近的地方对小行星进行研究。
Translation: The company also aims to bring back valuable materials such as platinum to Earth and may attempt to capture a smaller asteroid, bringing it to a lunar orbit to allow for easier study of the asteroid in a closer proximity to Earth.

Query_Text_cn: 安德森说，行星资源公司拥有资源开发技术，正在与设在地球的未具名矿业公司合作，不久后将在实验室内测试其开采小行星上资源的方法。
Translation: Anderson stated that Planetary Resources, which possesses resource development technology, is collaborating with an unnamed Earth-based mining company and will soon test its method for extracting resources from asteroids in a laboratory.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司总裁莱维茨基(ChrisLewicki)一直在研制名为“Arkyd”的航天器系列，第一个航天器有数英尺长，将在近地轨道上运行并寻找小行星目标。
Translation: The company's president, Chris Lewicki, has been developing a series of spacecraft named "Arkyd," with the first spacecraft several feet in length operating in a standard near-Earth orbit to search for asteroid targets.

Query_Text_cn: 未来的Arkyd航天器将试图抵达小行星，理论上讲，能够对小行星的资源进行开发。
Translation: Future Arkyd spacecraft will attempt to reach asteroids, theoretically capable of developing their resources.

Query_Text_cn: 莱维茨基说，该公司计划向近地小行星派出“蜂群”，即六艘航天器组成的小组。(莱维茨基曾是NASA的一名官员。
Translation: Lewitsky said the company plans to send a "Swarm"—a group of six spacecraft—to near-Earth asteroids. (Lewitsky was formerly an official at NASA.)

Query_Text_cn: 该公司说，自己的计划是受到日本太空总署几年前成功进行的小行星探索计划的鼓励。在日本的计划中，小行星的一小部分被带回了地球。
Translation: The company stated that its plan was inspired by a successful asteroid exploration mission conducted by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) several years ago. In Japan's mission, a sample from the asteroid was brought back to Earth.

Query_Text_cn: NASA正在进行一项类似的计划，定于2016年启动。
Translation: NASA is currently conducting a similar plan, scheduled to launch in 2016.

Query_Text_cn: NASA发言人周二说，行星资源公司的构想非常符合美国的国家太空政策和目标，他还说，我们当然希望能借助私营部门的资源和数据。
Translation: NASA spokesperson said on Tuesday that Planetary Resources' vision aligns well with U.S. national space policy and goals, adding that we certainly hope to leverage resources and data from the private sector.

Query_Text_cn: 由于NASA致力于载人航天计划加上国会的预算削减，NASA的无人航天器太阳系探索计划一直在缩减规模。
Translation: Due to NASA's commitment to crewed spaceflight programs coupled with Congress's budget cuts, NASA's uncrewed spacecraft solar system exploration programs have been scaling back in scale.

Query_Text_cn: 欧洲多个国家太空总署的现有计划也面临预算紧缩的问题。
Translation: The existing programs of the space agencies of multiple European countries are also facing budget constraints.

Query_Text_cn: 随着iPhone和iPad继续热销，苹果公司(AppleInc.)季度利润接近翻番，从而打消了近期市场担心该公司无法继续高歌猛进的情绪。
Translation: As iPhone and iPad continued to sell strongly, Apple Inc.'s quarterly profit nearly doubled, dispelling recent market concerns that the company could not maintain its rapid growth.

Query_Text_cn: 周二盘后交易中，苹果股价上涨40.55美元至600.83美元，涨幅超过7%。之前的11个常规交易日中，因投资者担心iPhone销售可能已经放缓，苹果股价有10个交易日收跌。
Translation: In after-hours trading on Tuesday, Apple's stock price jumped by $40.55 to $600.83, a rise of over 7%. Over the previous 11 regular trading sessions, Apple's stock closed lower in 10 sessions as investors worried that iPhone sales might have slowed.

Query_Text_cn: 他们对苹果股价的预期仍然很高，其中一部分人预计12个月后将接近每股1,000美元。
Translation: Their expectations for Apple's stock price remain high, with some projecting it could approach $1,000 per share within 12 months.

Query_Text_cn: 诞生接近五年之久的iPhone仍然是苹果利润的关键推进器。
Translation: The iPhone, now nearly five years old, remains a key driver of Apple's profits.

Query_Text_cn: 苹果说，上一季度售出iPhone3,510万部，高于上年同期的1,865万部。
Translation: Apple said it sold 35.1 million iPhones in the previous quarter, up from 18.65 million in the same period a year earlier.

Query_Text_cn: 这款手机连同相关产品和服务构成了苹果57.9%的销售额，高于前一季度的52.7%。
Translation: The smartphone, along with related products and services, accounted for 57.9% of Apple's revenue, up from 52.7% in the previous quarter.

Query_Text_cn: 该公司说，最新款iPhone目前在100多个国家、230家无线运营商有售，多于去年3月份90个国家的186家运营商。
Translation: The company said that the latest iPhone model is now available in more than 100 countries and 230 wireless carriers, surpassing the 90 countries and 186 carriers in March last year.

Query_Text_cn: 苹果首席财务长奥本海默(PeterOppenheimer)在电话会议中说，大中华区iPhone销量达到了上年同期的五倍。
Translation: Apple's Chief Financial Officer, Peter Oppenheimer, said in a conference call that iPhone sales in Greater China reached five times the level of the same period last year.

Query_Text_cn: 这些数据释放出了一个鼓舞人心的信号，表明这款风靡一时的产品可能在美国之外取得佳绩，尤其是在智能手机销量增长日新月异的不那么富裕的国家。
Translation: These data signal an encouraging sign, indicating that this hit product could achieve success beyond the United States, especially in less affluent countries where smartphone sales are growing rapidly.

Query_Text_cn: 咨询公司Jefferies&Co.的执行董事米谢克(PeterMisek)说，因为已经达到饱和状态，美国国内智能手机市场的增长速度正在放缓。
Translation: Peter Misek, an executive director at Jefferies & Co., said that the growth rate of the U.S. domestic smartphone market is slowing down because it has reached saturation.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，考虑到奢侈品牌在中国等国家的优势，苹果应该在其他市场做好准备。
Translation: He said that given the advantage of luxury brands in countries like China, Apple should prepare itself for other markets.

Query_Text_cn: 总部位于加州库珀蒂诺(Cupertino)的苹果公司今年头三个月的利润增长了94%，达到116亿美元，营收增长了58.9%，达到392亿美元。
Translation: Apple Inc., headquartered in Cupertino, California, saw its profit increase by 94% to $11.6 billion and revenue rise by 58.9% to $39.2 billion in the first three months of this year.

Query_Text_cn: 根据汤森路透(ThomsonReutersCorp.)的数据，尽管从这些数据来看增速较上一个季度有所放缓，但仍高于分析人士预期的95.2亿美元的利润和368亿美元的营收。
Translation: According to data from Thomson Reuters Corp., although the growth rate slowed compared to the previous quarter, the profit and revenue figures remained above analysts' expectations of $9.52 billion and $36.8 billion respectively.

Query_Text_cn: 上个季度iPad的销售量略低于一些分析人士的预测，但是同比增幅超过150%，达到1,180万部。
Translation: Last quarter, iPad sales were slightly below some analysts' forecasts, but the year-on-year growth surpassed 150%, reaching 11.8 million units.

Query_Text_cn: 苹果在上个季度发布了新版iPad。
Translation: Apple launched the new iPad in the previous quarter.

Query_Text_cn: 奥本海默说，苹果全新iPad的销售速度已经赶上了生产速度；市场需求相当惊人。
Translation: Oppenheimer stated that the sales pace of Apple's new iPad has caught up with its production speed; market demand has been remarkably strong.

Query_Text_cn: 在电话会议中，库克首次公开强烈暗示他将解决在其前任乔布斯(SteveJobs)时代就已经开始的、进展缓慢的诉讼战。他说，我向来讨厌打官司，现在也一样。
Translation: In a teleconference, Cook publicly and strongly hinted for the first time that he would address the protracted litigation battles that began during the tenure of his predecessor Steve Jobs. He said, "I have always abhorred litigation, and I still do."

Query_Text_cn: 在中国，看来有更多消费者正捂紧钱包，减少奢侈品消费。
Translation: In China, it appears that more consumers are tightening their wallets and reducing luxury consumption.

Query_Text_cn: 在中国这一奢侈品行业最重要的增长市场上，古驰(Gucci)母公司PPRSA是最新一家曝出增速大幅放缓的奢侈品集团。
Translation: In China, the most critical growth market for the luxury industry, Gucci's parent company PPRSA is the latest luxury group to report a significant slowdown in growth.

Query_Text_cn: PPR首席财务长迪普莱(Jean-MarcDuplaix)周四在一场电话会议上说，古驰一季度中国销售额取得了较高个位数的增幅。
Translation: Jean-Marc Duplaix, Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of PPR, stated on Thursday during a conference call that Gucci's sales in China achieved a high single-digit percentage increase in the first quarter.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然在某些国家，这样的增速已经值得欢呼雀跃，但对中国这一奢侈品销售多年来保持高速增长的国家而言，情况变得有些严重了。
Translation: While such growth rates would be cause for celebration in some countries, for China—a nation where luxury sales have long sustained high growth—the situation has become concerning.

Query_Text_cn: PPR旗下的所有设计师品牌均陷入低迷，其中包括YvesSaintLaurent、Brioni和BottegaVeneta。
Translation: All of PPR's designer brands are experiencing a downturn, including Yves Saint Laurent, Brioni, and Bottega Veneta.

Query_Text_cn: 就在这一消息发布前，奢侈品行业领导者酩悦轩尼诗路易威登(LVMHMoetHennessyLouisVuittonSA)在中国的销售增速也进入平稳期。
Translation: Just before the release of this news, the leading player in the luxury goods industry, LVMH Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton SA, saw its sales growth in China enter a stable phase.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，爱马仕(HermesInternationalSCA)本周早些时候说，和去年相比，今年其在亚洲的增速有所放缓。这个行业内最贵的一些手袋就出自爱马仕。
Translation: Hermès International SCA said earlier this week that its growth in Asia has slowed compared to last year. The company is known for producing some of the industry's most expensive handbags.

Query_Text_cn: 普莱说：在中国，消费者购买奢侈品的热情有所降低，这也许是因为对经济形势和政治环境的担心所致。我们仍然在等待中国奢侈品消费出现反弹，或许这更有可能在下半年到来。
Translation: Pley stated: "In China, the enthusiasm for purchasing luxury goods has waned, possibly attributable to concerns over the economic outlook and political environment. We are still awaiting a rebound in China's luxury consumption, which may be more likely to materialize in the second half of the year."

Query_Text_cn: 上周，酩悦轩尼诗路易威登将其中国奢侈品销售停滞的原因归咎于经济增速放缓。
Translation: Last week, Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton attributed the stagnation of luxury sales in China to slowing economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 随着中国新一届政府上台，送礼这种行为也遭到打击。在此之前，送礼是提振手表和其它昂贵商品销售的重要因素。
Translation: With the rise of China's new administration, the practice of gift-giving has come under scrutiny. Prior to this, gift-giving had been a key driver in boosting sales of watches and other luxury goods.

Query_Text_cn: 和每个季度在华销售都能够轻松达到两位数增幅的好日子相比（20%、30%，某些奢侈品企业甚至能达到40%的增速），销售额增幅显然是大幅放缓。
Translation: Compared to the good days when sales in China could easily achieve double-digit growth rates each quarter (20%, 30%, and some luxury companies even reached 40% growth), the growth rate of sales has clearly slowed significantly.

Query_Text_cn: 中国市场销售低迷的迹象在去年首次出现，当时对酩悦轩尼诗路易威登等公司而言，美国市场的销售增速要高于中国。
Translation: Signs of a sales slump in the Chinese market first emerged last year, when the sales growth in the US outpaced that in China for companies such as Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton.

Query_Text_cn: PPR说，在剥离了一系列计划被出售或分拆的业务之后，今年一季度其整体销售额上升1%，至23.6亿欧元（约合30.7亿美元）。今年6月PPR将更名为Kering。
Translation: PPR said that after spinning off a series of businesses slated for sale or spin-off, its overall sales in the first quarter of this year rose 1% to €23.6 billion (approximately $30.7 billion). In June this year, PPR will be renamed Kering.

Query_Text_cn: PPR同时拥有彪马(Pu等更为偏向大众市场的品牌。今年一季度这些品牌的销售额出现下滑。
Translation: PPR also owns brands such as Puma that are more oriented toward the mass market. Sales of these brands declined in the first quarter of this year.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，欧洲严峻的财政和经济形势也影响了当地消费者。
Translation: "At the same time, the severe fiscal and economic conditions in Europe also affected local consumers."

Query_Text_cn: 迪普莱说，古驰在欧洲本地已经受到当地消费者和游客购物量下降导致的低迷影响。
Translation: Duple said that Gucci has been affected by the downturn in Europe caused by declining spending among local consumers and tourists.

Query_Text_cn: 他补充说，该公司去年北美业务表现强劲，自己对该公司新一年在北美继续保持强劲增长的能力持谨慎态度。
Translation: He added that the company's North American operations performed strongly last year, but he remains cautious about its ability to maintain strong growth in the region this coming year.

Query_Text_cn: 奢侈品企业希望中国奢侈品销售放缓只是暂时现象，博柏利(BurberryPLC)的经历或许能让它们看到希望。
Translation: Luxury goods companies hope that the slowdown in China's luxury sales is only a temporary phenomenon, and the experience of Burberry PLC may offer them hope.

Query_Text_cn: 在截至今年3月末的六个月内，亚洲是这家大衣制造商表现最强劲的地区。由于中国市场销售强劲，该品牌的销售实现了15%的增幅。而就在六个月前，中国市场销售放缓还曾令该公司发布盈利预警。
Translation: In the six months to March 31 this year, Asia was the strongest performing region for this coat manufacturer. Thanks to robust sales in China, the brand's sales saw a 15% increase. Just six months earlier, slowing sales in China had prompted the company to issue a profit warning.

Query_Text_cn: 对瑞士表业来说，蓬勃增长的日子也许行将结束。
Translation: For the Swiss watch industry, the days of booming growth may be coming to an end.

Query_Text_cn: 去年，瑞士钟表出口额达到破纪录的214.2亿瑞士法郎(合226.5亿美元)，同比增长10.9%，制造商为之欢呼雀跃。
Translation: Last year, Swiss watch exports reached a record-breaking 214.2 billion Swiss francs (equivalent to 226.5 billion US dollars), with a year-on-year increase of 10.9%, which manufacturers celebrated.

Query_Text_cn: 在中国，手表经常被当做礼品送给政府官员。
Translation: In China, watches are often given as gifts to government officials.

Query_Text_cn: 但中国这一增长引擎目前似乎动力不足。
Translation: But China's growth engine currently seems to be lacking momentum.

Query_Text_cn: 由于北京打击腐败和送礼风削弱了需求，今年前三个月瑞士钟表对华出口额大降近26%。中国是瑞士表的全球第三大市场。
Translation: Due to Beijing’s crackdown on corruption and gift-giving, which weakened demand, exports of Swiss watches to China plunged nearly 26% in the first three months of this year. China is Switzerland’s third-largest global market for watches.

Query_Text_cn: 相应地，瑞士表的出口增速放缓至仅略超过2%。
Translation: Accordingly, the export growth rate of Swiss watches slowed to just slightly above 2%.

Query_Text_cn: 该展览是全球规模最大的钟表珠宝展。本届展览于周四开幕，吸引了全球各地的厂商前来开拓新业务，交换对钟表业形势的看法。
Translation: The exhibition is the world's largest watch and jewelry show. This year's event opened on Thursday, attracting manufacturers from around the globe to explore new business opportunities and exchange views on the state of the watch industry.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士制表商百达翡丽(PatekPhilippe)首席执行长斯特恩(ThierryStern)说，一定会在某个地方停下来的。他指出，该行业2012年表现强劲，2011年同比增长19.4%，2010年同比增长22.2%，过去三年的业绩好得惊人。
Translation: Thierry Stern, chief executive of Swiss watchmaker Patek Philippe, said that the industry's growth would eventually come to a halt somewhere. He noted that the sector performed strongly in 2012, with year-on-year growth of 19.4% in 2011 and 22.2% in 2010, making the performance over the past three years remarkably strong.

Query_Text_cn: 那些对零售商做了调查的分析人士表示，该地区零售商目前正在减少瑞士表的库存。
Translation: Analysts who surveyed retailers indicate that retailers in the region are currently reducing inventory of Swiss watches.

Query_Text_cn: 很多已不再补单，从而抑制了对新出口的需求。
Translation: Many are no longer placing replenishment orders, thereby suppressing the demand for new exports.

Query_Text_cn: 开普勒资本市场(KeplerCapitalMarkets)研究钟表业的考克斯(JonCox)说，中国需求疲弱持续的时间可能比原先预计得要长，因为该国对送礼风的打压比最初以为的要长，力度也更大。
Translation: Jon Cox, an analyst at Kepler Capital Markets focusing on the watch industry, said the weakness in Chinese demand could last longer than initially expected because the clampdown on lavish gift-giving in China has lasted longer and been more stringent than initially anticipated.

Query_Text_cn: 出于对中国市场的担忧，考克斯将自己对瑞士表出口的增长预期从7%下调至5%。
Translation: Due to concerns over China's market, Cox revised its growth forecast for Swiss watch exports downward from 7% to 5%.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管如此，一些制表商对有关中国经济增速放缓的担忧却不以为然。他们指出，销售额目前已处于高位，而且其它市场还有很多业务。
Translation: Despite this, some watchmakers dismiss concerns over China's slowing economic growth. They point out that sales are currently at high levels and there is still plenty of business in other markets.

Query_Text_cn: 本周早些时候，拥有卡地亚(Cartier)和万国表(IWC)品牌的历峰集团(CompagnieFianciereRichemontSA)说，预计5月16日发布全年财报时，其净利将实现30%的增长。
Translation: Earlier this week, the Compagnie Fianciere Richemont SA, owner of Cartier and IWC, said it expects to release its full-year financial results on May 16, with net profit projected to grow by 30%.

Query_Text_cn: 分析人士本预计历峰集团的利润增长在26%左右。
Translation: Analysts had projected that Richemont's profit growth would be around 26 percent.

Query_Text_cn: 关注互联网上奢侈品牌的数码奢侈品集团(DigitalLuxuryGroup)说，虽然面向中国市场的钟表出口也许未见增长，但搜索模式表明，中国消费者仍在网上研究瑞士表，很可能是准备出国时购买。
Translation: The Digital Luxury Group (DLG), which tracks luxury brands online, said that while exports of watches to the Chinese market may not have shown growth, search patterns indicate that Chinese consumers continue to research Swiss watches online, likely preparing to purchase them during overseas trips.

Query_Text_cn: 据该公司估计，中国消费者购买奢侈表的行为有一半是在中国境外完成的。
Translation: The company estimates that half of the purchases of luxury watches by Chinese consumers take place outside China.

Query_Text_cn: 路威酩轩集团(LVMHMoetHennessyLouisVuitton)旗下手表品牌宇舶(Hublot)的董事长比弗(Jean-ClaudeBiver)说，没有理由担心，现在只是放缓，不是下滑。
Translation: Jean-Claude Biver, Chairman of LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton's watch brand Hublot, said there is no reason to worry—it is merely a slowdown, not a decline.

Query_Text_cn: 但很多制表商认为，瑞士表业已经见顶，至少在短期内是这样。
Translation: But many watchmakers believe that the Swiss watch industry has peaked, at least in the short term.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞士参展商委员会主席、斯沃琪集团(SwatchGroupAG)旗下品牌天梭(Tissot)首席执行长蒂埃博(FrancoisThiebaud)说，今年出口增长可能会低至3%，这将是2009年经济危机期间出口大跌22%以来的最慢增速。
Translation: Francois Thiebaud, Chairman of the Swiss Exhibitors' Committee and CEO of Tissot, a brand under Swatch Group AG, stated that export growth this year may dip to as low as 3%, marking what he calls the slowest pace since the significant 22% drop experienced during the 2009 economic crisis.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，今年光顾巴黎和伦敦天梭店的中国游客较少，而面对严峻经济形势正在缩减开支的欧洲消费者则不太可能填补中国人留下的缺口。
Translation: He said that Chinese tourists visiting Tissot stores in Paris and London have been fewer this year, and European consumers cutting back on spending amid a severe economic situation are unlikely to fill the gap left by Chinese shoppers.

Query_Text_cn: 斯沃琪旗下品牌浪琴(Longines)总裁霍凯诺(WaltervonKaenel)说，经历多年的快速增长后，瑞士表业可能被宠坏了。
Translation: Chairman Walter von Kaenel of Longines, a brand under the Swatch Group, said that the Swiss watch industry might have been spoiled after years of rapid growth.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，该行业的高增速是不可持续的。
Translation: He said that the high growth rate of the industry is unsustainable.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，我也更谨慎了一点。
Translation: He said he had become a bit more cautious.
