Translation: SNC-Lavalin Group Inc., a Canadian construction company, collaborated with China Metallurgical Group (MCC) on the bridge project. After receiving materials submitted by World Bank investigators, Canadian authorities raided Lavalin's office in suburban Toronto earlier this month.

Query_Text_cn: Lavalin正在配合调查但否认有不当行为。
Translation: Lavalin is cooperating with the investigation but denies wrongdoing.

Query_Text_cn: 黄金期货价格周四收于前收盘水平，因为虽然有迹象显示欧洲债务危机的解决取得了进展，但这还难以让投资者确信目前已是重返贵金属市场的合适时机。
Translation: Gold futures prices closed at the previous day's level on Thursday as progress in resolving the European debt crisis had been indicated, but this failed to convince investors that now was the appropriate time to return to the precious metals market.

Query_Text_cn: 在纽约商交所大宗商品交易部,交投最活跃的十二月合约周四收于每盎司1,617.30美元，下跌80美分，跌幅0.1%。
Translation: In the commodities division of the New York Mercantile Exchange, the most actively traded December contract closed at $1,617.30 per ounce on Thursday, down 80 cents, or 0.1%.

Query_Text_cn: 近期交割的十月合约收于每盎司1,615.50美元，下跌60美分。
Translation: The October contract closed at $1,615.50 per ounce, down 60 cents.

Query_Text_cn: Everett市场人士一直担心，欧洲在遏制其债务危机方面行动过于缓慢，因为解决债务危机的计划必须获得欧元区17个成员国的全部批准才能执行。
Translation: Market participants in Everett have long been concerned that Europe is moving too slowly in containing its debt crisis, as plans to address it require approval from all 17 eurozone member states before implementation.

Query_Text_cn: 周四盘中的大部分时间，黄金价格都在周三收盘价附近上下波动，由于有上述担忧，一些投资者发现难以采取持续的投资行动。
Translation: On Thursday, the price of gold fluctuated near its Wednesday closing level for most of the trading session, as some investors found it difficult to take sustained investment actions due to such concerns.

Query_Text_cn: 期货交易机构FuturePathTrading的经纪人兼期货分析师雷什（FrankLesh）说，我们继续在观察欧洲的形势以及欧洲国家解决其债务危机的努力，并试图判断出这些努力是否取得了成效。
Translation: Frank Lesh, a broker and futures analyst at the futures trading firm FuturePath Trading, said, "We are continuing to monitor the situation in Europe and the efforts by European countries to address their debt crisis, trying to assess whether these efforts are yielding results."

Query_Text_cn: 他说，在黄金遭到大量抛售后，投资者正在考虑现在是否已是重返市场的时候，所以就出现了投资者犹豫不决的局面。
Translation: He said that after a significant sell-off of gold, investors are weighing whether now is the time to re-enter the market, resulting in a state of indecision among them.

Query_Text_cn: 对冲基金CountryHedging的分析师史密斯（SterlingSmith）说，如果欧洲开始救助行动，将会为金融体系增加大量流动性，这些新增加的流动性会被视为通货膨胀因素，因此对黄金价格有利。
Translation: Analyst Sterling Smith at hedge fund CountryHedging said that if Europe were to launch rescue operations, it would inject substantial liquidity into the financial system, and this newly added liquidity would be seen as inflationary factors, thus benefiting gold prices.

Query_Text_cn: 美元走弱也对金价有所帮助。
Translation: The dollar's weakness has also provided some support to gold prices.

Query_Text_cn: 美元兑一篮子货币的贸易加权汇率出现下跌，纽约市场的洲际交易所美元指数（ICEDollarIndex）从周三尾盘的78.106下滑至77.991。
Translation: The trade-weighted exchange rate for the U.S. dollar against a basket of currencies has declined, with the ICE Dollar Index in the New York market falling from 78.106 late on Wednesday to 77.991.

Query_Text_cn: 印度和中国是世界上最大两个黄金消费国，在前夜的交易中这两个国家的黄金需求似乎在增加。
Translation: India and China, the two largest gold-consuming countries in the world, saw their gold demand seem to be increasing in overnight trading.

Query_Text_cn: 目前正值印度的结婚旺季，这通常是市场大量需要黄金礼品的时候，而中国消费者正在为下周开始的“十一”黄金周假日做购物准备。
Translation: Currently, during India's wedding season—a time when there is typically high demand for gold gifts in the market—Chinese consumers are preparing for shopping ahead of the National Day holiday starting next week.

Query_Text_cn: 标准银行（StandardBank）的大宗商品策略部门负责人维特（WalterdeWet）说，虽然来自印度的买盘兴趣一直非常强烈，但支撑金价的力量在亚洲是普遍存在的，泰国和中国等地对实物黄金的需求也在增加。
Translation: Walter de Wet, head of commodity strategy at Standard Bank, said that while buy-side interest from India has remained extremely strong, the support for gold prices is widespread across Asia, with rising demand for physical gold also emerging in countries such as Thailand and China.

Query_Text_cn: 陷入困境的美国银行业已经提高服务收费并取消免费服务。如今他们又有了一个新的收费目标：借记卡用户。
Translation: Struggling U.S. banks have raised service fees and eliminated free services. Now they have a new target for fees: debit card users.

Query_Text_cn: 美国银行（BankofAmericaCorp.）正在计划向数百万借记卡用户收取每月5美元的费用，其它大型银行预计也将这么做。
Translation: Bank of America Corp. is planning to charge millions of debit card users a $5 monthly fee, and other major banks are also expected to follow suit.

Query_Text_cn: 美国银行业说它需要这笔费用弥补其将损失的收入，因为政府出台的新的监管规定限制了银行向商户收取的借记卡交易的费用。
Translation: The U.S. banking industry says it needs the fee to compensate for lost revenue as the government has implemented new regulatory provisions capping the fees on debit card transactions that banks can charge merchants.

Query_Text_cn: 周四，美国银行以资产规模计算，美国银行是美国最大的银行。在向高级员工发送的一份备忘录中披露了这项计划。
Translation: On Thursday, Bank of America, the largest U.S. bank by assets, disclosed the plan in a memo sent to senior staff.

Query_Text_cn: 该行打算于明年初在全美范围内收取这项费用。
Translation: The bank plans to charge this fee across the United States early next year.

Query_Text_cn: 包括摩根大通（J.P.MorganChase&Co.）和富国银行（WellsFargo&Co.）在内的其它几家大型银行正在几个州测试或计划测试收取类似费用。
Translation: Including J.P. Morgan Chase & Co. and Wells Fargo & Co., several other major banks are currently testing or planning to test similar fees in several states.

Query_Text_cn: 表示，它将从10月1日开始对某些账户收取每月4美元的借记卡使用费。
Translation: It has announced that it will begin charging a $4 monthly debit card fee for certain accounts starting October 1.

Query_Text_cn: 联邦政府出台的限制借记卡“刷卡费”的新规预计将令美国的银行每年损失66亿美元的收入。
Translation: The Federal government's new regulations limiting debit card "swipe fees" are expected to result in an annual revenue loss of $6.6 billion for U.S. banks.

Query_Text_cn: 为了弥补损失的收入，许多银行已经取消了借记卡奖励计划或缩减此类计划的规模，同时向支票账户收取月使用费，并提高了那些想要避免某些费用的客户的最低余额要求。
Translation: To offset lost revenue, many banks have eliminated debit card reward programs or scaled back such initiatives, charged monthly maintenance fees on checking accounts, and raised the minimum balance requirements for clients wishing to avoid certain fees.

Query_Text_cn: 今年6月，美国联邦储备委员会理事会（FederalReserveBoard）最终通过了限制借记卡刷卡费的规定，规定将于本周六生效。
Translation: In June, the Federal Reserve Board finally adopted a rule limiting debit card swipe fees, which will take effect this Saturday.

Query_Text_cn: 按照新规，顾客每次使用借记卡消费，商户只要向银行支付24美分的费用，低于目前44美分的标准。
Translation: Under the new regulation, merchants only need to pay 24 cents per debit card transaction, lower than the current 44-cent rate.

Query_Text_cn: 这项规定适用于资产在100亿美元或以上的银行。
Translation: This regulation applies to banks with assets of 100 billion US dollars or above.

Query_Text_cn: 美国银行曾表示它预计这项规定将令其每年收入损失20亿美元。美国银行业曾花数月时间游说反对此项规定。
Translation: Bank of America previously stated that it expected the regulation to result in an annual revenue loss of $2 billion. The U.S. banking industry spent months lobbying against the regulation.

Query_Text_cn: 一家中国矿业公司因对安全问题的担忧而退出了原本将成为巴基斯坦规模最大的一桩外国投资交易，令伊斯兰堡试图将这个巨大的邻国作为可以替代美国成为其主要盟友的努力变得更加困难。
Translation: A Chinese mining company withdrew from what would have been Pakistan's largest foreign investment deal due to concerns over safety issues, making Islamabad's efforts to position its giant neighbor as a potential replacement for the United States as its primary ally even more challenging.

Query_Text_cn: 中国庆华集团的一位管理人士周四说，由于巴基斯坦多个大城市最近连续发生爆炸事件，出于对人员安全的考虑，该公司于8月份退出了巴基斯坦南部信德省(Sindh)190亿美元的交易。该公司是中国最大的私营煤矿公司之一。
Translation: A management official from China Qinghua Group said on Thursday that due to the recent consecutive explosions in multiple major cities in Pakistan, the company withdrew from the $19 billion deal in Sindh province in southern Pakistan in August out of concern for personnel safety. Qinghua is one of China's largest private coal mining companies.

Query_Text_cn: 信德省投资委员会主席ZubairMotiwala承认未来20年中建设一个煤矿、多个发电厂和化工厂的计划被取消。
Translation: The chairman of the Sindh Investment Board Zubair Motiwala confirmed the cancellation of the plan to build a coal mine, multiple power plants and chemical factories over the next 20 years.

Query_Text_cn: 但他说，庆华会重新考虑，他对此满怀希望。
Translation: But he said that Qinghua would reconsider, and he is full of hope regarding this.

Query_Text_cn: 自5月份美国在巴基斯坦击毙本?拉登(OsamabinLaden)、导致伊斯兰堡和华盛顿关系急转直下后，巴基斯坦一直在与中国建立更密切的关系。
Translation: Since the killing of Osama bin Laden in Pakistan in May led to a significant deterioration in relations between Islamabad and Washington, Pakistan has been building closer ties with China.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，目前为止中国的反应不太热烈，这表明伊斯兰堡未来一段时间内可能仍需依靠华盛顿提供数十亿美元的军事和非军事援助。
Translation: However, China's response has not been very enthusiastic so far, suggesting that Islamabad may still need to rely on Washington for billions of dollars in military and non-military aid in the foreseeable future.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦总理吉拉尼(YousufRazaGilani)利用中国公安部部长孟建柱本周访巴的契机，努力增强中巴友谊。吉拉尼说，中巴友谊比山高，比海深，比钢强，比蜜甜。
Translation: Pakistan Prime Minister Yousuf Raza Gilani took the opportunity of Chinese Minister of Public Security Meng Jianzhu's visit to Pakistan this week to actively strengthen China-Pakistan friendship. Gilani stated, "China-Pakistan friendship is higher than mountains, deeper than oceans, stronger than steel, and sweeter than honey."

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦陆军参谋长卡亚尼(AshfaqKayani)对中国给予巴基斯坦的“坚定支持”向孟建柱表示感谢。孟建柱承诺向巴基斯坦执法部门提供120万美元的援助。
Translation: Pakistan Army Chief of Staff Ashfaq Kayani expressed his gratitude to Meng Jianzhu for China's "steadfast support" toward Pakistan. Meng Jianzhu, Member of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, and Minister of Public Security, pledged to provide $1.2 million in assistance to Pakistan's law enforcement agencies.

Query_Text_cn: 这番热情洋溢的赞扬与最近美巴之间的论调形成了鲜明的对比；此前即将卸任的美军参谋长联席会议主席、海军上将马伦(MikeMullen)曾致电一个反抗组织，美国国会议员也扬言要停止对巴基斯坦的援助。
Translation: This effusive praise stands in sharp contrast to the recent rhetoric between the U.S. and Pakistan; previously, outgoing Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and Admiral Mike Mullen had contacted a rebel group, while U.S. congressional members threatened to halt aid to Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: 伊斯兰堡的回应则是警告美国这样做可能会失去一个盟友。
Translation: Islamabad’s response was to warn the United States that proceeding in this manner might result in the loss of an ally.

Query_Text_cn: 多年来中国一直支持巴基斯坦，将其作为战略上在印度洋地区平衡印度势力的国家。巴基斯坦是中国武器的最大出口市场。
Translation: Over the years, China has consistently supported Pakistan, viewing it as a strategic counterweight to India's influence in the Indian Ocean region. Pakistan is China's largest export market for weapons.

Query_Text_cn: 两国共同开发了JF-17战机（中国称“枭龙战机”）等军事装备，此外中国还帮助巴基斯坦修建民用核反应堆。
Translation: The two countries co-developed military equipment such as the JF-17 fighter (known in China as the Xiaolong fighter), and China has also assisted Pakistan in constructing civilian nuclear reactors.

Query_Text_cn: 北京建设并为巴基斯坦瓜达尔港口(Gwadar)提供资金，作为修建一条从中国西北至阿拉伯海的公路和铁路运输通道的一部分。瓜达尔港于2007年开始运营。
Translation: Beijing funded and constructed the Gwadar Port in Pakistan as part of a project to build a transportation corridor linking China’s northwestern regions to the Arabian Sea via roads and railways. Gwadar Port began operations in 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，在很多情况下，中国的支持没有达到巴基斯坦所希望的程度，而在北京方面看来，伊斯兰堡则没有兑现承诺，其中包括保证中国在巴基斯坦的投资安全。
Translation: However, in many cases, China's support has not met the level Pakistan hoped for, while Beijing views Islamabad as having failed to fulfill its commitments, including ensuring the security of Chinese investments in Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: 一位巴基斯坦政府官员说，美国突袭并击毙了本?拉登，这令很多巴基斯坦人大为不满，巴基斯坦与美国的关系变得紧张，之后巴基斯坦陆军一直主张与中国达成正式的防务协定。
Translation: A Pakistani government official stated that the U.S. raid which killed Osama bin Laden has left many Pakistanis deeply dissatisfied, straining the relationship between Pakistan and the United States. Since the incident, the Pakistan Army has consistently advocated for formal defense agreements with China.

Query_Text_cn: 这样一个协定将把中国拖入任何一场涉及他们盟友的冲突之中，并可能激怒美国和印度。印度是巴基斯坦在这一地区的竞争对手。
Translation: Such an agreement would drag China into any conflict involving its allies and could anger the United States and India. India is Pakistan's rival in this region.

Query_Text_cn: 中国未就此事置评。
Translation: China has not commented on this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦军方的一名发言人拒绝就此置评。
Translation: A spokesperson for the Pakistani military declined to comment on this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 中国不会签署这样的协定。
Translation: China will not sign such an agreement.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦一名军事分析师西迪卡（AishaSiddiqa）说，在中国无法保证对盟友的控制力的情况下，这对中国来说是麻烦事。
Translation: A military analyst in Pakistan, Aisha Siddiqa, said that if China cannot ensure control over its allies, this poses a problem for China.

Query_Text_cn: 中国政府迫切希望通过重新改善和印度的关系来平衡其对巴基斯坦的支持。印度是中国日益重要的贸易伙伴。
Translation: The Chinese government urgently hopes to reimprove relations with India to balance its support for Pakistan. India is an increasingly important trading partner for China.

Query_Text_cn: 中国也希望极力避免同美国发生新的摩擦，因为这可能会严重影响中国国家副主席习近平明年初对华盛顿的首次正式访问。据外交官和分析人士预测，习近平有望于2012年接任中共中央总书记一职，并于2013年出任国家主席。
与此同时，美国希望中国能参与到有关巴基斯坦的对话中来。华盛顿正试图寻找途径就巴基斯坦同伊斯兰武装分子的关系向伊斯兰堡施压。
Translation: Meanwhile, the United States hopes China can be involved in dialogue regarding Pakistan. Washington is seeking ways to exert pressure on Islamabad concerning Pakistan's ties with Islamic militant groups.

Query_Text_cn: 据美国国务院一名高级官员透露，周一，美国国务卿克林顿（HillaryClinton）在纽约直接向中国外交部长杨洁篪提出这一要求。
Translation: A senior official at the U.S. Department of State disclosed on Monday that U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton raised this request directly with Chinese Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi in New York.

Query_Text_cn: 北京大学南亚问题专家韩华说，由于美军从阿富汗撤军的日期临近，中国因此视巴基斯坦为一个日益重要的战略合作伙伴。
Translation: Han Hua, a Peking University expert on South Asian affairs, said that with the approaching withdrawal date of U.S. troops from Afghanistan, China thus views Pakistan as an increasingly important strategic partner.

Query_Text_cn: 韩华说，这并不意味着中国想要取代美国曾经扮演的角色。
Translation: Han Hua said this does not mean that China seeks to replace the role the United States once played.

Query_Text_cn: 这并不是一个零和博弈。
Translation: This is not a zero-sum game.

Query_Text_cn: 中巴之间还有一些交易正在进行。
Translation: There are still some ongoing business transactions between China and Pakistan.

Query_Text_cn: Motiwala说，巴基斯坦上周同另一家较小的中国企业寰宇矿业有限公司（GlobalMiningCo.）签署了初步协议。寰宇矿业将在一家矿场和电力项目上投资30亿美元。该电力项目的地址靠近庆华集团退出的那个项目。
Translation: Motiwala said that Pakistan signed a preliminary agreement with another smaller Chinese company, Global Mining Co., last week. Global Mining will invest $3 billion in a mining site and a power project. The power project is located near the one Qinghua Group exited.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦海军最近同意购买中国制造的两艘“阿兹马特”级（Azmat-class）攻击舰。今年8月，中国发射了一颗巴基斯坦通信卫星。
Translation: The Pakistan Navy recently agreed to purchase two Chinese-made "Azmat-class" attack frigates. In August this year, China launched a Pakistani communications satellite.

Query_Text_cn: 巴基斯坦向中国提出的增加其基础设施项目资金的其他要求还没有进展。
Translation: There has been no progress on the additional requests Pakistan has made to China to increase funding for its infrastructure projects.

Query_Text_cn: 今年5月，巴基斯坦国防部长说，中国已同意接手瓜达尔港的经营，还说伊斯兰堡已经要求中国在瓜达尔为巴基斯坦海军建立一个基地。作为一个商业港口，瓜达尔港几乎没有什么业务。
Translation: In May this year, Pakistan's Defense Minister stated that China had agreed to take over the operation of Gwadar Port, adding that Islamabad had requested China to establish a base for the Pakistan Navy in Gwadar. As a commercial port, Gwadar Port has virtually no business operations.

Query_Text_cn: 中国在此问题上仍然保持沉默。
Translation: China has remained silent on this issue.

Query_Text_cn: 负责瓜达尔港运营的巴基斯坦官员说，没有迹象表明中国将接手这个港口。
Translation: Pakistani officials responsible for the operations of Gwadar Port said there is no indication that China would take over the port.

Query_Text_cn: 这些官员说，中国未能建成连接瓜达尔港和中国内陆的道路网络，也没有提供建设资金。
Translation: These officials stated that China has failed to construct the road network connecting Gwadar Port to its interior and has not provided funding for the construction.

Query_Text_cn: 在过去十年中，有多位中国工人在巴基斯坦被杀害，其中一些是在动荡的俾路支省（Baluchistan）遇害的。俾路支省的武装分裂叛乱分子一直反对中国投资。
Translation: Over the past decade, several Chinese workers have been killed in Pakistan, some of whom were murdered in the restive province of Baluchistan. Armed separatist insurgents in Baluchistan have consistently opposed Chinese investment.

Query_Text_cn: 一些中国专家说，瓜达尔处于俾路支省相对偏僻的位置，这降低了其作为军事基地以及中国进口石油中转站的吸引力，因为这样做成本高昂，而且输油管道穿过巴基斯坦部分极不稳定地区还会带来安全风险。
Translation: Some Chinese experts argue that Gwadar's relatively remote location in Balochistan Province reduces its appeal as a military base and a transshipment hub for China's imported oil, as doing so would be costly and the construction of an oil pipeline through highly unstable regions in Pakistan poses security risks.

Query_Text_cn: 中国反对欧盟将航空纳入碳排放交易体系。
Translation: China opposes the EU's move to include aviation in its carbon emissions trading system.

Query_Text_cn: 中国外交部发言人洪磊周三说，中国反对欧盟（EuropeanUnion）将航空纳入碳排放交易体系以限制温室气体排放的计划。
Translation: Hong Lei, a spokesman for China's Foreign Ministry, said on Wednesday that China opposes the European Union's (European Union) plan to include aviation in its carbon emissions trading system to restrict greenhouse gas emissions.

Query_Text_cn: 洪磊在例行记者会上说，中方赞赏欧盟为应对气候变化所做的努力，但反对欧方强行实施航空排放单方面立法的做法；中方已多次表明立场，并已通过双边渠道向欧盟表达了我们的立场和关切；事实上，不仅中国，其他很多国家也都对欧盟这一做法持反对态度。
Translation: Hong Lei said at a regular press conference that China appreciates the efforts made by the EU in addressing climate change, but opposes the EU's practice of forcefully implementing unilateral legislation on aviation emissions. China has repeatedly made its position clear and communicated its stance and concerns to the EU through bilateral channels. In fact, not only China but many other countries also oppose the EU's approach.

Query_Text_cn: 洪磊还呼吁欧盟与中方在内的有关方面协商处理此事。
Translation: Hong Lei also called on the EU and other relevant parties, including China, to consult to address this matter.

Query_Text_cn: 周一，欧盟气候行动专员郝泽高(ConnieHedegaard)提交了欧盟27国现有的碳排放限额交易体系明年如何扩大到航空领域的详细计划。
Translation: On Monday, EU Climate Action Commissioner Connie Hedegaard submitted a detailed plan outlining how the EU’s existing emissions trading system would be expanded to cover the aviation sector next year.

Query_Text_cn: 从明年1月1日起，所有航空公司从欧盟国家机场起飞或降落的航班都须持有允许其排放二氧化碳的许可。
Translation: Starting from January 1,next year,all flights operated by airlines departing from or landing at airports in EU countries must hold permits allowing them to emit carbon dioxide.

Query_Text_cn: 在欧盟区有很少航线的航空公司将获得豁免。
Translation: Airlines with few routes in the EU region will be exempted.

Query_Text_cn: 8月，中国航空运输协会一名官员说，协会已经准备就欧盟将欧盟以外地区航空公司纳入碳排放体系的计划提起诉讼。
Translation: In August, an official from the China Air Transport Association stated that the association has prepared to file a lawsuit against the EU's plan to include airlines from non-EU regions into its carbon emissions trading system.

Query_Text_cn: 协会秘书长魏振中在8月份讲话时表示，该协会与中国国航、东航和南航组成的代表团已与5月赴布鲁塞尔，与欧盟官员就该问题进行了交涉。他的讲话原稿发布在该协会的网站上。
Translation: Secretary-General Wei Zhenzhong stated in August that a delegation formed by the association together with Air China, China Eastern, and China Southern had traveled to Brussels in May to hold discussions with EU officials regarding the matter. The transcript of his speech was published on the association’s website.

Query_Text_cn: 过去几周来，中国房地产业的观察人士听的一直是分析师、监管机构和评级机构标准普尔(Standard&Poor's)唱的哀歌。
Translation: Over the past few weeks, observers of China's real estate sector have been hearing nothing but the dirge sung by analysts, regulators, and rating agency Standard & Poor's.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，现在一位中国房地产知名人士也开始唱起了忧郁的蓝调。
Translation: However, now a prominent figure in China's real estate sector has started singing the blues.

Query_Text_cn: TomohiroOhsumi/BloombergSOHO中国首席执行长张欣SOHO中国首席执行长张欣周三说，在她17年的住宅房地产从业经历中，从未遇到过这样艰难的市场。
Translation: Tomohiro Ohsumi/Bloomberg: Zhang Xin, Chief Executive Officer of SOHO China, said on Wednesday that in her 17-year career in residential real estate, she has never encountered such a challenging market.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣在上海外国记者俱乐部(ForeignCorrespondentsClubShanghai)说，这是我们在销售上遇到的最具挑战性的一年。
Translation: Zhang Xin said at the Foreign Correspondents' Club of Shanghai that this has been the most challenging year we have encountered in sales.

Query_Text_cn: 她在谈到较高端房地产市场、也就是SOHO中国主要关注的市场时说，住宅销售这一块看不到交易。
Translation: She said that in discussing the high-end real estate market—namely the sector that SOHO China focuses on—there are no visible transactions in residential sales.

Query_Text_cn: 现年46岁的张欣与丈夫潘石屹一同领导着位于北京的开发商SOHO中国。这家知名公司开发的公寓和写字楼看起来像是宜家(IKEA)和《星际旅行》(StarTrek)的综合体。
Translation: Zhang Xin, 46, co-leads SOHO China, a prominent Beijing-based developer, alongside her husband Pan Shiyi. The company's apartments and office buildings resemble a fusion of IKEA and Star Trek.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣曾是一位投资银行家，她与丈夫合伙经营的SOHO中国使他们成为中国顶尖富豪之一。
Translation: Zhang Xin was an investment banker. She and her husband co-founded and co-managed SOHO China, which made them one of China's top billionaires.

Query_Text_cn: 与这对明星伉俪在其新浪微博上表达的不满相呼应的是，张欣将目前楼市的下滑归咎于政府的政策。她说，随着北京遏制通货膨胀和修建保障房，开发商和购房人都无法获得信贷。
Translation: Echoing the discontent expressed by this celebrity couple on their Sina Weibo accounts, Zhang Xin attributes the current decline in the property market to government policies. She stated that as Beijing curbs inflation and builds affordable housing, both developers and homebuyers are unable to secure credit.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣说，房地产业受到政策的严重左右，你在猜测政策上花的时间比真正做事的时间还要多。
Translation: Zhang Xin said that the real estate industry is heavily influenced by policies, and one spends more time speculating on policies than actually doing work.

Query_Text_cn: 她表达了对北京大规模建设保障房的不安，说这与他们15年来的一贯做法背道而驰，她调侃说一些公寓月租最低将可达人民币70元（约合11美元）。
Translation: She expressed concern over Beijing's large-scale construction of affordable housing, stating that this was contrary to their long-standing practices over the past 15 years. She joked that some apartments would have monthly rents as low as 70 yuan (approximately $11).

Query_Text_cn: 通过幻灯片，张欣明确表示更青睐像SOHO中国8月份销售的公寓所达到的每平方米5万元的价格，当时吸引了很多买家。
Translation: Through a slide presentation, Zhang Xin explicitly stated her preference for the price level of 50,000 yuan per square meter achieved by the apartments sold by SOHO China in August, which attracted a significant number of buyers at the time.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣预测，紧缩的货币政策和投资环境在中国楼市不会持久。
Translation: Zhang Xin predicts that contractionary monetary policy and investment environment in China's real estate market will not last long.

Query_Text_cn: 当有人问她预测中国领导人什么时候会放宽限制的时候，她表示会在六个月之内，她说会很快。
张欣周三的发言很辛辣──难怪她用白色黑莓(Blackberry)发的微博有240万用户关注。
Translation: Zhang Xin's sharp remarks on Wednesday — no wonder her Weibo posts sent from a white Blackberry have attracted 2.4 million followers.

Query_Text_cn: 她谈到迅速整合的楼市将引发社会不安定，地下钱庄的高利贷利息高达50%，她说，有些情况下还会引发自杀事件。
Translation: She said that the rapidly consolidating real estate market could trigger social instability, that the exorbitant interest rates of underground banks can reach as high as 50%, and that in some cases it could even lead to suicide cases.

Query_Text_cn: 情况并非都是令人苦闷的。
Translation: Not all situations are disheartening.

Query_Text_cn: 在张欣周三发言的高级酒店外，街道上持续不断的气锤敲击声表明了中国的开发没有停止的事实。
Translation: Outside the luxury hotel where Zhang Xin spoke on Wednesday, the constant sound of pneumatic hammers highlighted the fact that China's development has not stopped.

Query_Text_cn: 而且SOHO中国在不断地收购、建楼，最近尤其是在上海。
Translation: Moreover, SOHO China has been continuously acquiring and developing properties, particularly in Shanghai recently.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣展示了一段建筑师扎哈?哈迪德(ZahaHadid)的设计视频，视频中，位于虹桥综合交通枢纽、即将开工建设的未来派写字楼有点像附近火车站驶出的动车。
Translation: Zhang Xin showcased a design video by architect Zaha Hadid. The futuristic office building situated at the Hongqiao Integrated Transportation Hub, which is set to commence construction, bears a striking resemblance to a high-speed train departing from the nearby railway station.

Query_Text_cn: 张欣说，2011年，SOHO中国斥资人民币114亿元在上海收购楼盘，全部都是商业楼盘。
Translation: Zhang Xin said that in 2011, SOHO China invested RMB 11.4 billion to acquire properties in Shanghai, all of which were commercial.

Query_Text_cn: 她说，政府对住宅项目开发的限制使写字楼成了更安全的投资。
Translation: She said that the government's restrictions on residential property development have made office buildings a safer investment choice.

Query_Text_cn: 她说，2009年摩根士丹利(MorganStanley)将上海的部分楼盘卖掉时，SOHO中国开始从北京向上海扩张。
Translation: She said that when Morgan Stanley sold part of its properties in Shanghai in 2009, SOHO China began expanding from Beijing to Shanghai.

Query_Text_cn: 据张欣说，SOHO中国目前正在考虑进军广州和深圳。
Translation: According to Zhang Xin, SOHO China is currently considering expanding into Guangzhou and Shenzhen.

Query_Text_cn: 在一个月多点的时间里，铜的行情转为熊市，令大宗商品交易员措手不及，并拉响了整个金融市场的警报。
Translation: In just over a month, copper's market shifted into a bearish trend, catching commodities traders off guard and sounding an alarm across the broader financial market.

Query_Text_cn: 铜价的跌幅远远超过了股市的跌幅，标普500指数同期跌了5.6%。
Translation: The decline in copper prices far outpaced that of stock markets, with the S&P 500 index falling by 5.6% over the same period.

Query_Text_cn: 由于铜被广泛用于从苹果公司(AppleInc.)的iPad到室内管道和电线等各种产品中，铜成为全球经济及股市的一个很好的领先指标，所以铜价的下跌就显得幅度尤其大了。
Translation: Copper, widely used in products ranging from Apple Inc.'s iPad to indoor plumbing and wiring, has become a leading indicator of the global economy and stock markets. Thus, the decline in copper prices has been particularly sharp.

Query_Text_cn: 一些投资者对铜预测经济形势的能力坚信不移，以致于称其为“铜博士”。
Translation: Some investors are so convinced of copper's ability to predict economic trends that they refer to it as the "Dr. Copper".

Query_Text_cn: 鉴于金融市场已经因投资者对欧洲债务危机及中美经济的担忧而受到打击，最近铜价的下跌就尤其令人不安了。
Translation: Given that financial markets have been hit by investors' concerns over the European debt crisis and the economies of China and the United States, the recent decline in copper prices has been particularly unsettling.

Query_Text_cn: 这对那些希望股市将很快止跌的投资者来说也是坏消息。
Translation: This is also bad news for investors hoping the stock market will bottom out soon.

Query_Text_cn: 全球曼氏金融(MFGlobal)策略师克洛普费恩斯坦(AdamKlopfenstein)说，大家看到铜价的跌幅超过了股市跌幅，这表明在复苏的现阶段股价过高了。
Translation: MF Global strategist Adam Klopfenstein said that the decline in copper prices has exceeded that of stock markets, indicating that stock prices have become overvalued at the current stage of the recovery.

Query_Text_cn: 周三，铜期货跌5.6%，收于每磅3.2360美元，创下13个月新低。
Translation: On Wednesday, copper futures fell 5.6%, closing at $3.2360 per pound and hitting a 13-month low.

Query_Text_cn: 铜期货的下跌拖累了股市大盘。
Translation: The decline in copper futures dragged down the broader stock market.

Query_Text_cn: 标普500指数一路走低，在短短30多分钟的时间里跌了近1.5%，该指数周三收盘跌24.32点，至1151.06点，跌幅2.1%。
Translation: The S&P 500 index plunged sharply, dropping nearly 1.5% in just over 30 minutes. The index closed down 24.32 points on Wednesday at 1151.06, a 2.1% decline.

Query_Text_cn: 铜过去一直是股市行情的良好预测指标，特别是在金融危机最深重的时候。
Translation: Copper has historically been a reliable indicator of stock market performance, particularly during the most severe periods of financial crises.

Query_Text_cn: 美国投资公司MKMPartners首席市场技术分析师史塔克顿(KatieStockton)说，2009年初前后，铜价曾远远先于其他市场大幅下挫，目前铜价和股市之间的相关性看来与那个时候出奇的相似。
Translation: Katie Stockton, chief market technician at MKM Partners, said that around early 2009, copper prices had plummeted far ahead of other markets. Currently, the correlation between copper prices and stock markets appears strikingly similar to that period.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年12月，铜价暴跌并在当月下旬触底。
Translation: In December 2008, copper prices plummeted and hit bottom in the latter part of that month.

Query_Text_cn: 而股市直到2009年3月才开始跟随铜价下跌。
Translation: The stock markets did not begin to follow the decline of copper prices until March 2009.

Query_Text_cn: 史塔克顿说，2008年年底铜价确实出现了具有决定性的低谷；标普在那段时间开始将铜价定为历史最低水平，但价格却进一步下跌；看到铜价稳定下来，才能预计股市会稳定。
Translation: Starkton said that by the end of 2008, copper prices did indeed hit a decisive trough; during that period, S&P began setting copper prices at historic lows, but prices continued to decline. Only when copper prices stabilize can one anticipate stability in stock markets.

Query_Text_cn: 同样的，全球经济普遍收缩也会尤其对铜造成损害。
Translation: Similarly, a widespread contraction in the global economy would also particularly harm copper.

Query_Text_cn: 但或许还有其他因素在起作用。
Translation: But there might be other factors at play.

Query_Text_cn: 首先，自2008年触底以来，铜价一直处于牛市行情。
Translation: Since hitting bottom in 2008, copper prices have remained in a bull market trend.

Query_Text_cn: 到今年2月，铜价已经是原来的三倍，并且直到最近大跌前，铜价一直徘徊在接近高位水平。
Translation: By February this year, the price of copper had tripled, and it hovered near peak levels until just before the recent sharp decline.

Query_Text_cn: 随着铜价下跌，对冲基金及其他投机者纷纷撤资。
Translation: As copper prices fall, hedge funds and other speculators are cutting their exposure.

Query_Text_cn: 美国商品期货交易委员会(CommodityFuturesTradingCommission)的数据表明，8月底，认为铜价会从2009年9月以来首次下跌的投机型投资者人数超过了认为会上涨的。
Translation: The data from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) indicated that at the end of August, the number of speculative investors who expected copper prices to fall for the first time since September 2009 exceeded those who anticipated a rise.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，从4月开始，很多大型大宗商品对冲基金都没有真正的参与金属市场；疲软的经济背景已经形成了一个令他们考虑“做空”的环境。
Translation: He said that since April, many large commodity hedge funds have not genuinely participated in the metal markets; the weak economic backdrop has created an environment prompting them to consider "shorting."

Query_Text_cn: 同时也有很多人在注视着中国。中国去年在世界精炼铜消费总量中占了40%。
Translation: Meanwhile, many are watching China. China accounted for 40% of the world's total refined copper consumption last year.

Query_Text_cn: 中国海关总署上周说，中国今年的铜进口量较上年跌了26%。
Translation: China's General Administration of Customs said last week that China's copper imports this year fell by 26% from the previous year.

Query_Text_cn: 此前汇丰对中国制造业进行了初步评估，结果显示9月份制造业活动连续第三个月出现萎缩。
Translation: HSBC’s preliminary assessment of China’s manufacturing showed that manufacturing activity contracted for the third consecutive month in September.

Query_Text_cn: 另外，中国的铜价正在走低，向伦敦制定的世界基准价格靠拢。
Translation: Additionally, the price of copper in China is declining and moving toward the world benchmark price set in London.

Query_Text_cn: 二者之间的差价达到5月以来最窄，表明中国对铜的胃口正在变小。
Translation: The spread between the two has narrowed to its narrowest since May, indicating that China's appetite for copper is shrinking.

Query_Text_cn: 管理摩根富林明资产管理(J.P.MorganAssetManagement)旗下IntrepidValueFund基金的布拉姆（ChristopherBlum）说，铜是应该密切关注的一种商品；数据显示中国的需求正在减缓。
Translation: Christopher Blum, who manages the Intrepid Value Fund at J.P. Morgan Asset Management, said copper is a commodity that deserves close attention; data show China's demand is slowing.

Query_Text_cn: 当市场下挫时，看涨人士爱提醒投资者“逢低买进”，不过，这种策略虽然从逻辑上说行得通，但实际运用起来效果却没那么好。
Translation: When markets dip, bullish investors often remind investors to "buy the dip." However, while this strategy makes logical sense, its practical application often falls short of expectations.

Query_Text_cn: 凭感觉来看，逢低买进确实是讲得通的。
Translation: From an intuitive standpoint, buying the dip does make sense.

Query_Text_cn: 投资无非就是低买高卖。
Translation: Investing is essentially about buying low and selling high.

Query_Text_cn: ChristopheVorlet上周四道琼斯工业股票平均价格指数(DowJonesIndustrialAverage)在盘中低位一度下跌近500点，看到这种情况，至少有一部分投资者在盘算着逢低买进。
Translation: On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunged nearly 500 points to intraday lows, spurring at least some investors to calculate opportunistic buying.

Query_Text_cn: 随后，上周五股市收盘上涨，抄底的投资者很快便赚到了一笔钱。
Translation: Subsequently, the stock market closed higher last Friday, and the bottom-fishing investors soon reaped a profit.

Query_Text_cn: 但如果我们作些更加深入的观察和思考，就会发现逢低买进似乎没那么诱人。
Translation: But upon making more in-depth observations and reflections, one would find that buying on dips does not seem as appealing as it might appear.

Query_Text_cn: 先从下定义开始。
Translation: Start by defining the concept.

Query_Text_cn: 还有一个问题：如果股市长期回报像多数投资者所期待的那样为正，那么逢低买进可能并不会增加你的回报。
Translation: If stock market long-term returns are positive as most investors expect, then dollar-cost averaging may not actually boost your returns.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，VanguardGroup的投资策略分析师小弗兰西斯?肯尼瑞(FrancisKinniryJr.)指出，许多下调行情都出现在市场接近纪录高位时。
Translation: Additionally, Francis Kinniry Jr., an Investment Strategy Analyst at Vanguard Group, noted that many market downturns have occurred when the market was nearing record highs.

Query_Text_cn: “低于纪录高位”与“便宜”恐怕不是一个概念。
Translation: "Below record highs" and "cheap" are probably not one and the same concept.

Query_Text_cn: 标准普尔500指数(Standard&Poor's500)在2007年10月9日触及绝对高位1565.15点。
Translation: The S&P 500 Index hit an all-time high of 1,565.15 on October 9, 2007.

Query_Text_cn: 上周五标准普尔500指数收盘报1136.43点，远低于当年的回调水平。
Translation: The S&P 500 index closed at 1,136.43 points last Friday, far below the year's corrective level.

Query_Text_cn: 为考察逢低买进策略在实际中如何发挥作用，我请投资经理威廉?伯恩斯坦(WilliamBernstein)用Vanguard500指数基金(Vanguard500IndexFund)来回顾过去10年的状况。伯恩斯坦任职于总部位于康涅狄格州伊斯特福德的投资顾问公司EfficientFrontierAdvisors。Vanguard500指数基金是衡量美国股市整体走势的常用指标，因为它追踪标准普尔500指数。
Translation: To examine how the buy-and-hold strategy functions in practice, I asked investment manager William Bernstein to review the past 10 years using the Vanguard 500 Index Fund. Bernstein works at Efficient Frontier Advisors, an investment advisory firm headquartered in Eastford, Connecticut. The Vanguard 500 Index Fund serves as a common benchmark for evaluating the broader U.S. stock market, as it tracks the S&P 500 Index.

Query_Text_cn: 假设你恰好在10年前买进了这只基金，你当时应该是为每份基金支付了77.22美元（经派息因素调整后）。
Translation: If you had purchased this fund exactly 10 years ago, you would have paid $77.22 per share (adjusted for dividends).

Query_Text_cn: 你为逢低买进而花的钱最终还是比一开始投入的要多。
Translation: The total amount spent on dollar-cost averaging ultimately exceeds the initial investment.

Query_Text_cn: 伯恩斯坦说，事实与直觉大相径庭。
Translation: Bernstein said that the facts differ greatly from intuition.

Query_Text_cn: 他估计，一开始进行的一次性投资可以让你获得3%的年平均总回报率。
Translation: He estimates that the initial one-time investment can yield an annual average total return rate of 3%.

Query_Text_cn: 在单日跌幅为5%时买进会让你的年平均回报率减少0.1个百分点，在单日跌幅为2%时买进则会使你的年平均回报率减少0.8%。
Translation: Buying in when there is a single-day decline of 5% will reduce your annual average return by 0.1 percentage points. Purchasing during a 2% single-day drop would decrease it by 0.8 percentage points.

Query_Text_cn: Vanguard的肯尼瑞指出，大幅回调可能会“密集出现”。
Translation: Kenneth Rui of Vanguard noted that significant corrections may "cluster densely".

Query_Text_cn: 四个交易日以后该指数出现了历史第五高跌幅，下跌9%。
Translation: Four trading days later, the index recorded its fifth-largest historical decline, plunging by 9%.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一个问题是，除非你能在高位卖出，否则逢低买进没什么好处。
Translation: Another issue is that unless you can sell at the top, buying low has little benefit.

Query_Text_cn: 肯尼瑞发现，在过去十年里，在下跌2%的时候逢低买进的策略结合定期股票和债券投资组合再平衡操作，能让年均回报率提高0.3%左右。
Translation: Keni Rui found that, over the past decade, a strategy of buying on dips when the market drops by 2% combined with periodic rebalancing of the stock and bond portfolio can increase the annualized return rate by approximately 0.3%.

Query_Text_cn: 逢低买进也许能让你感觉好一点，这就像在百货商场打折时购物感觉良好一样。
Translation: Buying the dip might offer a fleeting sense of relief, much like the satisfaction of splurging on discounted items at a department store during a sale.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，别误认为逢低买进一定能增加你的投资回报。
Translation: However, do not mistakenly believe that buying the dip will guarantee an increase in your investment returns.

Query_Text_cn: 俄罗斯官员力图恢复投资者的信心，后者因长期担任俄罗斯财长的库德林(AlexeiKudrin)突然被解职而感到惊慌。官员们预测说卢布将出现反弹，而就在此时，俄罗斯央行称它周一抛售了23.6亿美元以支撑疲软的卢布。
Translation: Russian officials are trying to restore investor confidence, which had been rattled by the sudden dismissal of Alexei Kudrin, who had long served as finance minister. Just as officials predicted a ruble rebound, Russia's central bank said it sold off $2.36 billion on Monday to prop up the weakening ruble.

Query_Text_cn: 此外，国际货币基金组织(IMF)警告说，如果全球形势恶化，繁重的政府支出可能殃及俄罗斯的经济稳定。
Translation: In addition, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) warned that if global conditions deteriorate, burdensome government spending could jeopardize Russia's economic stability.

Query_Text_cn: IMF的警告与库德林本人的担忧相吻合，他在刚刚过去的这个周末公开了表达了这种忧虑，而俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫(DmitryMedvedev)为此于本周一解除了他的财长职务。
Translation: IMF's warning aligns with concerns expressed by Alexei Kudrin himself, who voiced these worries over the past weekend, prompting Russian President Dmitry Medvedev to remove him from his position as finance minister on Monday.

Query_Text_cn: 俄罗斯央行行长伊格纳提夫(SergeiIgnatiev)周二罕见地召开了媒体吹风会，唱好卢布的前景，称俄罗斯央行不会扩大卢布的目标汇率区间。
Translation: Sergei Ignatiev, governor of the Russian Central Bank, on Tuesday rarely held a media briefing to express optimism about the ruble's prospects, stating that the central bank would not expand the currency's target exchange rate corridor.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，如果油价能保持在目前这个水平，未来几周卢布走强的可能性远远大于走弱的可能。
Translation: He said that if oil prices can remain at their current level, the probability of the ruble strengthening in the coming weeks is far greater than that of it weakening.

Query_Text_cn: 克林姆林宫经济顾问达瓦科维奇(ArkadyDvorkovich)周二晚些时候在Twitter上发表评论，赞扬伊格纳提夫的讲话，还说当局有维持稳定所必须的一切手段。
Translation: Arkady Dvorkovich, Economic Adviser to the Kremlin, later on Tuesday posted on Twitter applauding Ignatov's remarks and said the authorities have all the necessary means to maintain stability.

Query_Text_cn: 但伊格纳提夫也承认卢布存在下行压力。最近几周，投资者纷纷逃离被视为高风险的资产，卢布因此遭受重创。
Translation: However, Ignatiev also acknowledged the downward pressure on the ruble. In recent weeks, investors have fled assets perceived as high-risk, causing the ruble to plummet as a result.

Query_Text_cn: 伊格纳提夫说，俄罗斯央行为减缓卢布跌势本月已抛售了60多亿美元，而周一抛售的20多亿美元就包括在内。
Translation: Ignatiev said the Russian Central Bank has sold over $6 billion this month to curb the ruble's decline, including over $2 billion sold on Monday.

Query_Text_cn: 交易员说，俄罗斯央行周一的干预举措是金融危机迫使俄罗斯2009年大幅贬值卢布以来规模最大的一次。
Translation: Traders said the intervention by the Central Bank of Russia on Monday was the largest since the 2009 financial crisis forced Russia to sharply devalue the ruble.

Query_Text_cn: 周二的口头干预至少临时起了一些作用，卢布兑美元汇率在俄罗斯Micex交易所出现上涨，从周一尾盘的1美元兑32.42卢布升至周二的31.69卢布。
Translation: Tuesday's verbal intervention at least temporarily served to boost the ruble's exchange rate against the dollar on Russia's Micex exchange, with the currency rising from 32.42 rubles per dollar in Monday's late trading to 31.69 rubles on Tuesday.

Query_Text_cn: 伊格纳提夫认为，卢布之所以走软是因为全球市场动荡导致资金外逃。
Translation: Ignatiev believes that the weakening of the ruble is due to global market turmoil leading to capital flight.

Query_Text_cn: 目前并不清楚俄罗斯央行是否会在周三买入更多卢布。
Translation: It remains unclear whether the Russian Central Bank will buy more rubles on Wednesday.

Query_Text_cn: 但IMF与库德林说，俄罗斯的很多金融问题与国内因素有更密切的关系。
Translation: However, IMF and Kudrin said that many of Russia's financial issues are more closely related to domestic factors.

Query_Text_cn: 库德林在被解职后的首次公开声明中依然坚持自己的看法。他因公开指责俄罗斯政府计划大幅增加防务和社会福利开支而在周一被韦德梅杰夫解职。
Translation: Kudrin stood by his views in his first public statement since being dismissed. He was dismissed by Medvedev on Monday for publicly criticizing the Russian government's plan to significantly increase defense and social welfare spending.

Query_Text_cn: 库德林在声明中说，过去几个月，尽管我对很多决定表示反对(有些是公开表示)，但无疑关于预算政策的决定增加了预算风险。
Translation: Kudrin stated in the declaration that over the past several months, although I have opposed many decisions (some publicly), there is no doubt that decisions on budgetary policy have increased budgetary risks.

Query_Text_cn: 执掌俄罗斯财政12年的库德林被很多投资者视作俄罗斯金融稳定的守卫者。他说，自己最初为这个问题准备辞职是在今年2月，但俄罗斯总理普京(VladimirPutin)劝说他留了下来。
Translation: Alexander Kudrin, who headed Russia's finance ministry for 12 years, is seen by many investors as a guardian of the country's financial stability. He said he had initially prepared to resign in February, but Russian Prime Minister Vladimir Putin persuaded him to stay.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，预算风险首先跟防务和社会福利开支计划过于庞大有关，而这将不可避免地影响整个国民经济。
Translation: He said that the budget risks are primarily associated with the excessively large-scale plans for defense and social welfare expenditures, and this will inevitably impact the entire national economy.

Query_Text_cn: IMF在一份有关俄罗斯情况的例行报告中警告说，支出大幅上扬让俄罗斯容易受到其主要出口商品石油出现价格下跌的影响。
Translation: IMF warned in a routine report on Russia that the sharp rise in spending has left the country vulnerable to the impact of a price decline in its main export commodity, oil.

Query_Text_cn: 事实上，我们说的是欧元区有可能爆发一场危机、美国或许会再次发生危机，以及欧洲和北美同时发生经济衰退的几率。
Translation: We are talking about the possibility of a crisis erupting in the Eurozone, the likelihood of another crisis in the United States, and the probability of simultaneous economic recessions in Europe and North America.

Query_Text_cn: 我们往往忽略了许多亚洲经济体的强劲增长态势，以及那里明显没有金融危机这一事实，我们事实上经常将中国和其他一些国家描绘为世界经济的潜在拯救者。
Translation: We often overlook the robust growth momentum of many Asian economies and the evident absence of financial crises in those regions. In fact, we frequently portray China and other countries as potential saviors of the world economy.

Query_Text_cn: 然而这种局面现在可能已经改变，我们或许一直都是对的。
Translation: However, the status quo may have changed, and we may have always been correct.

Query_Text_cn: 当前这场危机可能已经蔓延至全球。
Translation: The current crisis may have already spread to a global scale.

Query_Text_cn: 就像一直以来的那样，危机的信号来自金融市场。
Translation: As has been the case, the signals of crisis originate from financial markets.

Query_Text_cn: 目前，股市正在回升，金、银、铜、锌的价格已稳定下来，此前由于投资者担心全球经济增长放缓（不错，是全球性的）会打击对基本原材料的需求，这些金属的价格近来曾大幅下挫。
Translation: Currently, the stock market is rebounding and the prices of gold,silver,copper,zinc have stabilized. Previously, these metals' prices had plunged sharply due to investor concerns that a global growth slowdown (yes, a global phenomenon) would weaken demand for base materials.

Query_Text_cn: 那些经济依赖大宗商品出口的国家虽然本币汇率有所回升，但大宗商品和“商品货币”头上仍笼罩着阴云。
Translation: Although countries whose economies rely on commodity exports have seen some recovery in their domestic currencies, commodities and "commodity currencies" still face looming clouds of uncertainty.

Query_Text_cn: 这种局面引发了一些非常具有看跌色彩的研究结论，而这类论调通常只是在有关希腊经济和美国失业状况的评论中才会看到。
Translation: This situation has triggered some research conclusions with a highly bearish undertone, a rhetoric typically only seen in commentaries on Greece's economy and the U.S. unemployment situation.

Query_Text_cn: 与此同时，瑞银（UBS）的货币策略师们指出，上周资金继续从新兴市场经济体大量外流。
Translation: At the same time, UBS's currency strategists noted that funds continued to flow out of emerging-market economies heavily last week.

Query_Text_cn: 中国建设银行董事长郭树清说，在与美国高层官员和企业领导人举行会谈后，他受到了鼓舞，相信美国将批准中国的投资，而不会设置路障。
Translation: Guo Shuqing, chairman of China Construction Bank, said he was encouraged after meetings with senior U.S. officials and business leaders and believes the U.S. will approve China's investments without putting up roadblocks.

Query_Text_cn: 周一，郭树清在中美企业领导人合作伙伴计划会议后说，这让我们觉得，扩大在美直接投资是可能的，过去我们对此表示怀疑。
Translation: On Monday, Guo Shuqing said after the China-US Business Leaders Partnership Program meeting that this has made us feel that expanding direct investment in the US is possible, whereas we were previously skeptical about it.

Query_Text_cn: 郭树清、摩根士丹利(MorganStanley)董事长约翰?麦克(JohnMack)以及其他中美企业领导人在华盛顿讨论了贸易和经济问题，并与美国国务卿希拉里?克林顿(HillaryClinton)、财政部长盖特纳(TimothyGeithner)和白宫幕僚长戴利(WilliamDaley)举行了会谈。
Translation: Guo Shuqing, John Mack, chairman of Morgan Stanley, and other Chinese and American business leaders discussed trade and economic issues in Washington and held talks with U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner, and White House Chief of Staff William Daley.

Query_Text_cn: 郭树清说，中国投资者常常认为美国政府把一些行业归为“战略性”行业，而使中国投资无法进入。
Translation: Gou Shuqing said that Chinese investors often believe the U.S. government categorizes certain industries as "strategic" industries, thereby preventing Chinese investment from entering them.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，他说此行使他相信没有特别的政府政策限制中国投资，而是依照具体情况具体分析的原则决定是否允许投资。
Translation: However, he said that this visit has made him believe there are no special government policies restricting Chinese investment, but rather decisions on whether to approve investments are made based on the principle of specific analysis for specific circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，他认为这将使建设银行的客户更多地投资美国，特别是食品和农业企业。
Translation: He said that he believes this will encourage China Construction Bank's clients to invest more in the United States, especially in food and agricultural enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 郭树清说，如果我说我们希望收购美国银行(BankofAmerica)或花旗(Citigroup)15%、20%、30%甚至40%的股权，政府将很乐意批准。
Translation: If I were to say that we hope to acquire 15%, 20%, 30%, or even 40% equity in Bank of America or Citigroup, the government would be more than willing to approve.

Query_Text_cn: 但他也明确表示，建设银行没有进行此类收购的计划。
Translation: But he also made it clear that China Construction Bank has no plans to engage in such acquisitions.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，建设银行没有兴趣在发达国家大举扩张业务。
Translation: He said that China Construction Bank has no interest in aggressively expanding its business in developed countries.

Query_Text_cn: 摩根士丹利董事长麦克说，他鼓励中国同行投资美国基础设施项目，这样既可以获得不错的回报，还可以减少对中国投资的担心。
Translation: Morgan Stanley Chairman Michael said he encourages Chinese peers to invest in U.S. infrastructure projects, which can both yield respectable returns and reduce concerns over Chinese investments.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，中国公司应该效仿上世纪90年代日本制造商的模式；当时日本厂商在美国建厂，逐渐被视为是当地企业。
Translation: He said that Chinese companies should emulate the model of Japanese manufacturers in the 1990s; at that time, Japanese firms set up factories in the United States and gradually came to be viewed as local enterprises.

Query_Text_cn: 在其他问题上，郭树清说他认为中国应该更快地升值人民币，以减少中国外汇储备的积累。目前中国外汇储备为3.2万亿美元。
Translation: On other issues, Guo Shuqing said China should more rapidly appreciate the yuan to reduce the accumulation of its foreign exchange reserves. China's current foreign exchange reserves stand at $3.2 trillion.

Query_Text_cn: 自2010年6月中国允许人民币汇率在一定区间浮动以来，人民币兑美元以每年约5.5%的速度升值。
Translation: Since June 2010 when China allowed the renminbi exchange rate to float within a certain range, the renminbi has appreciated against the US dollar at an annual rate of approximately 5.5%.

Query_Text_cn: 他没有透露他认为合理的升值速度是多少，但看来与目前的速度相差不大。
Translation: He did not disclose the pace of appreciation he considers reasonable, but it appears to be not significantly different from the current speed.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，目前人民币升值速度接近市场预期。
Translation: He said that currently the pace of the renminbi's appreciation is approaching market expectations.

Query_Text_cn: 中国央行明确表示，计划让人民币继续升值，不过中国有些人担心疲软的经济可能会损害出口。
Translation: China's central bank has made it clear that it plans to let the yuan continue to appreciate; however, some people in China are concerned that a weak economy could harm exports.

Query_Text_cn: 这可能会成为放缓人民币升值速度的一个原因。
Translation: This could become a reason to slow the pace of RMB appreciation.

Query_Text_cn: 周一，中国央行将人民币兑美元汇率中间价上调至新高，此时正值全球投资者继续压低人民币币值。此举意味着尽管全球经济形势令人不安，但中国政府将继续推进人民币升值的进程。
Translation: On Monday, China's central bank set the midpoint rate for the yuan against the US dollar at a new high, even as global investors continued to depress the currency's value. This move signals that despite unsettling global economic conditions, the Chinese government will continue to advance the yuan's appreciation process.

Query_Text_cn: 周一，负责设定人民币每日交易区间的中国人民银行没有回复记者的置评请求。
Translation: On Monday, the People's Bank of China, responsible for setting the daily trading band for the yuan, did not respond to journalists' requests for comment.

Query_Text_cn: 但观察人士称，此举表明中国官员不会让市场对全球经济前景的不安情绪阻碍他们让人民币逐渐升值的努力。自从2010年6月中国政府基本结束人民币盯住美元的汇率政策以来，中国政府官员就一直在让人民币逐步升值。
Translation: Observers say this move signals that Chinese officials will not allow market unease over the global economic outlook to hinder their efforts to gradually appreciate the yuan. Since China effectively ended the yuan's peg to the dollar in June 2010, officials have been allowing the currency to steadily appreciate.

Query_Text_cn: 中国同时面临要求人民币升值的国际压力（尤其是美国），以减少部分美国国会议员所说的有利于中国出口商的不公平待遇。
Translation: China is facing international pressure, especially from the U.S., for RMB appreciation to reduce the unfair advantages benefiting Chinese exporters, as claimed by some U.S. congressional members.

Query_Text_cn: 东方汇理银行（CreditAgricoleCIB）驻香港高级经济学家科瓦尔奇克（DariuszKowalczyk）说，中国央行周一的举动旨在向市场释放一个信号，即尽管全球其它市场的投资者都在规避风险，但中国将继续让人民币升值。
Translation: Dariusz Kowalczyk, senior economist at Credit Agricole CIB in Hong Kong, said the People's Bank of China's move on Monday aimed to signal to the market that China will continue to allow yuan appreciation even as investors in other global markets are shunning risk.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，由于中国继续把重点放在抗击通胀上，人民币升值是降低通胀压力的快捷途径。
Translation: He said that as China continues to prioritize combating inflation, the appreciation of the yuan is the quickest route to reducing inflationary pressures.

Query_Text_cn: 招商银行股份有限公司（ChinaMerchantsBankCo.，简称：招商银行）高级分析师刘东亮说，中国央行不希望离岸市场的情绪影响到国内市场。
Translation: Liu Dongliang, a senior analyst at China Merchants Bank Co., said that the People's Bank of China does not want sentiment in the offshore market to affect the domestic market.

Query_Text_cn: 周一中国央行上调人民币汇率中间价之前，全球投资者已经令人民币多日承压。由于投资者纷纷买入传统避险投资品，他们在中国境外市场压低了人民币币值。
Translation: Before Monday, global investors had been putting sustained pressure on the yuan for days as they drove down the yuan's value in offshore markets by rushing to buy traditional safe-haven assets.

Query_Text_cn: 尽管中国政府在国内严格控制人民币，但投资者可以在香港自由买卖人民币，并交易与人民币相关联的期货产品。
Translation: Despite the Chinese government's strict control of the renminbi domestically, investors can freely buy and sell the currency in Hong Kong and trade RMB-linked futures products.

Query_Text_cn: 英国有关部门上周五表示，瑞士银行（UBSAG）发生的未经授权的违规交易在曝光前已经悄然进行了三年，并导致20亿美元的损失。英国有关部门已经以涉嫌欺诈指控瑞银一名31岁的交易员。
Translation: The UK authorities stated last Friday that the unauthorized irregular transactions at UBS AG, which had gone undetected for three years before coming to light, resulted in losses of $2 billion. The UK authorities have charged a 31-year-old trader with fraud.

Query_Text_cn: 在刚刚聘用自伦敦一家顶级律所的律师的陪同下，阿杜伯利（KwekuAdoboli）在法庭听证会上匆匆地呆望了记者一下，除了提供他的出生日期和地址，他几乎什么都没说。
Translation: Kweku Adoboli, accompanied by a lawyer recently hired from a prestigious law firm in London, briefly glanced at the journalists during the court hearing. Apart from providing his date of birth and address, he said little else.

Query_Text_cn: 在伦敦金融区的伦敦裁判法院（CityofLondonMagistrates'Court）举行的一场大约30分钟的听证会上，阿杜伯利用纸巾擦了擦眼睛，他还未进入答辩程序。
Translation: During a hearing lasting approximately 30 minutes held at the City of London Magistrates' Court in the financial district of London, Adubo used a tissue to wipe his eyes and had not yet entered his plea.

Query_Text_cn: 在有关部门对阿杜伯利提出指控之际，此案的初步情况开始显现：作为全球最大银行之一的瑞银据信存在内部失误，从而使得一个小型股票交易部门的年轻交易员在三年的时间内造成巨额损失，持续时间远远长于最初怀疑的期限。
Translation: As authorities bring charges against Archuleta, the preliminary details of the case are beginning to emerge: UBS, one of the world's largest banks, is believed to have had internal missteps that allowed a junior trader in a small equities trading unit to amass massive losses over three years—a duration far longer than initially suspected.

Query_Text_cn: 据熟悉情况和法庭文件的知情人士透露，未经授权的违规交易可以追溯到2008年。
Translation: According to informed sources familiar with the situation and court documents, unauthorized improper transactions can be traced back to 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 上周三，瑞银拉响了警报。当时，风险管理部门的负责人发现，专门负责共同基金组合交易部门的阿杜伯利涉嫌进行未经授权的交易。
Translation: Last Wednesday, UBS raised an alarm when the head of the risk management department discovered that Aduberry, responsible for the mutual fund portfolio trading department, was allegedly involved in unauthorized transactions.

Query_Text_cn: 据知情人士透露，在同阿杜伯利会面时，风险管理部门的负责人问了这位交易员很多问题，此后阿杜伯利离开公司回家。
Translation: According to sources familiar with the matter, during a meeting with Adubery, the head of the risk management department posed numerous questions to the trader. Adubery then left the company to return home.

Query_Text_cn: 周四凌晨3点30分阿杜伯利被捕。
Translation: Aduboli was arrested at 3:30 a.m. on Thursday.

Query_Text_cn: 上周五在法庭上，阿杜伯利被控两项罪名：一是伪造账目（falseaccounting），二是滥用职权构成欺诈。
Translation: On Friday in court, Adurberi was charged with two counts: one of false accounting and another of fraudulent abuse of position.

Query_Text_cn: 法庭文件显示，第一和第二项指控宣称阿杜伯利在2008年10月至2011年9月之间伪造了涉及交易所买卖基金（ETF）的交易记录。
Translation: Court documents show that the first and second charges allege Adoboli fabricated transaction records related to exchange-traded funds (ETFs) between October 2008 and September 2011.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一项指控宣称他在今年1月至9月间犯有欺诈罪。
Translation: Another charge alleges that he committed fraud between January and September this year.

Query_Text_cn: ETF是一种类似共同基金但却像股票那样进行交易的证券，通常旨在复制某种指数的走势。
Translation: An ETF is a type of security similar to mutual funds but traded like stocks, typically designed to track the performance of a particular index.

Query_Text_cn: 阿杜伯利的代理人、伦敦律所KingsleyNapley拒绝置评。
Translation: The agent for Adurbari, London law firm KingsleyNapley, declined to comment.

Query_Text_cn: 多年前这家律所曾代理尼古拉斯?李森（NicholasW.Leeson）的案子。李森在衍生工具上的交易导致拥有223年历史的霸菱银行（BaringsPLC）在1995年倒闭。
Translation: The law firm has handled the case of Nicholas W. Leeson in the past. Leeson's trading in derivatives led to the collapse of Barings PLC, a 223-year-old bank, in 1995.

Query_Text_cn: 李森后来因此入狱服刑。
Translation: Li Sen was subsequently imprisoned as a result.

Query_Text_cn: 关于阿杜伯利、他的交易活动以及这些未经授权的交易是如何逃过瑞银风险控制部门注意等问题还有许多未知。金融危机期间在抵押贷款上遭受巨大损失之后，瑞银一直在试图加强风险控制。
Translation: There are still many unknowns regarding Kweku Adoboli, his trading activities, and how these unauthorized transactions evaded the scrutiny of UBS's risk control department. Following significant losses from mortgages during the financial crisis, UBS has been striving to strengthen its risk controls.

Query_Text_cn: 上周末期间，瑞银可能得以更全面地了解了其风险控制措施为何没能阻止这起重大损失的原因。
Translation: Over the weekend, UBS may have gained a more comprehensive understanding of the reasons why its risk control measures failed to prevent the significant loss.

Query_Text_cn: 瑞银已经指示长期担任其法律顾问的史密夫律师事务所（HerbertSmithLLP）调查此事。
Translation: UBS has instructed its long-serving legal advisor, Herbert Smith LLP, to investigate the matter.

Query_Text_cn: 预计这家银行的管理者们将要回答棘手的问题，如这个计谋怎么能追溯至2008年，历时如此之久。
Translation: It is anticipated that the bank's management will have to answer tough questions, such as how this scheme can be traced back to 2008 and has endured for such a long time.

Query_Text_cn: 英国和瑞士的监管机构已对瑞银的亏损展开联合调查。
Translation: UK and Swiss regulators have launched a joint investigation into UBS's losses.

Query_Text_cn: 这个圆圆脸的交易员被置身于法庭上一个四周以玻璃围绕的被告席里，两边有法警看守。他穿着一件浅蓝色的V领毛衣，里面是一件白领衬衫。他一会儿看看旁听席上的记者，一会儿又看看法官。
Translation: The trader with a round face sat in a glass-enclosed defendant's dock in the courtroom, flanked by court officers on both sides. He wore a light blue V-neck sweater and a white-collared shirt. Alternately glancing at the journalists in the gallery and the judge, his gaze shifted between the two.

Query_Text_cn: 阿杜伯利的家人生活在加纳，闻听此事大为震惊的亲属当时曾试图找机会让他父亲飞往伦敦。他的父亲约翰?阿杜伯利(JohnAdoboli)是联合国一名已退休的人事官员。
Translation: Adoboli's family resides in Ghana. Upon hearing of the incident, his relatives were deeply shocked and had attempted to arrange for his father to fly to London at the time. His father, John Adoboli, was a retired personnel officer at the United Nations.

Query_Text_cn: 约翰在接受采访时说，上周四儿子的女友打来电话，他才首次得知儿子被捕。
Translation: John said in an interview that he first learned of his son's arrest when his son's girlfriend called him last Thursday.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，儿子曾说工作压力很大，但自己乐在其中。
Translation: He said his son had said the work pressure was very high, but he enjoyed it.

Query_Text_cn: 约翰说，有时我睡觉前会给儿子打个电话，而他会说，爸爸，我还在工作。
Translation: John said that sometimes before going to bed, he would call his son, and the son would say, "Dad, I'm still working."

Query_Text_cn: 据知情人士透露，阿杜伯利以前曾在一个名为Delta1的交易小组做事，这个名称意指有一定的交易风险，对价格变动也有一定的敏感性。
Translation: According to sources familiar with the matter, Aduboli previously worked in a trading group called Delta1, whose name implies a certain level of trading risk and sensitivity to price fluctuations.

Query_Text_cn: “Delta”指的是衡量买卖股票的选择权风险的指标。
Translation: "Delta" refers to the metric used to measure the risk associated with buying or selling stock options.

Query_Text_cn: 阿杜伯利所在的这个小组专门从事的是交易所买卖基金(ETF)。
Translation: The group that Adurble is part of specializes in exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

Query_Text_cn: 但知情人士说，该计谋的重点不是做相对普通的证券交易，而是做风险对冲。
Translation: But according to insiders, the focus of the strategy was not on routine securities trading but rather on risk hedging.

Query_Text_cn: 他们说，问题最终像雪球般越滚越大，直至局面失控。
Translation: They said that the problem eventually snowballed until the situation spiraled out of control.

Query_Text_cn: 交易员也推测认为，亏损和瑞士法郎最近的大幅波动有关。
Translation: Losses are also speculated to be linked to the recent significant fluctuations in the Swiss franc.

Query_Text_cn: ETF的受欢迎程度已大幅升温，因为它可让投资者对全球各领域进行押注，包括一些可能很难投资的领域，而利用的投资工具在很多时候却比一般共同基金更为便宜。
Translation: The popularity of ETFs has surged significantly as they allow investors to bet on various sectors globally, including some areas that are otherwise difficult to access, while the investment vehicles used are often cheaper than traditional mutual funds.

Query_Text_cn: 举例来说，希望押注人口增长将推动农机具需求上涨的投资者可投资一种有拖拉机和化肥制造商敞口的ETF。
Translation: For example, investors betting on population growth driving up demand for agricultural machinery can invest in an ETF with exposure to tractor and fertilizer manufacturers.

Query_Text_cn: 不过，ETF的流行也让它受到关注。
Translation: However, the popularity of ETFs has also drawn attention to them.

Query_Text_cn: 英国央行(BankofEngland)今年6月发布报告说，全球银行在ETF市场中面临风险，因为这些银行在日益复杂、透明度不断降低和关联度越来越紧密的ETF市场中充当交易伙伴。
Translation: The Bank of England said in a report released in June that global banks face risks in the ETF market, as these banks act as trading counterparties in an increasingly complex, declining transparency and growing interconnectedness ETF market.

Query_Text_cn: 阿杜伯利的听证会于上周五在英国央行附近的一个地点举行，共持续了半个小时左右，结束时，他仍被拘押，下一次出庭将在9月22日。
Translation: Adurble's hearing was held at a location near the Bank of England last Friday and lasted about half an hour. He remained in custody upon conclusion, with his next court appearance scheduled for September 22.

Query_Text_cn: 一份新的研究报告显示，去年外资银行中国业务的利润有提高，但仍然明显落后于中资银行的盈利增长速度，人才争夺战推高了外资银行的成本。
Translation: A new report shows that while foreign banks' China operations saw improved profits last year, their growth still significantly lags behind that of domestic banks. The talent competition has driven up their costs.

Query_Text_cn: 预计将于9月18日发布的这份由毕马威会计师事务所（KPMG）撰写的报告汇总了中国33家外资银行的数据。
Translation: The report, expected to be released on September 18 and prepared by KPMG (KPMG), summarizes data from 33 foreign banks in China.

Query_Text_cn: 其盈利水平仍大大低于2008年的高位。
Translation: Its profit levels remain far below the peak levels of 2008.

Query_Text_cn: AFP/GettyImages汇丰控股有限公司（HSBCHoldingsPLC，简称：汇丰控股）中国子公司的利润在2010年增长28%，至人民币9.22亿元（约合1.44亿美元），大约只有2008年18亿元利润水平的一半。汇丰控股是在中国内地经营规模最大的外资银行，其分支机构超过100家。
Translation: HSBC Holdings PLC (HSBC), the parent company of HSBC Holdings, reported that its Chinese subsidiary's profit rose 28% in 2010 to 922 million yuan (approximately $144 million), about half of the 1.8 billion yuan profit level in 2008. HSBC is the largest foreign bank operating in mainland China, with over 100 branches.

Query_Text_cn: 渣打集团（StandardCharteredPLC）中国子公司2010年的税后利润为3.84亿元，和2009年相比下降9%，远低于其2008年6.38亿元的利润水平。
Translation: In 2010, the post-tax profit of Standard Chartered PLC's China subsidiary was 3.84 billion yuan, a 9% decrease compared to 2009, far below its 2008 profit of 6.38 billion yuan.

Query_Text_cn: 摩根大通公司（J.P.MorganChase&Co.）中国子公司2010年的利润下降49%，至7,000万元，2009年其利润降幅已达21%。
Translation: In 2010, the profit of J.P. Morgan Chase & Co.'s China subsidiary fell by 49% to 70 million yuan, following a 21% decline in 2009.

Query_Text_cn: 花旗集团（CitigroupInc.）中国子公司的利润水平在2010年上升19%，至8.71亿元。
Translation: Citigroup Inc.'s China subsidiary's profit rose 19% in 2010 to 871 million yuan.

Query_Text_cn: 花旗集团没有公布2008年中国业务的利润。
Translation: Citigroup did not disclose the profits of its China operations in 2008.

Query_Text_cn: 相比之下，中国工商银行股份有限公司（Industrial&CommercialBankofChinaLtd.，简称：工商银行）去年的净利润增长了28%，至1,651.6亿元。2009年工商银行的净利润增幅为16%。
Translation: By comparison, Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Ltd. (ICBC) saw its net profit increase by 28% last year to 165.16 billion yuan. In 2009, the bank's net profit grew by 16%.

Query_Text_cn: 今年是大多数外资银行披露其中国子公司业绩详情的第二年。2010年中国银行业监管机构要求外资银行公开披露这方面信息。
Translation: This year marks the second year that most foreign banks have disclosed detailed performance information of their Chinese subsidiaries. In 2010, the China Banking Regulatory Commission mandated foreign banks to publicly disclose such information.

Query_Text_cn: 公开的数据仅仅包括外资银行中国子公司的业绩情况，不包括外资银行投资中资银行的收益或向赴海外上市的中资企业收取的承销费等项目。
Translation: The publicly available data only include the performance of foreign banks' Chinese subsidiaries and exclude projects such as returns from investments in Chinese banks or underwriting fees charged to Chinese enterprises listing overseas.

Query_Text_cn: 一些银行没有公开发布这些数据，它们将数据直接交给了毕马威。
Translation: Some banks did not publicly release this data; they submitted it directly to KPMG.

Query_Text_cn: 一直以来，外资银行都将中国视作促进增长的动力，但大部分外资银行在中国市场的势头还难有起色。截至2010年底，在中国银行业的总资产中，外资银行只占2%。
Translation: Foreign banks have long viewed China as a driver of growth, but most have struggled to gain momentum in the Chinese market. As of the end of 2010, foreign banks accounted for only 2% of the total assets of China's banking industry.

Query_Text_cn: 由于2009年的金融危机，外资银行在华收益大幅下滑，主要是因为在中资银行大量放贷以配合政府出台的刺激计划之际，外资银行却采取了其总部提出的谨慎做法。
Translation: Due to the 2009 financial crisis, the profits of foreign banks in China saw a significant decline, primarily because while state-owned banks engaged in massive lending to align with the government's stimulus plan, foreign banks adopted a cautious approach proposed by their headquarters.

Query_Text_cn: 摩根大通中国区董事长邵子力将该行在华成本的上升归因于分支机构的扩张、聘用更多的人员，以及与众多寻求增加在华银行业务人员的外资银行之间的人才争夺战。
Translation: Shao Zili, chairman of JPMorgan Chase China, attributes the rising costs of the bank's operations in China to the expansion of its branches, hiring more staff, and a talent competition with foreign banks seeking to increase their banking operations in China.

Query_Text_cn: 摩根大通的经营费用在2009年减少近20%后，去年增加了38%。
Translation: JPMorgan Chase's operating expenses dropped by nearly 20% in 2009 before increasing by 38% last year.

Query_Text_cn: 花旗中国区首席执行长欧兆伦(AndrewAu)说，该行在华增设分支机构和扩充人员推高了费用。
Translation: Andrew Au, Chief Executive Officer of Citigroup China, said that the bank's expansion of new branches and workforce in China has driven up costs.

Query_Text_cn: 渣打银行说，随着该行继续在华投资新的分支机构和人员，费用出现上升。
Translation: Standard Chartered said that operating costs have risen as the bank continues to invest in new branches and staff in China.

Query_Text_cn: 这些银行拒绝透露今年的利润预期。
Translation: These banks decline to disclose this year's profit forecasts.

Query_Text_cn: 汇丰拒绝置评。
Translation: HSBC declined to comment.

Query_Text_cn: 外资银行都在争夺能说汉语和英语（或其他一门外语）、有能力和经验但数量相对较少的人才，在这种情况下，成本开始上升。
Translation: Foreign banks are all vying for scarce talent who are capable, experienced, fluent in both Chinese and English (or another foreign language), driving up costs in such circumstances.

Query_Text_cn: 一家外资银行驻上海的一位高管说，在中国拥有至少10年外资银行工作经验的双语员工能比欧洲一些拥有同样经验的人挣的还多。
Translation: A senior executive at a foreign bank based in Shanghai said that bilingual employees in China with at least 10 years of experience in foreign banks can earn more than some of their counterparts in Europe with similar experience.

Query_Text_cn: 毕马威会计事务所驻北京的金融服务地区负责人李世民(SimonGleave)说，人员在外资银行间的流动性相对较大，他们频繁跳槽。银行间的人才争夺战极大地推高了成本。
Translation: Simon Gleave, Head of Financial Services for KPMG in Beijing, said that personnel mobility among foreign banks remains relatively high, with frequent employer-switching. The intense talent competition among banks has significantly driven up costs.

Query_Text_cn: 我认为近期内这种情形不会改变。
Translation: I believe that this situation will not change in the near term.

Query_Text_cn: 另外一个可能给盈利能力带来压力的因素是监管部门的要求。监管部门要求，在中国注册的外资银行年底前必须将未偿贷款减少至其所吸收存款的75%以下。
Translation: Another potential pressure on profitability stems from regulatory requirements. Authorities have mandated that foreign banks registered in China must reduce their outstanding loans to below 75% of deposits taken in by year-end.

Query_Text_cn: 这将使外资银行与一直以来必须遵守这条监管规定的中国本土银行站在同一起跑线上，并将增大外资银行争取客户存款的压力。
Translation: This move will place foreign banks on a level playing field with domestic banks that have had to adhere to this regulatory requirement all along,and will increase the pressure on foreign banks to mobilize customer deposits.

Query_Text_cn: 李世民说，鉴于外资银行有限的分支网络，我认为这将是一个持续性的问题，并不仅限于今年。他指出，数家外资银行已建立了足够大的网络来支撑相当大的存款基础。
Translation: Li Shimin said, "Given the limited branch networks of foreign banks, I believe this will be an ongoing issue, not limited to this year." He noted that several foreign banks have established sufficiently large networks to support a substantial deposit base.

Query_Text_cn: 他说，小银行将难以在存款市场上竞争。
Translation: He said that small banks will struggle to compete in the deposit market.

Query_Text_cn: 中国一环保部门下令两家工厂暂停生产，其中包括美国江森自控(JohnsonControlsInc.)在上海运营的一个电池厂。此前，该环保部门在工厂周边地区检测到儿童血铅超标。
Translation: Environmental authorities in China ordered two factories to suspend operations, including a battery plant operated by U.S.-based Johnson Controls Inc. in Shanghai, after detecting elevated lead levels in children's blood in areas surrounding the plants.

Query_Text_cn: 上海市环保局上周五发表声明说，发现少数儿童血铅超标，已责令其暂停生产。
Translation: Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau issued a statement last Friday saying that it had discovered a small number of children with elevated blood lead levels and ordered the suspension of production.

Query_Text_cn: 环保局说，将进行环境检测，但没有公布时间表。
Translation: The Environmental Protection Bureau said it will conduct environmental testing but did not announce a timetable.

Query_Text_cn: 上海市环保局发表简短声明之前，这两家位于上海浦东国际机场附近的工厂周边地区居民投诉了数天。
Translation: Before the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau issued a brief statement, residents in the surrounding areas of the two factories located near Shanghai Pudong International Airport had complained for several days.

Query_Text_cn: 新华社上周四援引上海市政府的一份声明报道说，有25名儿童患病，其中12人住院。
Translation: Xinhua News Agency reported last Thursday, citing a statement from the Shanghai municipal government, that 25 children fell ill, of whom 12 were hospitalized.

Query_Text_cn: 上海市环保局责令工厂暂停生产的声明说，该地区主要铅排放企业为上海江森自控国际蓄电池有限公司。江森自控总部位于美国密尔沃基，是全球最大的汽车铅蓄电池生产商之一。
Translation: The statement from the Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau ordering the factory to suspend production stated that the primary lead emitter in the region is Shanghai Johnson Controls International Battery Co., Ltd. Headquartered in Milwaukee, U.S., Johnson Controls is one of the world's largest manufacturers of automotive lead-acid batteries.

Query_Text_cn: 声明说，该厂使用铅锭和硫酸做为原辅材料，在生产过程中产生的铅烟、铅尘通过过滤除尘器处理后排放。
Translation: The statement says that the factory uses lead ingots and sulfuric acid as raw and auxiliary materials. The lead smoke and lead dust generated during production are treated and emitted after passing through a filtration dust collector.

Query_Text_cn: 声明没有指责该公司存在污染环境的违法行为。
Translation: The statement did not accuse the company of environmental violations.

Query_Text_cn: 江森自控驻上海发言人DanaYu上周五在回复记者的电子邮件中说，该公司非常重视潜在的铅污染问题，正在与上海有关部门协同努力。
Translation: JohnsonControlsShanghai-basedspokespersonDanaYusaidinareponsetoajournalist'semailonFridays thatthecompanytakesthepotentialleadcontaminationissueextremelyseriouslyandiscollaboratingwithrelevantauthoritiesinShanghai.

Query_Text_cn: 她说，但我们没有理由认为我们是问题的根源。
Translation: She said, but we have no reason to believe that we are the root cause of the problem.

Query_Text_cn: 上海市环保局较简要地提及另外一家由上海新明源汽车配件有限公司运营的被责令暂停生产的工厂，不过说该公司未经批准擅自从事涉铅生产。
Translation: The Shanghai Environmental Protection Bureau briefly mentioned another factory operated by Shanghai Xinmingyuan Auto Parts Co., Ltd. that had been ordered to halt production, however the company conducted lead-related production without proper authorization.

Query_Text_cn: 该厂经理李志良对美联社(AssociatedPress)说，我们不知道在没有许可证的情况下不能从事涉铅生产。
Translation: Li Zhiliang, the factory manager, told the Associated Press that we were unaware that it is illegal to engage in lead-related production without a license.

Query_Text_cn: 中国多年来一直努力解决铅中毒问题，分析人士常常把铅中毒作为中国工业快速发展所带来副作用的一个例证。
Translation: China has been working to address the issue of lead poisoning for years, and analysts often cite it as an example of the side effects brought by the country's rapid industrial development.

Query_Text_cn: 政府采取了多项措施，其中包括关闭一些铅冶炼厂，但问题依然严重。
Translation: The government has taken multiple measures, including the closure of some lead smelters, but the problem remains severe.

Query_Text_cn: 大约四年前，中国出口的儿童饰品引起全球关注，美国消费品安全委员会（U.S.ConsumerProductSafetyCommission）发现这些广受儿童喜爱的饰品含有铅，随即对产品进行召回。
Translation: About four years ago, Chinese exports of children's jewelry attracted global attention when the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) found that the popular items contained lead and promptly recalled the products.

Query_Text_cn: 在中国，媒体也报道了有人在处理所谓的电子垃圾时中毒的事件。电子垃圾是指被回收并被拆解为废金属的旧电脑。
Translation: In China, the media have also reported incidents of poisoning occurring during the handling of so-called electronic waste. Electronic waste refers to old computers that are recycled and disassembled into scrap metal.

Query_Text_cn: 中国国有媒体开始质疑由大型铅酸电池供电的廉价时尚电动自行车带来的健康影响。
Translation: Chinese state media have begun to question the health impacts of cheap and fashionable electric bikes powered by large lead-acid batteries.

Query_Text_cn: 上海出现这起最新的血铅事件前，人们已经连续几天控诉本月有儿童在参加开学体检时铅含量检测呈阳性，很多帖子都发布在新浪微博上。
Translation: Before this latest lead contamination incident occurred in Shanghai, people had been complaining for several consecutive days that children had tested positive for lead exposure during their back-to-school physical examinations this month, with many posts appearing on Sina Weibo.

Query_Text_cn: 研究显示，即便是血铅含量略微超标都可能会导致永久性的神经损伤和智力下降，尤其是儿童。
Translation: Studies show that even a slight exceedance of blood lead levels may cause permanent neurological damage and cognitive decline, particularly in children.

Query_Text_cn: 江森自控发言人DanaYu在声明中说，公司上海工厂的铅排放量是中国国家标准允许量的约七分之一，而通过废水处理厂排出的铅约为国家标准的十分之一。
Translation: Dana Yu said in a statement that the lead emissions from the company’s Shanghai plant are about one-seventh of China’s national standards, and the lead discharged through the wastewater treatment plant is roughly a tenth of the national standards.

Query_Text_cn: 她说，我们工厂的员工会定期进行检测，以确保他们的血铅水平足够低。
Translation: She said that the employees of our factory are regularly tested to ensure that their blood lead levels remain sufficiently low.

Query_Text_cn: 这座上海工厂拥有13年历史，于2005年被江森自控收购。包括该工厂在内，江森自控在中国共有三家工厂，在全球拥有约30家。
Translation: The Shanghai factory, with a history of 13 years, was acquired by Johnson Controls in 2005. Including this facility, Johnson Controls has three factories in China and approximately 30 worldwide.

Query_Text_cn: 上周，公司刚刚宣布计划在中国新建一座1亿美元的蓄电池厂，用于制造能使汽车引擎快速启动和停止的高级铅酸电池，具体厂址尚未确定。
Translation: Last week, the company announced plans to build a $100 million battery plant in China to produce advanced lead-acid batteries that enable car engines to rapidly start and stop. The specific location has yet to be determined.

Query_Text_cn: 多国财长和央行行长本周将齐聚华盛顿出席国际货币基金组织(IMF)年会，届时IMF新任总裁拉嘉德(ChristineLagarde)可能会语惊四座。
Translation: Finance ministers and central bank governors from multiple countries will gather in Washington this week to attend the International Monetary Fund (IMF) annual meeting, where IMF's new managing director ChristineLagarde might stun the audience.

Query_Text_cn: 年会最重要的议题是，如何阻止全球经济重新陷入衰退。
Translation: The most important agenda of the annual meeting is how to prevent the global economy from falling back into recession.

Query_Text_cn: IMF总裁通常会非常谨慎，他们一般是按照该组织187个成员国领导人，尤其是按照最有影响力的领导人的意思行事。
Translation: IMF managing directors are typically cautious and generally act in accordance with the wishes of the organization's 187 member countries' leaders, especially the most influential ones.

Query_Text_cn: 对IMF来说，这将需要立场上的一个彻底转变。在过去一两年，IMF一直坚持认为，各国应当把削减赤字作为首要目标。
Translation: For the IMF, this would require a complete shift in stance. Over the past one or two years, the IMF has consistently maintained that countries should prioritize cutting deficits as their top priority.

Query_Text_cn: 它的这种告诫对于实行紧缩的国家起了很大的推动作用。
Translation: Its warnings have served as a significant catalyst for countries implementing austerity measures.

Query_Text_cn: 后来又出现了有关信用评级的担忧，英国等一些国家为此迅速、大幅地削减了预算。
Translation: Later, concerns over credit ratings emerged, prompting the UK and some other countries to swiftly and drastically cut their budgets.

Query_Text_cn: 如今，紧缩措施对经济的增长前景开始构成压力。
Translation: Now, austerity measures are beginning to exert pressure on the growth prospects of the economy.

Query_Text_cn: 英国经济去年末有所收缩，引发外界怀疑它是否已走出衰退，开始复苏。
Translation: The UK economy contracted at the end of last year, prompting external observers to question whether it had emerged from recession and begun to recover.

Query_Text_cn: 有些预测人士警告称，如果美国目前实行的税收减免和其它刺激举措今年结束的话，美国经济明年也将很危险地逼近收缩。
Translation: Some analysts warn that if the current tax cuts and other stimulus measures in the U.S. are set to expire this year, the U.S. economy could also edge perilously close to contraction next year.

Query_Text_cn: 虽然不断增加的债务负担是个长期问题，但拉嘉德已开始主张，各国应在处理较长期赤字问题的同时，竭力恢复经济增长。
Translation: Although the growing debt burden represents a long-term issue, Lagarde has begun advocating that countries should strive to restore economic growth while addressing their long-term fiscal deficits.

Query_Text_cn: 拉嘉德上周说，在全球很多地区，人们过于严苛地执行紧缩措施，却没有让经济稳步增长。
Translation: Christine Lagarde said last week that in many regions around the world, people have implemented austerity measures too stringently without leading to steady economic growth.

Query_Text_cn: 但她在表达上一直很小心，没有直接批评英国的做法，而是把自己的意思用IMF惯有的不得罪大股东的方式加以淡化处理。
Translation: However, she has always been cautious in her communications, refraining from directly criticizing the UK's approach and instead opting to present her stance using the IMF's customary approach of avoiding alienating major shareholders to downplay her message.

Query_Text_cn: 麻省理工学院(MassachusettsInstituteofTechnology)经济学家、IMF前首席经济学家约翰逊(SimonJohnson)说，现在的问题是欧洲国家以及美国内部对于进行经济刺激存在很大分歧，这让IMF大伤脑筋。
Translation: Simon Johnson, an MIT economist and former chief economist of the IMF, said that the problem now is that there are significant disagreements among European countries and within the United States regarding the implementation of economic stimulus measures, which is causing headaches for the IMF.

Query_Text_cn: 市场开始断言，欧洲立法者没有能力拿出采取果断措施的意愿，这些措施包括扩大救助资金的范围，或至少展示出政府有实力阻止银行破产。
Translation: Markets are beginning to assert that European lawmakers lack the capacity to muster the willingness to take decisive actions, including expanding the scope of rescue funds or at least demonstrating the government's capability to prevent bank failures.

Query_Text_cn: 欧洲需要在各国间制定一项紧密协调的财政政策，即使欧洲选民意识到这可能意味着类似于“欧洲联合众国”的形式。
Translation: Europe needs to establish a closely coordinated fiscal policy among its member states, even if European voters become aware that this could amount to a form akin to a "United States of Europe".

Query_Text_cn: 前法国财政部长拉嘉德正处于IMF总裁职务的蜜月阶段，她在欧洲有公信力。
Translation: Christine Lagarde, former French Finance Minister, is in the honeymoon phase of her tenure as Managing Director of the IMF and enjoys established credibility in Europe.

Query_Text_cn: 她的任务是：提出建设一个更团结欧盟的具体计划，她可能会说更团结的欧盟对普通欧洲人有利。
Translation: Her task is to propose concrete plans for building a more united EU; she might argue that a more united EU benefits ordinary Europeans.

Query_Text_cn: IMF一直在分析的提议是将欧洲债务整合进由各国政府通过欧洲救援基金共同支持的金融工具，而不是迫使陷入麻烦的国家独自承受现有的债务。
Translation: The proposal that the IMF has been analyzing involves integrating European debt into a financial instrument co-financed by governments through the European rescue fund, rather than forcing troubled countries to bear existing debt alone.

Query_Text_cn: 这可能是个开始。
Translation: This may be the beginning.

Query_Text_cn: 说服金砖国家发挥更大作用。
Translation: Encourage BRICS countries to play a greater role.

Query_Text_cn: 在其他国家犹豫不决之时，一些欧洲政府很自然地会找这些国家寻求财政支持。
Translation: When other countries are hesitant, some European governments naturally turn to these countries for financial support.

Query_Text_cn: 如果认为这些国家会救助欧洲并以本国公民的钱来冒险（新兴市场其他国家不会冒这个险），这是不切实际的。
Translation: It is unrealistic to think that these countries would bail out Europe by risking their own citizens' money (other emerging market countries would not take such a risk).

Query_Text_cn: 但认为它们会成为欧洲解决方案的一部分，这也不是什么天真的想法。
Translation: But it is also not a naive idea to believe that they would be part of the European solution.

Query_Text_cn: 中国国务院总理温家宝非常有商业头脑，他已经暗示如果欧洲为中国提供一些贸易优惠，中国可能会加大购买力度。
Translation: Wen Jiabao, the Chinese Premier known for his shrewd business acumen, has hinted that if Europe offers China some trade preferences, China may step up its purchasing.

Query_Text_cn: 对欧洲来说这可能是个糟糕的交易，但这表明中国有参与的意愿。
Translation: This might be a bad deal for Europe, but it indicates China's willingness to participate.

Query_Text_cn: 中国和巴西担心全球经济放缓可能会损害本国的出口，甚至对本币升值造成更大压力。
Translation: China and Brazil are concerned that the global economic slowdown may harm their exports and even exert greater pressure on the appreciation of their currencies.

Query_Text_cn: 哈佛经济学家、IMF前首席经济学家罗格夫（KennethRogoff）说，中国拥有3.2万亿美元的储备，比IMF的财力强得多；但中国参与到欧洲事务中来在政治上十分复杂；一个原因是普通中国人的工资只是欧洲人的一小部分，他们在想贫穷的中国是否应救援富裕的欧洲。
Translation: Harvard economist and former IMF Chief Economist Kenneth Rogoff said that China, with $3.2 trillion in reserves, has far greater financial capacity than the IMF; but China's involvement in European affairs is politically very complex; one reason is that average Chinese workers earn only a fraction of what Europeans do, and they question whether a poorer China should bail out a wealthier Europe.

Query_Text_cn: 2008年金融危机期间某个凌晨的三点钟，一位华尔街高管站在他所在银行的总部的大堂里，准备去参加一场紧急会议。
Translation: At 3 a.m. during the 2008 financial crisis, a Wall Street executive stood in the lobby of his bank's headquarters, preparing to attend an emergency meeting.

Query_Text_cn: 他四下张望着空旷的大厅，那里除了几个昏昏欲睡的保安之外什么也没有，突然，他的目光落在一排自动取款机上。
Translation: He glanced around the empty hall, which contained nothing but a few drowsy security guards, when suddenly his gaze fell on a row of ATM machines.

Query_Text_cn: 相关报道我指出，这样等于是在股市下跌时卖出，在债券市场上扬时买进，但他不以为然。他表示，“现在要做的就是让资本保值，就算我在这个过程中会损失一点钱，那也随它去好了。
Translation: In the related report, I pointed out that this approach amounts to selling during a stock market downturn and buying in the bond market when it is rising.
